name: Call of Duty - Modern Warfare 2
description: The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 campaign starts five years after its predecessor. The world faces destruction again. Russians make Zhakaev a hero and threaten peace. A terrorist aids them in escalating tensions. Players control various characters in missions worldwide. The game is a first-person shooter with linear but scripted gameplay, including shooting, sneaking, and driving. Players use modern weapons but can only carry two at a time. Multiplayer mode features a ranking system. They gain experience points and unlock new content. They also can create custom classes or use standard ones. A two-player co-op mode, Spec Ops, is available when offering missions. They are separate from the main campaign in that they have different objectives and difficulty settings. The game combines action-packed gameplay with a complex storyline. In addition, it offers diverse game modes for single and multiplayer experiences.

name: Doom 3 BFG Edition
description: The game offers the game for players when they can try the base game and many expansion versions. In this game, many improvements appear, but the gameplay is still related to technology and demons. The story starts on Mars in 2145 with many secret experiments. Players control a marine sent to this planet and face the new enemies you have not seen before. From the first perspective, aiming, shooting, and running are the base moves. Enemies range from zombies to demons. Before entering the dark areas, players must be careful to use a flashlight or weapons. At the same time, they also feel the horror-focused theme and find ways to survive longer.

name: Call of Duty - Modern Warfare 3
description: Modern Warfare 3 is a first-person shooter with a continuing story. It allows players to choose from single or co-op gameplay. In the campaign, they can take on various roles and participate in a war that involves multiple countries. Spec Ops mode returns, and survival mode is new and challenging. Kill Confirmed is a new mode where players must collect dog tags. Meanwhile, the team defender is involved in capturing and holding a flag before the invasion of the enemies. Private matches offer unique pre-made modes when you want to play with your friends. Therefore, each mode has its own rules and objectives you can choose from if you like. The game expands on the series’ established formula while introducing fresh elements.

name: Grand Theft Auto V (GTA 5)
description: Grand Theft Auto V is set in Los Santos with three exceptional protagonists: Michael, Trevor, and Franklin. Players can switch between them instantly because each character has unique missions and personalities. At the same time, they often work together for heists that require planning and hiring henchmen. The gameplay involves gunfights and an open world. Players can steal various vehicles and roam freely or complete missions. Illegal activities are possible, but they increase the wanted level. In particular, police pursue players with high wanted levels. Players can lose the police by hiding or changing vehicles. Michael meets Franklin during a car repossession job. They become friends and burn down a mansion together, which belongs to a drug lord. He demands compensation. Michael and Franklin rob a jewelry store. Trevor, Michael’s old partner, joins them after hearing about the heist. Their lives then become increasingly chaotic.

name: Call of Duty - Black Ops II
description: Black Ops II is a first-person shooter game set in two timelines when players control different characters. The story connects two destinies and their common enemy. At the same time, you will find the plot related to a new cold war and revenge with presented drones and robotic technology. Players can customize their weapons before missions and try the non-linear campaign. Specially, choices can affect the story and ending of the game. To have the freedom to experience new sandbox-style missions called Strike Force is the best choice. It allows for commanding troops from above or playing the soldier roles.

name: God of War Collection - Infinity Cut
description: Being an action-adventure game, God of War is played from the third-person perspective with the main character, Kratos. Players fight against enemies from Greek mythology, like minotaurs, harpies, and zombie soldiers. Therefore, the Hydra and the Guardian of Pandora are bosses and require them to pay attention to. Jumping and climbing are essential in platforming. While some riddles are easy, some are really difficult. Players can restore their health and magic by collecting orbs. Gain experience for improvements by consuming red orbs. You can enhance your meter length by using Gorgon Eyes and Phoenix Feathers. Remastered editions of the original two games are part of this collection. These updates include better visuals and a frame rate of 60 FPS. They also offer help for trophies. All of the visuals are in high definition now, so they’re much sharper.

name: The Elder Scrolls V - Skyrim - Dawnguard
description: INTRODUCTION It’s been just over half a year since The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim hit our gaming screens, and Bethesda Softworks, the wizards behind this masterpiece, has already cooked up a fresh and riveting storyline for fans to sink their teeth into. Dawnguard, as this extensive DLC expansion for PC, X360, and PS3 is known, not only extends the game time by 10 to 20 hours but also unfurls an array of exciting features that adds an extra layer of sizzle to this fantasy saga. UNFOLDING THE EPIC TALE The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim – Dawnguard escorts players into a gripping narrative. Harkon, the feared lord of vampires, is plotting to plunge the world into perpetual darkness using the power of the Elder Scrolls. Pitted against him is the valiant Dawnguard, a band of vampire hunters. Now, it’s up to Dovahkiin, our protagonist, to shelve his dragon-hunting spree temporarily and take a decisive stand in this brewing conflict. TWO ROADS DIVERGED IN THE GAME The most intriguing part of this expansion pack is that players can pick between darkness and light in this skirmish. Aligning with Harkon’s vampire legion allows you to morph into a vampire lord, mirroring the werewolf transformation from the original game. The new avatar has unique skills, such as vampire catch, perfect for trapping and weakening foes. Opting for the Dawnguard, on the other hand, arms you with crossbows and a new shout – Soul Tear, which commands the spirit of a defeated foe to ally with Dovahkiin. Regardless of your allegiance, both sides offer immersive and distinct lairs – the sinister castle Volkihar for Harkon’s followers and a secluded fortress in the mountains for the Dawnguard. THE LUST FOR POWER: NEW ABILITY TREES Dawnguard introduces two fresh ability trees dedicated to the vampire and werewolf forms. But don’t worry if you’re an experienced player; Bethesda has factored that in. Instead of relying on experience points, these trees are powered by defeating enemies with these skills. Whether facing off against legendary dragons, petrifying gargoyles, or armored trolls, each victory will develop your character. MOUNTED COMBAT AND VISUAL MAKEOVERS Here’s something that’ll make the fans grin. Dawnguard finally allows players to wage battles while astride their steeds; a feature much yearned for in the base game. But that’s not all. If you’re not thrilled with your character’s appearance, don’t worry because a simple trip to the underground sewers of Riften can change that. Find the right contact, and you’ll get a brand-new look soon. EXPLORING THE REALM OF IMPRISONED SOULS As the narrative of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim – Dawnguard intensifies, players will venture into the haunting realm of Soul Cairn, a land of captive spirits. This eerie environment brims with undead foes and promises fresh abilities for players to harness. It’s an exploration that extends the game’s depth, underscoring Bethesda’s commitment to pushing the boundaries of immersive gaming. So, whether you’re new to the series or an ardent fan, this game guarantees a thrilling rollercoaster ride into the heart of fantasy gaming. Brace yourself for an epic adventure – Dawnguard awaits!

name: Call of Duty - Black Ops
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops is the seventh game in the series. It takes place during the Cold War. Players control special forces soldiers in secret missions. The game includes operations in Vietnam, Russia, Cuba, and Laos. The main characters are Alex Mason and Jason Hudson. They investigate a Soviet chemical weapon called Nova-6. The game has multiplayer modes to give players the chance to play online or offline. They can earn XP points to increase their ranks and gain a higher position. There’s also a zombie co-op mode. Players can earn CoD Points and bet them in special matches. Black Ops introduces new features where players can customize their characters more. In some matches, piloting aircraft like helicopters and stealth planes play an important role. The game combines action and strategy, so it offers various gameplay options based on the preferences of players.

name: Grand Theft Auto IV (GTA 4)
description: Niko Bellic, an ex-soldier from Serbia, moves to the United States seeking a better life because of Roman’s rich promises. However, the reality is starkly different because Roman is poor, jobless, and indebted to shady characters. By helping his hapless cousin, he becomes entangled in a life of crime. He also seeks revenge on a traitor from his past in Serbia through some missions. GTA IV adds new elements with the retaining features of the previous game. Players can steal cars and listen to radio stations while watching TV and browsing a fictional internet. Players can also use police databases and engage in various side activities. At the same time, 16 players can roam freely in 15 different multiplayer modes. The number changes through the platform; for example, the Windows version supports 32 players and boasts improved graphics. These features enhance the overall gaming experience and provide players with more options for entertainment and creativity.

name: Call of Duty - Modern Warfare 2 - Ultimate Edition
description: The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 campaign starts five years after its predecessor. The world faces destruction again. Russians make Zhakaev a hero and threaten peace. A terrorist aids them in escalating tensions. Players control various characters in missions worldwide. The game is a first-person shooter with linear but scripted gameplay, including shooting, sneaking, and driving. Players use modern weapons but can only carry two at a time. Multiplayer mode features a ranking system. They gain experience points and unlock new content. They also can create custom classes or use standard ones. A two-player co-op mode, Spec Ops, is available when offering missions. They are separate from the main campaign in that they have different objectives and difficulty settings. The game combines action-packed gameplay with a complex storyline. In addition, it offers diverse game modes for single and multiplayer experiences.

name: Phantom Breaker - Extra - Legacy Release
description: Phantom Breaker - Extra - Legacy Release

name: Call of Duty - Black Ops III
description: INTRODUCTION Step into the exhilarating world of Call of Duty: Black Ops II, a military-themed first-person shooter that proudly stands as the ninth entry in the beloved game series. Crafted by the seasoned artisans at Treyarch Studios, who previously graced us with Call of Duty 3, Call of Duty: World at War, and the original Call of Duty: Black Ops, this latest installment continues to redefine the gaming landscape. A FRESH PERSPECTIVE ON STORYTELLING Call of Duty: Black Ops II transports players to 2025 in a daring divergence from the traditional settings. It’s the era of a new Cold War, with the United States and China as principal actors, and the stakes are sky-high – the control of rare earth elements, the lifeblood of expensive electronics and alternative energy. The tale unfolds through the eyes of David Mason, the son of Alex Mason from the first Black Ops, and his formidable foe, Raul Menendez of Nicaragua. Rife with flashbacks from the 80s and familiar faces like Frank Woods, this game is a thrilling roller coaster ride of nostalgic callbacks and futuristic predictions. ADVANCED GAMEPLAY MECHANICS Future warfare has its perks, especially in the form of advanced weaponry and equipment. Imagine taking down opponents with sniper rifles equipped with scopes that can reveal hidden enemies or employing electric charges as ammunition. Adding improved sights and a computer integrated into the uniform lends an extra strategic edge by enabling air support calls. Yet, it’s not just about shooting – there are various activities to partake in. The freedom to maneuver advanced vehicles such as the F-38 fighter and futuristic helicopters sets Black Ops II apart from its predecessors. NEW DIMENSIONS TO STRATEGY In an innovative twist, players can choose how to execute specific missions by providing long-range cover with a sniper rifle or getting up close and personal, guns blazing. This flexibility adds dynamism to the gameplay and allows for personalization according to your preferred play style. Each choice offers a unique vantage point, making every playthrough feel different. EXCITING GAME MODES Black Ops II introduces the innovative Strike Force Operations mode, an amalgamation of real-time strategy with classic FPS gameplay. Take the reins of a drone, lead a foot soldier, or manage the operation from the skies. But be warned, failure in this mode doesn’t result in the game being over; instead, it dampens your standing on the international stage, influencing the game’s conclusion. REFINED MULTIPLAYER AND ZOMBIE MODES The multiplayer mode has received a significant upgrade, with the innovative Pick 10 system allowing for greater customization. It’s all about strategic choices, whether you’re picking improvements, using “Wildcards,” or selecting your weapons. Destruction is your playground, whether drones or the unique microwave gun. With various maps offering varied settings, the game also fosters a strong connection with social media, adding a new dimension to your experience. The iconic Zombie mode also makes a triumphant return, with feedback-driven improvements and three varied game variants, providing an adrenaline-pumping co-op experience. TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCEMENTS Call of Duty: Black Ops II leverages a heavily modified graphics engine that traces back to Call of Duty: World at War and the first Black Ops. The improvements include enhanced physics, partial environment destruction, and extraordinarily detailed locations, all while maintaining the series’ hallmark smooth animation at 60 frames per second. With DirectX 11 at its core, the game ensures that players are treated to a visual spectacle befitting this highly anticipated installment.

name: Call of Duty 4 - Modern Warfare
description: A new spin is introduced to the Call of Duty series in the fourth installment. The original creators have returned. In Europe, players join the British Special Air Service, whereas in the Middle East, they become Marines. Fictitious international terrorism is an element of the game. Call of Duty 4 is still a first-person shooter, but it takes place in a modern world with new weapons. Throughout the campaign, players will face up against a variety of modern foes. They are multi-talented and can play two distinct military roles. You can control a variety of multiplayer options. The single-player missions feature various activities to discover the twisting plot. Players can choose weapons that fit their style from a huge arsenal. The effects are a part of the new 3D engine when giving the physics and dynamic lighting.

name: Batman - Arkham City
description: Batman: Arkham City is a sequel to Arkham Asylum with the same-name protagonist. Eighteen months after the first game, Quincy Sharp becomes mayor and creates a large prison in Arkham City. Batman enters the prison as Bruce Wayne and fights against Hugo Strange and other villains. The story involves a disease and a secret plan. Many famous characters appear in the game with an open world to explore. Batman can fight, use gadgets, and solve puzzles. He can choose between direct attacks or stealth. Batman has improved abilities and new gadgets through many missions; for example, the Detective mode helps with investigations. Players can complete side quests and collect Riddler trophies. Catwoman is also playable in some missions. The combat system allows for chained combos and throws. Batman’s arsenal includes familiar and new gadgets that are used for fighting, puzzle-solving, and traversing the environment. In the mix of action-and-strategy gameplay, the grappling hook and line launcher have been improved. New gadgets also include ice grenades and disruptors.

name: Fallout 3 - Collector’s Edition - Infinity Cut
description: Product Description Fallout 3 from the creators of the award-winning Oblivion, featuring one of the most realized game worlds ever created. Create any kind of character you want and explore the open wastes of post-apocalyptic Washington D.C. Every minute is a fight for survival as you encounter Super Mutants, Ghouls, Raiders and other dangers of the Wasteland. Prepare for the future. Amazon.com The third game in the Fallout series, Fallout 3 is a singleplayer action role-playing game (RPG) set in a post-apocalyptic Washington DC. Combining the horrific insanity of the Cold War era theory of mutually assured destruction gone terribly wrong, with the kitschy naivety of American 1950s nuclear propaganda, Fallout 3 will satisfy both players familiar with the popular first two games in its series as well as those coming to the franchise for the first time. ‘Fallout 3’ game logo The Cold War goes Next-Gen The Capital Wasteland Welcome to the nation’s capital. View larger. Brotherhood of Steel member The Brotherhood of Steel is a powerful ally. View larger. The Pip-Boy Model 3000 Customize characters with your Pip-Boy. View larger. The optional turn-based VATS mode The optional turn-based VATS mode. View larger. The Story: Vault 101 – Jewel of the Wastes For 200 years, Vault 101 , a fallout shelter, has faithfully served the surviving residents of Washington DC and its environs, now known as the Capital Wasteland. Though the global atomic war of 2077 left the US all but destroyed, the residents of Vault 101 enjoy a life free from the constant stress of the outside world. Giant Insects, Raiders, Slavers, and yes, even Super Mutants are all no match for superior Vault-Tec engineering. Yet one fateful morning, you awake to find that your father has defied the Overseer and left the comfort and security afforded by Vault 101 for reasons unknown. Leaving the only home you’ve ever known, you emerge from the Vault into the harsh Wasteland sun to search for your father, and the truth. Key Features: Limitless Freedom! – Take in the sights and sounds of the vast Capital Wasteland! See the great monuments of the United States lying in post-apocalyptic ruin! You make the choices that define you and change the world. Just keep an eye on your Rad Meter! Experience S.P.E.C.I.A.L.! – Vault-Tec engineers bring you the latest in human ability simulation – the SPECIAL Character System! Utilizing new breakthroughs in points-based ability representation, SPECIAL affords unlimited customization of your character. Also included are dozens of unique skills and perks to choose from, each with a dazzling variety of effects! Fantastic New Views! – The wizards at Vault-Tec have done it again! No longer constrained to just one view, experience the world from 1st or 3rd person perspective. Customize your view with the touch of a button! The Power of Choice! – Feeling like a dastardly villain today, or a Good Samaritan? Pick a side or walk the line, as every situation can be dealt with in many different ways. Talk out your problems in a civilized fashion, or just flash your Plasma Rifle. Blast ‘Em Away With V.A.T.S.! –Even the odds in combat with the Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System for your Pip-Boy Model 3000! V.A.T.S. allows you to pause time in combat, target specific body parts on your target, queue up attacks, and let Vault-Tec take out your aggression for you. Rain death and destruction in an all-new cinematic presentation featuring gory dismemberments and spectacular explosions. Mind-Blowing Artificial Intelligence! – At Vault-Tec, we realize that the key to reviving civilization after a global nuclear war is people. Our best minds pooled their efforts to produce an advanced version of Radiant AI, America’s First Choice in Human Interaction Simulation. Facial expressions, gestures, unique dialog, and lifelike behavior are brought together with stunning results by the latest in Vault-Tec technology. Eye-Popping Prettiness! – Witness the harsh realities of nuclear fallout rendered like never before in modern super-deluxe HD graphics. From the barren Wasteland, to the danger-filled offices and metro tunnels of DC, to the hideous rotten flesh of a mutant’s face. The Fallout 3 Collector’s Edition includes: Fallout 3: From the creators of the award-winning Oblivion comes Fallout 3, featuring one of the most realized game worlds ever created. Create any kind of character you want and explore the open wastes of post-apocalyptic Washington, D.C. Every minute is a fight for survival as you encounter Super Mutants, Ghouls, Raiders, and other dangers of the Wasteland. Prepare for the future. Vault Boy Bobblehead: Enjoy your very own Vault Boy with this collector’s item direct from Vault-Tec. The Art of Fallout 3: This hardcover book features nearly 100 pages of never-before seen concept art and commentary from Bethesda Game Studios artists. The Making of Fallout 3: Get an exclusive, inside look at Bethesda Game Studios and the team behind the game with this special DVD. Vault-Tec Lunch Box: The entire package comes in a fully customized metal lunch box.

name: LEGO Batman 3 - Beyond Gotham
description: “Lego Batman 3” is an extremely exciting action-adventure game based on the image of the most famous superhero in DC Comics, Batman. The game was developed by Travel Tales and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment in November 2014 for many different platforms. “Lego Batman 3” is the 3rd version of the “Lego Batman” series of games. Right at the time of launch, the game has met the expectations of many players around the world. Many game critics have also praised the building for its extremely compelling storyline, beautiful and captivating graphics, game humor and variety of characters. The game “Lego Batman 3” also retains the core of the previous versions, with the number of characters in the game up to more than 200 different characters. Players can freely choose any one of the characters in the game from a third-person perspective, mainly fighting the enemies, solving puzzles and collecting Lego ‘studs’, the game’s currency. Players can also perform combined attacks in combat will multiply the number of “studs” earned. Up to two players can play in cooperative mode. In the game, there are many different environments, all based on the famous locations in the DC comic universe. Like previous Lego games, the levels are unlocked for “Free Play” mode when they are completed in Story Mode. “Free Play” allows players to replay any completed level.

name: SoulCalibur IV & Tekken 6
description: SoulCalibur IV & Tekken 6

name: Elder Scrolls V - Skyrim
description: INTRODUCTION: Dipping your toes into the rich, immersive realm of Bethesda Softworks Studios’ renowned role-playing franchise, you find yourself back in the heartland of Tamriel. With “The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim,” a new saga unfurls, painting a grand epic of dragons’ resurgence on the land and the valiant Dovahkiin’s struggle against the looming shadow of destruction. STORYTELLING IN THE GAME: Set two centuries post the events of Oblivion, “Skyrim” thrusts you into the role of a dragon hunter, or Dovahkiin, the last of the fabled dragon slayers. Until recently, the dragon species were nothing more than a grim echo of a bygone era. However, the prophecy heralds the return of Alduin, the harbinger of destruction personified as a dragon. As the narrative unfolds, you lock horns with these mighty beasts, devouring their souls and abilities or Shouts, allowing you to slow time, unleash invisible energy blasts, or even conjure a dragon ally. Many of these abilities are discovered in ancient Nordic dungeons, where long-lost words of power lie hidden. THE REFINED MECHANICS AND GAMEPLAY: The game’s progression starts with the birth of your avatar. Amidst ten distinct races, you choose one unencumbered by class constraints. The deeper you dive into the game, the more potent your character becomes. Each new level allows you to bolster one of the three primary statistics: magic, health, or stamina. “Skyrim” introduces a comprehensive rework of the skill system, dividing it into specific groups such as one-handed or two-handed weapons, each brimming with unique abilities and attacks. Notably, the magic system also sees a shuffle, with spells from the Mysticism school reallocated to different groups. A REVOLUTIONIZED COMBAT SYSTEM: The combat in “Skyrim” is a dance of death, a harmonious blend of dynamics and strategy. Each hand of your hero can wield a weapon, a shield, or a spell, leading to a vast array of deadly combinations – a destructive attack in one hand, a gleaming sword in the other. Gone are the days of button mashing; each encounter demands astute movement and a sharp eye for dodging, blocking strikes, and toppling opponents. An ill-timed action could disrupt your hero’s balance, leaving them vulnerable to enemy attacks that are now more lifelike and threatening than ever. To add to the spectacle, your character can execute dramatic finishing moves. IMMERSION INTO A LIVING, BREATHING WORLD: The world of “Skyrim” pulsates with life; every nook and cranny is teeming with bustling inhabitants. Each choice you make carries weight and influences how the world around you reacts. Drop a dagger in the town square, and watch as an NPC returns it to you or, perhaps, swipes it for themselves. Dialogues are reworked to feel more natural, and when not busy saving the world, you can unwind by indulging in many daily activities. The game has everything from farming to blacksmithing, cooking to mining, or even armorsmithing. EXPLORATION AND TECHNOLOGY IN THE GAME: “Skyrim” unveils a vast virtual world ripe for exploration. It has five major cities, hundreds of dungeons, and countless secrets. To aid your inquiry, a fast-travel option has been introduced between locations. An enhanced enemy-level scaling system tailors the game to your character’s progress, making the adventure more personalized and engaging. The improved graphics engine breathes life into the world with dynamic weather, realistic wind simulation, and significant improvements to character appearances and facial animations. The UI elements can be turned off for an unfiltered immersive experience in this virtual world.

name: Burnout Paradise – The Ultimate Box - Ultimate Series
description: Burnout Paradise does not have Game menus. Paradise City is open for players to explore with the start of an event at every intersection. In Showtime mode, players can crash at any location. Credit is earned for licenses and cars in the primary game mode. Five different events exist: Burning Route, Marked Man, etc. Over 80 automobiles are in the game, but if you do not drive carefully, they can receive realistic damage. Environmental harm is another possibility that can help you have a realistic race. The game allows you to take camera-based mugshots because pictures related to the defeat of players are taken. There are add-ons for the game, like the Cagney Pack, the Bikes Pack, and the Party Pack. For the challenging lovers, there are trophies in the PlayStation 3 version when they pass the specific demands. In addition, you should not skip several little enhancements to the game.

name: Dark Souls - Collector’s Edition
description: Dark Souls - Collector’s Edition

name: Street Fighter X Tekken
description: Street Fighter X Tekken combines two fighting game series. It uses Street Fighter mechanics with Tekken characters. The game has a 2D visual style and tag team gameplay. Players can switch characters during fights and combos. Victory comes when one character loses all health. Special attacks use a Cross Gauge. Street Fighter characters use six buttons, while Tekken characters use four. The game introduces Gem and Pandora systems. Gems boost character stats when activated. Pandora’s mode sacrifices one character to strengthen the other. Local and online multiplayer are available. The game focuses on fast-paced action and strategic character switching. Cross Rush, Cross Arts, and Cross Assault are key attack types you should choose depending on the situation and the opponents. Players must manage their Cross Gauge carefully to execute powerful moves. At the same time, the gem system creates curiosity for players because of character customization and strategy.

name: Batman - Arkham Asylum
description: Batman has captured the Joker and returned him to Arkham Asylum. However, the inmates have taken control by Joker, who now runs the facility. Therefore, players take on the role of Batman from the third perspective and navigate through Arkham’s grounds and various wings. Arkham is a super-prison and rehabilitation center for the most dangerous criminals. By combining stealth, detective work, and exciting combat elements, players will apprehend the Joker. Along the way, they encounter some of Batman’s deadliest foes. Fortunately, the hero receives help from surviving guards and information from a computer genius named Oracle. Players utilize an array of gadgets, including the grappling hook and many other weapons. They gain experience points in combat and missions to upgrade Batman’s abilities and arsenal. The game features a controllable camera and an optional first-person view for detailed examinations.

name: Batman - Arkham Origins
description: Batman: Arkham Origins takes place when Bruce Wayne became Batman. The event of this game is related to Black Mask, who hires villains to kill Batman. Therefore, Batman also meets Joker for the first time and starts their destinies. In a large environment, players can explore the whole city to open locations and complete missions. He fights using the free-flow system, which allows quick attacks and combos. When enemies have guns, Batman uses stealth kills to defeat them quickly. Before the fight, our hero can upgrade his abilities and gadgets. Besides the missions, players can do side quests, solve puzzles, and find crime scene investigations. Batman can use the Batwing for fast travel and visit his Batcave.

name: FIFA 18 - Legacy Edition
description: EA SPORTS™ FIFA 18 Legacy Edition* features the latest kits, clubs, and player squads from top leagues around the world. Gameplay features and modes will have parity with FIFA 17 on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. LEGACY MODES The following Game Modes are included in FIFA 18 with the same features and innovations from FIFA 17. Kick Off Career Mode Tournaments – Licensed and Custom Women’s International Cup Skill Games Online Seasons Online Friendlies Be a Pro (Player/Goalkeeper)

name: The Elder Scrolls V - Skyrim - Dragonborn
description: INTRODUCTION Buckle your dragon-scaled armor and gird yourself for an adventure. Yes, we are diving into the world of Dragonborn, the illustrious third expansion for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, a legend in role-playing games that reigned supreme in 2011. Lauded on multiple platforms, including PC, PS3, and X360, this expansion stands tall against its predecessor, Hearthfire. Forget house building and family starting; Dragonborn unveils an extensive universe, unfolding an enthralling narrative, fresh territories, and formidable adversaries. JOURNEY TO THE ICY ISLAND OF SOLSTHEIM Just a dragon’s flight northeast of Skyrim province, you’ll find yourself on the frosty isle of Solstheim, first introduced in the second expansion of The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind in 2003. Despite the passing of two centuries, the resilient inhabitants have clung fiercely to their sovereignty, resisting the influence of various mainland factions that continue to vie for power. ENCOUNTERING THE MYSTERIOUS MIRAAKU Unravel the enigma of Miraaku, a legendary figure who was the first to bear the title that now rests on your shoulders – Dragonborn—Like a treacherous current, time swept him away into the abyss of insanity centuries ago. Possessing abilities akin to yours, this wayward soul used dragons to fulfill his ominous objectives. Your primary quest: thwart the resurgence of this malevolent madman. EXPANSIVE GAMEPLAY ELEMENTS AND ABILITIES There’s more to Dragonborn than an epic narrative and picturesque settings. It expands the gameplay horizon with fresh elements. Among these, the capacity to soar skywards atop a dragon reigns supreme. An exhilarating experience that promises a newfound perspective on the vast, fantastical landscapes. NEW TYPES OF FOES AND EQUIPMENT Get ready to encounter unfamiliar enemies that will test your mettle. It wouldn’t be a proper expansion if it didn’t put your survival instincts to the test. The new arsenals at your disposal are equally intriguing – weapons, powers, and armor. With them, not only do you stand a better chance against the newfound threats, but you’ll also feel the thrill of wielding newfound strength. ENRICHING THE ORIGINAL GAME Dragonborn goes beyond simply adding new elements. It enriches the base game, enhancing the depth and breadth of your role-playing experience. The new narrative, locations, and opponents are weaved seamlessly into the game’s rich tapestry, ensuring that each encounter feels as much a part of the original journey as the base game itself. To conclude, Dragonborn is more than an expansion. It’s a new chapter in the epic saga that Skyrim weaves, inviting you to write your heroic tale. So gear up, warrior! The world is waiting for your story to unfold.

name: The Elder Scrolls V - Skyrim
description: After 200 years of Oblivion, eleven nations are capturing territory in Skyrim through a civil conflict. At the same time, a dragon attacks and creates the chance to make the prisoner get away. Stories about dragons are common, and the ex-prisoner now roams Skyrim. Players are free to explore the action-packed role-playing game Skyrim. In particular, eleven distinct races possess unique traits that players can consider choosing from. Character development is determined by playstyle without classes to satisfy the creativity of players. They can also acquire extra Magicka to enhance every stat and improve skills. Through training or practicing, players will discover the eighteen one, but certain perks require a higher skill level to be unlocked.

name: Far Cry 3
description: Far Cry 3 is an open-world first-person shooter game where you can discover a fictional island in the Pacific. The game combines exploration with role-playing elements when players can earn experience points and craft items. You will control Jason Brody, the main character. During a vacation, he and his friends are captured by pirates, so Jason escapes and joins a native tribe. When searching for his friends, he fights against the pirates in the dangerous world. Players can explore freely and complete various tasks. They can climb radio towers to reveal map sections, while Safe houses allow travel and trading. As the core activities, hunting animals and gathering plants give these resources for crafting and upgrading equipment. Players can also earn skill points to improve the abilities of the protagonist. The game offers different play styles, like stealth, combat, or survival skills. As Jason learns new skills, he gets tattoos on his arm.

name: Batman - Arkham Asylum - Collector’s Edition
description: Batman: Arkham Asylum is a single player, third-person action/adventure in which the Dark Knight is forced to take on his greatest challenge yet when he is trapped by arch rival, the Joker, within Gotham City’s facility for the criminally insane, Arkham Asylum. A blend of exciting arcade style combat and stealth mechanics packed with amazing graphics in a moody, immersive setting, Batman: Arkham Asylum offers diverse gameplay options that push the envelope for all action, adventure and superhero games. ‘Batman: Arkham Asylum’ game logo Batman in hand to hand combat in ‘Batman: Arkham Asylum’ Kick it in combat gameplay. View larger. Batman gliding in on an enemy in ‘Batman: Arkham Asylum’ And stealth action. View larger. The Joker in ‘Batman: Arkham Asylum’ Match wits with The Joker. View larger. The batarang in flight in ‘Batman: Arkham Asylum’ Utilize utility belt gadgets. View larger. The huge Killer Croc in ‘Batman: Arkham Asylum’ Take on dangerous bosses. View larger. Story Batman: Arkham Asylum features an original story penned exclusively for the game by famous Batman author and five-time Emmy award winner, Paul Dini, whose credits include “Lost” season one and “Batman: The Animated Series.” As the game begins Batman is personally delivering his nemesis, The Joker, to the asylum at Arkham Island, but he is uneasy. Although the Arkham asylum is well fortified, he has a nagging feeling that all is not well, which proves to be the case when seconds after turning The Joker over to the guards, the master criminal breaks free of his captors. Even more surprising than this quick turn of events is the revelation that it was never The Joker’s intent to escape the vault-like facility, but instead to trap Batman there. Surrounded by an asylum full of dangerous criminals, many of which he put there and all at the beck and call of the Joker, can Batman survive and discover what is behind the Joker’s intricate plot? Gameplay In Batman: Arkham Asylum players strap on the gadget-heavy utility belt of the Caped Crusader. Gameplay here is a combination of both the knuckle crunching rush of hand to hand combat as you take on the hordes of thugs that infest Arkham Asylum, and stealth gameplay in which you must dispatch individuals from the shadows. Players can expect an engrossing single player campaign in which Batman continually moves forward to face the henchmen, bosses and traps that The Joker has set for him. With regards to opponents, in addition to The Joker who you will hear more than you see, the dark walls of Arkham also hold familiar villains from the the Batman criminal universe including Harley Quinn, Victor Zsasz and Killer Croc, that you will have to deal with, but don’t expect a one-dimensional experience. As players progress from environment to environment within Arkham they will have to use varying combinations of muscle, detective skills, gadgetry and a certain degree of light RPG-like leveling of Batman’s skills, arsenal and physical characteristics to survive and discover what The Joker’s underlying scheme is. In addition to the story-driven single player campaign Arkham Asylum also contains various additional play modes. These include an arcade styled combat mode where players accumulate points by engaging hordes of thugs in a hand to hand slugfest across a series of maps, in which Batman’s physical strength and agility play a major role. The key here is to chain together as many attacks as possible due to the fact that with each successful combo players increase the point multiplier associated with their actions. The game also features a time-based stealth mode where players must hone their ability to strike silently from the shadows. This gameplay, referred to as ‘Invisible Predator’ utilizes the Dark Knight’s skill with gadgets like the grapple tool, batarang and explosives. These allow for vertical/horizontal mobility, the ability to quickly strike from above and at a distance and to take out enemies and create distractions, even through walls. But remember that Batman works solo and is not superhuman. Your enemies will congregate around trouble areas and work as a team against you, so you must be silent, plan your attacks wisely, strike quickly and discover the value of encouraging fear within enemies. Key Features Utilize the unique FreeFlow combat system to chain together unlimited combos seamlessly and battle with huge groups of The Joker’s henchmen in brutal melee brawls. Investigate as Batman, the world’s greatest detective, by solving intricate puzzles with the help of cutting edge forensic tools including x-ray scanning, fingerprint scans, ‘Amido Black’ spray and a pheromone tracker. Face off against Gotham’s greatest villains including The Joker, Harley Quinn, Victor Zsasz and Killer Croc. Become the Invisible Predator with Batman’s fear takedowns and unique vantage point system to move without being seen and hunt enemies. Choose multiple takedown methods, including swooping from the sky and smashing through walls, and use the predator camera get a closer look at the action. Explore every inch of Arkham Asylum and roam freely on the infamous island, presented for the first time ever in its gritty and realistic entirety. Experience what it’s like to be Batman using batarangs, explosive gel aerosol, the Batclaw, sonar resonator and the line launcher. Unlock more secrets by completing hidden challenges in the world and develop and customize equipment by earning experience points. Enjoy complete superhero freedom in the environment with the use of Batman’s grapple to get to any place you can see, jump from any height and glide in any direction.

name: Beyond - Two Souls - Special Edition
description: BEYOND: Two Souls blurs the lines of movie-making and gaming by featuring a brand-new engine, an immersive and evocative story and the best theatrical performances in gaming to date. Special Edition Features: – Premium steel book – Exclusive extra game scene – Game soundtrack – Dynamic themes – Avatar pack – Making Of Featurettes

name: Need for Speed - Undercover
description: Need for Speed: Undercover allows players to become an undercover cop. They must do many things, like infiltrating a crime group. The goal is to reach a leader who has the skills of a fast driver. Therefore, players explore a big city in cars to complete various missions and gain respect. Missions include overcoming races and performing destruction. A new mode is Highway Battle, which allows for outrunning opponents in traffic. In addition, you can find some protection tasks against many targets. With the role of an undercover cop, players can be considered as wanted people. Winning races earns a reputation and money. This unlocks new challenges and city areas. From there, you will approach new cars or upgrades.

name: MotorStorm - Pacific Rift
description: MotorStorm: Pacific Rift is a racing game sequel with the environment set on a tropical island. Players drive various vehicles, like bikes, ATVs, etc. Monster trucks are new to the series and liked the most because they can crush other cars and destroy scenery. Bikers can now duck or jump over obstacles. The tracks are unconventional and have multiple routes. Not all routes suit every vehicle. Tracks wear down during races. This affects vehicle behavior. In particular, small vehicles struggle with vegetation, but big rigs can plow through. Water areas cool engines and change performance. The game offers split-screen play for up to four players. It also had online multiplayer, but servers closed in 2012. The game continues the style of the first MotorStorm. Players will experience many races and pass unique challenges in diverse environments and with vehicle interactions.

name: God of War III
description: Kratos returns in the final chapter of The God of War when riding on Titan Gaia toward Mt. Olympus after Zeus betrayed and killed him. However, Kratos escapes the Underworld and seeks revenge with the help of the Titans. The gameplay remains similar to previous titles. Players control Kratos in hack-and-slash action with button combinations and the quick event to finish enemies. Kratos New weapons like Cestus and Blade of Olympus lead Kratos to extras and modes to complete the story. After that, you can unlock Chaos’s difficulty and the Challenge of Olympus and freely access the special videos and costumes. These extras are available after meeting certain requirements. The game combines intense action and mythological storytelling.

name: Battlefield - Bad Company Gold Edition
description: Battlefield - Bad Company Gold Edition

name: Street Fighter IV
description: Street Fighter IV is the first main game in the series since 1997 and is set between the second and third main series. It features familiar characters and a new visual style. Characters are 3D with a hand-drawn effect. The gameplay is similar to previous games but with new Focus Attacks. They can absorb and counter incoming moves. When their revenge gauge is full, players can also perform ultra combos. In addition, the home version offers online multiplayer and additional content that includes new characters, voice acting, and bonus stages. The game also combines traditional elements with new features to aim to appeal to both longtime fans and newcomers. Therefore, Street Fighter IV blends nostalgia with innovation in the fighting genre.

name: Motorstorm
description: MotorStorm is a fast rally racing game that takes place at a desert festival. Players can drive many vehicles, such as motorcycles and trucks. The game has tough AI opponents to motivate players in skill training. They must finish well to unlock more tracks that have shortcuts, but they change each lap. This feature gives a fresh experience in each race. The best route depends on your vehicle. Online play supports up to 12 players. There are 8 tracks in Monument Valley. Four more tracks can be bought. Tracks vary from sand dunes to rocky canyons, and your driving skills are required. Some tracks favor certain vehicles. Boost is important in MotorStorm when helping players catch up or pull ahead. However, they must watch their boost meter because the hot engine will explode. Sometimes, this explosion can help win a race. However, it doesn’t always work if an opponent is ahead.

name: Mortal Kombat
description: New Mortal Kombat starts from the beginning of the series and the plot. Starting with the first three games, it goes back to the original tournaments. Chapters in the game’s Story mode are based on different characters. Throughout matches, players take on several responsibilities. Through many types of wars, fights help players discover the plot where various choices appear along with playable characters. Simultaneously, arcade modes help players find nostalgia for the older games, besides the Story mode. A new Challenge Tower has been added to the mini-games when 300 tasks await players when they reach the top of this tower. Obstacles might be anything from evading attacks to slaying zombies. In addition, some tasks require you to assume a particular role, such as protecting a movie set while playing Johnny Cage.

name: Need for Speed - The Run - Gold Version
description: Jack Rourke is in trouble when owing money to criminals. Now, they require him to pay this impossible loan. Happily, his friend Sam tells him about an event named The Run. The protagonist will join a big race across America if he wants to receive $25 million. However, this race will be dangerous and challenging when Jack must beat 200 drivers to win. Many factions also have the goal to hinder him in this competition. For gameplay, players race from San Francisco to New York. The game inspires real locations that possess a huge track. The game has quick-time events. There are many cars to choose from, and each of them requires new challenges for players. Cars can be upgraded and customized by changing stats and colors and adding body kits.

name: Uncharted 2 - Among Thieves - Collector's Edition - Collector's Cut
description: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves is the story of Nathan Drake, a fortune-hunter with a shady reputation and an even shadier past who is lured back into the treacherous world of thieves and mercenary treasure-seekers. The Collectors Box contains: 2 Exclusive Art Cards 2 Multiplayer Gold Plated Guns 2 Exclusive Multiplayer Character Skins Exclusive PS3 XMB Theme Comes in Steekbook

name: Metal Gear Solid 4
description: Introduction Unleash the inner spy and flex those strategic muscles with “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” for PS3. This groundbreaking video game history has trapped countless players in its intricate web. First released by Konami in 2008, this stealth-action marvel has left an indelible mark on the gaming world with its engaging narrative, intense gameplay, and unforgettable characters. PLOT Prepare for a whirlwind of espionage, politics, and warfare that would make even James Bond’s head spin. Set in the dystopian future of 2014, “Metal Gear Solid 4” paints a world dominated by private military companies (PMCs) and nano-machine technology. As veteran soldier Solid Snake, players are thrust into a global stage where the line between friend and foe is perpetually blurred. A deadly new threat looms on the horizon — the Guns of the Patriots, an insidious system that threatens to manipulate every soldier on the battlefield. It’s up to Snake to unearth this diabolical weapon’s secrets and end its reign of terror. CHARACTERS The game has a vibrant and diverse cast of characters, including grizzled veterans, relentless villains, and enigmatic allies. The protagonist, Solid Snake, is an elite operative known for his courage, skill, and iconic bandana. Despite suffering from rapid aging due to his clone origins, Snake remains a formidable force on the battlefield. Snake’s allies include Otacon, an eccentric but brilliant scientist, and Sunny, a tech-savvy young girl with an affinity for cooking eggs. On the opposite side are adversaries like Liquid Ocelot, a rogue military commander with a complex history with Snake, and Vamp, an immortal warrior with a penchant for knives. Every character, friend, or foe adds depth to the game’s narrative, creating a rich, immersive gaming experience. GAME FEATURES One can’t delve into the “Metal Gear Solid 4” world without marveling at the game’s standout features. Stealth is a central element in this game. Players are encouraged to sneak, hide, and plan to avoid detection carefully. Then there’s the OctoCamo, a suit that allows Snake to blend into any background, taking the stealth to a new level. Another key feature is the game’s rich arsenal of weapons, which is customizable to match any combat scenario. The game also integrates an emotionally charged psyche gauge, which tracks Snake’s mental and physical health, adding a layer of realism rarely seen in video games. CONCLUSION In conclusion, “Metal Gear Solid 4” offers a spectacular blend of riveting plot, complex characters, and innovative gameplay features, making it an enduring classic in the gaming world. It’s not just a game; it’s an odyssey of action, strategy, and emotion. Just remember, as you stealthily sneak past enemies and brave the darkest corners of the world — don’t forget to laugh at Snake’s silly cardboard box trick or Sunny’s egg-cooking fiasco. After all, even in a dystopian future, there’s always room for a good chuckle. So gear up, brave the battlefield, and most importantly, enjoy the ride!

name: God of War HD
description: God of War blends the alternative Greek myths when you will not find anything familiar. A tormented Spartan named Kratos seeks redemption and serves Olympian gods. After that, he must defeat Ares because of the damage he received. The game mixes 3D action, platforming, and puzzles. Kratos wields the Blades of Chaos for combos. Players collect orbs to upgrade weapons and spells from defeated enemies. Therefore, new abilities will be grown while the story progresses. Various difficulty modes unlock extra content that reveals development insights and cut material. The gameplay balances combat, exploration, and upgrades to fully experience mythological elements with Kratos’ personal journey.

name: Call of Duty - Advanced Warfare
description: Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare is set in the far future when a private military company called Atlas dominates. Players control Jack Mitchell when you can go through the story and locations that Atlas wants to unfold. The game presents the high-tech exosuits that enhance the abilities of users. Therefore, players can do many complex things like double jump, grappling hooks, or becoming invisible. Missions offer different suit types with unique powers, so players can have more chances and stealth options. The upgrade is so important, and its conditions are completing challenges. Various vehicles, like hoverbikes and fighter jets, are available to help players discover more easily. Multiplayer modes include Capture the Flag, Hardpoint, and Momentum. Therefore, anyone can change their strategies and feelings at any time.

name: Spider-Man 3 - Complete Archive
description: Spider-Man 3 will help you relive all the events that happened in the 2007 movie. Players control the hero and continue protecting New York City from villains. Like the previous game, the gameplay still remains, and players will find a larger city to explore with many secrets. The game adds some mini-stories that do not appear in the film. From there, this marks the appearance of the new enemies. The powers of Spider-Man still depend on the suits that he wears. For example, the black symbiote costume makes the hero stronger but more aggressive. With the red and blue suit, he is faster and more liked by the public. For the PS3 version, you will try the new feelings with the motion controls and bonus mini-game with the New Goblin.

name: MotorStorm - Apocalypse
description: MotorStorm: Apocalypse leads players to an earthquake-hit urban area. The game focuses more on the storyline and allows players to race through a festival. Three characters represent the related difficulty levels. During the races, the earthquake sometimes causes chaos and makes falling buildings and explosions. In addition, players can understand the story through cut-scenes. Players will pass through twelve races per character. Boost is important in the races. At the same time, it can be used at unlimited times but can overheat the engine. Water cools the engine, or you can go airborne. The race becomes more interesting when some vehicles have special controls to ram or punch opponents.

description: Resistance Dual Pack

name: Assassin’s Creed IV Black Flag + Assassin’s Creed Rogue Double Pack
description: Assassin’s Creed IV Black Flag + Assassin’s Creed Rogue Double Pack

name: Fighting Edition - Tekken 6 / Tekken Tag Tournament 2 / SoulCalibur V - Classic Cut
description: Fighting Edition: Tekken 6 / Tekken Tag Tournament 2 / SoulCalibur V is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Europe in 2015.

name: Doom 3 BFG Edition - Master Cut
description: The game offers the game for players when they can try the base game and many expansion versions. In this game, many improvements appear, but the gameplay is still related to technology and demons. The story starts on Mars in 2145 with many secret experiments. Players control a marine sent to this planet and face the new enemies you have not seen before. From the first perspective, aiming, shooting, and running are the base moves. Enemies range from zombies to demons. Before entering the dark areas, players must be careful to use a flashlight or weapons. At the same time, they also feel the horror-focused theme and find ways to survive longer.

name: MotorStorm II
description: MotorStorm II

name: Need For Speed - ProStreet
description: The game will introduce more new gameplay, but you will not find the Free Roam mode because Event Map is the replacement solution. Players want to become racing kings through races on tracks that possess many rewards. Like other racing games, players can receive a jukebox and unlock new car models. The game has many changes, such as classic racing modes without cop chases. Players create an alias and choose difficulty settings to improve their skills. To create more challenges, the developer added online multiplayer, and competitions between races will always happen. Therefore, each mode will have its own role, and you should go through the free modes, which allow for unlocking more tracks and cars.

name: Tekken Hybrid
description: “Tekken Hybrid” is a game collection of the Tekken series of game series released by Namco Bandai Games in 2011. It is a Japanese fighting game genre among the characters available in the game. The game has beautiful 3D graphics to help players feel the truth from the characters in the game. “Tekken Hybrid” has a total of 34 characters available that players can choose to participate in matches. The game has single-player mode and multiplayer online game mode. Entering the game, the player can move the character to attack the opponent. The health meter bar is displayed on the screen to help players can easily monitor the status of the character. In the game the player can choose up to 8 battles to play according to the Tekken card rules, the player can allow their fighter to rest to recover health while the player’s character fights with the opponent. If the character participating in the match in the game is defeated, the player can replace a new one to continue fighting. Conversely, if the player’s characters are completely defeated their fighter must continue the game alone.

name: Castlevania - Lords of Shadow Collection
description: Gabriel Belmont learns of a mask with the power to raise the dead and sets out on a mission to obtain it to bring his recently murdered wife back from the dead. Lords of Shadow builds upon the combat systems first explored in this series in 2003’s Lament of Innocence and adds more violent kills to the mix. Inspiration for these changes seems to have come from 2005’s God of War. This remarkable Castlevania: Lords of Shadow Collection combines the award-winning Castlevania: Lords of Shadow, two additional DLC chapters, the complete Castlevania: Lords of Shadow: Mirror of Fate HD adventure, and an exclusive Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2 demo.

name: Need for Speed - Carbon
description: The game has evolved when offering a city-based career mode, a story, and FMV cutscenes. Therefore, players can race in the city and Carbon Canyon to compete. If players win races, they earn money for vehicle improvements. In particular, each enhancement that has its rarity will be unlocked gradually. Forty cars will appear before players, including new muscle cars. Players can form crews and participate in racing challenges. Some versions offer online multiplayer for up to eight players to express their confidence and skills. The city is divided into territories controlled by gangs. For these locations, players should go through many challenges and race with the gang leaders. Boss duels take place in the city and Carbon Canyon, with scores based on proximity.

name: Fallout 3
description: After World War II, technology developed quickly and gave hope to people for a prosperous future. Conflict returned in 2077, so the world was annihilated by nuclear weapons with only vault survivors. Some underwent significant mutations while the globe turned into a nuclear wasteland. After two centuries, people departed from the Vaults to take Earth back. The main character hails from Vault 101, where he was raised in a strict household. Abruptly, his father exits the vault. He must be located by the hero. Along the way, he discovers unspoken realities. One role-playing game is Fallout 3, with 3D shooter components. Features from earlier games are retained but emphasize battle and exploration more. Gamers are free to explore the environment where they can go to places and converse with fictional people. The primary mission is most linear, but it presents moral options in the closing moments. In addition, players can finish side tasks as well.

name: Red Dead Redemption
description: Red Dead Redemption is a western game set in 1911 with the protagonist John Marston. Forced to capture his former gang members, he should explore the open world. Through the long adventure, players can follow the story or engage in various activities. Horses are the main transportation and help you discover towns, characters, and events that populate the world. Random events include animal attacks and ambushes. Hunting, gambling, and duels are available, so guns are the primary weapons. Two morality systems affect the game world. Marston can shoot while riding and use a lasso because of a cover system and the “Dead Eye” targeting enhancing mode. In addition, multiplayer modes support up to 16 players. They can form possessions and level up to unlock new items. The game combines action, exploration, and storytelling in a Western setting.

name: Call of Duty - Black Ops - Complete Edition
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops is the seventh game in the series. It takes place during the Cold War. Players control special forces soldiers in secret missions. The game includes operations in Vietnam, Russia, Cuba, and Laos. The main characters are Alex Mason and Jason Hudson. They investigate a Soviet chemical weapon called Nova-6. The game has multiplayer modes to give players the chance to play online or offline. They can earn XP points to increase their ranks and gain a higher position. There’s also a zombie co-op mode. Players can earn CoD Points and bet them in special matches. Black Ops introduces new features where players can customize their characters more. In some matches, piloting aircraft like helicopters and stealth planes play an important role. The game combines action and strategy, so it offers various gameplay options based on the preferences of players.

name: Beyond the Future - Fix the Time Arrows - Ultimate Pack
description: Beyond the Future - Fix the Time Arrows - Ultimate Pack

name: Battlefield - Bad Company
description: First-person shooter with a war theme is called Battlefield: Bad Company. It centers on a gang of rebels within the unit of the 222nd Army. The group chooses to break away and go after their own objectives. The imaginary Middle Eastern nations provide the game setting. Preston Marlowe is controlled by the players, who collaborate with his team. He can recover health by using a health injector, and after dying, he instantly respawns. Up to four weapons may be carried and free for players to be used. In particular, you can operate or drive numerous vehicles to move quickly in the game. The backstories and motivations of the characters are revealed through the plot and the challenge you should discover. Large-scale environmental damage is possible using the Frostbite DX engine, which influences the use of cover. A rating system with unlocked weapons and gear is part of the multiplayer experience. Gold Rush is one of the basic modes, and through exclusive events, players can obtain five new weapons.

name: Uncharted 3 - Drake’s Deception
description: Drake’s Deception is the third Uncharted game. It follows Nathan Drake, an adventurer. Sully is his loyal friend. The story shows Nathan’s youth and modern times. A new melee combat system is introduced. Players can kick and evade enemy attacks. Quick-time events are used in combat. The game searches for the lost city Iram. The adventure spans diverse environments in many locations, including England, France, Syria, and a large desert. The gameplay is similar to the previous version. Climbing and shooting are still important. Cinematics blend seamlessly with gameplay. Stealth is now encouraged. Players can collect artifacts for trophies. Puzzles require manipulating items and using Drake’s notebook. Hints appear if players struggle to help Drake pass new challenges and mysteries. The game has 22 story chapters and balances action, puzzle-solving, and exploration. Multiplayer modes are included.

name: Uncharted - Drake’s Fortune
description: Nathan Drake is a treasure hunter and believes his relation to Sir Francis Drake. One day, Nathan finds the coffin of his ancestor and an old diary. From there, he and his friends search for El Dorado, the legendary city of gold. They explore the ruins of a Spanish colony and fight pirates who want El Dorado’s riches. The game has shooting and exciting escapes besides the exploration of lush islands and the driving vehicles through firefights. In the underground, they also investigate when evading traps and pitfalls. The story reveals what happened to the Spanish colonists long ago. Players must use cover during intense shootouts. They perform dangerous stunts and navigate treacherous environments. The game combines action and exploration skillfully. Players uncover mysteries while fighting enemies and overcoming obstacles. Therefore, the adventure takes them through various exotic locations and challenging situations.

name: Super Street Fighter IV - Arcade Edition
description: Super Street Fighter IV - Arcade Edition

name: Resident Evil 6 Anthology
description: Resident Evil: Director’s Cut is related to the original game when being a slight remix. The game offers three modes, with the original mode unchanged. For the newbie, the game gives more ammo and health attached with auto-targeting. From there, arrange mode will be opened, where you can find the new outfits, camera angles, and key items. These changes challenge veteran players. The default pistol is now chromed and stronger. The game still has an uncut opening video and shows more graphic content. Overall, the game aims to surprise players and offer new experiences with the changed and unchanged elements.

name: Borderlands
description: Pandora is a desert planet full of bandits and treasure hunters. They’re all after a legendary vault with amazing riches. Borderlands mixes shooting and role-playing when players freely choose from four characters with special skills. Through the gameplay, you level up and have conditions to upgrade skills and stats. You kill bad guys and do quests to gain experience and receive weapons and useful stuff as rewards. Possessing the RPG elements, these items have different qualities and features. Characters can grow up to level 50. You can upgrade your skills based on your playstyle. The world is dangerous but full of rewards for brave explorers through a lot of loot to collect.

name: Killzone HD
description: The game is a remastered version of the same-name game. Therefore, you will find many improvements, like better graphics, sound, and optimized features. The story follows colonists who mutated and became hostile. They are about to attack a planet related to their former allies. In addition, players can choose from four characters with unique abilities to enter FPS gameplay. You should learn about their strengths and weaknesses. It had multiplayer modes, but the servers were not available this time. The original colonists formed an empire and launched an invasion. The defenders are trying to repel the attack. With the sci-fi theme, the game allows for space exploration and planetary colonization. Therefore, players can switch between different playstyles through character selection.

name: Batman - Arkham City - Collector’s Edition - Reloaded Cut
description: Developed by Rocksteady Studios, Batman: Arkham City builds upon the intense, atmospheric foundation of Batman: Arkham Asylum, sending players soaring into Arkham City, the new maximum security home for all of Gotham Citys thugs, gangsters and insane criminal masterminds. Set inside the heavily fortified walls of a sprawling district in the heart of Gotham City, this highly anticipated sequel introduces a brand-new story that draws together a new all-star cast of classic characters and murderous villains from the Batman universe, as well as a vast range of new and enhanced gameplay features to deliver the ultimate experience as the Dark Knight. Batman: Arkham City is third-person Action-Adventure game that delivers an authentic Dark Knight experience rooted in an original and engrossing story as well as a combination of melee combat, stealth, investigative and speed-based challenge gameplay. A sequel to 2009’s Batman: Arkham Asylum, Arkham City features the full range of classic enemies seen in the previous game, in addition to Catwoman, who is a playable character and has her own storyline in the new release. Additional features include: a range of new gadgets, an increased number of possible melee opponents and a range of movement options for Batman that include leaping, sliding, gliding and the grapple hook. In addition to the game on Blu-ray disc, the Batman: Arkham City Collector’s Edition contains a wealth of exclusive items fit for collectors and fans alike. See the complete list of these items below.
