Batman: Arkham City on Blu-ray disc for PlayStation 3 Custom Batman statue produced by Kotobukiya Collectible art book Early access to the Iceberg Lounge Challenge Map and Batman: The Dark Knight Returns skin Batman: Arkham City album from WaterTower Music including original songs by hit artists, available via digital redemption Bonus DC Universe animated original movie, Batman: Gotham Knight Key Game Features Become the Dark Knight – Batman: Arkham City delivers a genuinely authentic Batman experience with advanced, compelling gameplay on every level: high-impact street brawls, nail-biting stealth, multifaceted forensic investigation, epic super-villain encounters and unexpected glimpses into Batman’s tortured psychology. Play as Catwoman – Catwoman is a fully playable character in Batman: Arkham City who has her own storyline in the main game which is seamlessly interwoven with Batman’s story arc. Her navigation skills, combat moves and gadgetry have been specifically designed to deliver a fully featured and unique experience. Advanced FreeFlow Combat – Batman faces highly coordinated, simultaneous attacks from every direction as Arkham’s gangs bring heavy weapons and all-new AI to the fight, but Batman steps it up with twice the number of combat animations and double the range of attacks, counters and takedowns. New Gadgets – Batman has access to new gadgets such as the Cryptographic Sequencer V2 and Smoke Pellets, as well as new functionality for existing gadgets that expand the range of Batman’s abilities without adding extra weight to his Utility Belt. New Story – Five-time Emmy-Award-winner Paul Dini returns to pen a brand-new story for Batman: Arkham City, taking gamers deep inside the diseased heart of Gotham. Arkham Has Moved – Following the closure of Arkham Asylum and Blackgate prison, Gotham’s new mayor, Quincy Sharp ordered the relocation of all inmates to Arkham City – a sprawling new super-prison five times bigger than Arkham Island, enclosing a wide variety of industrial districts, iconic locations and Gotham landmarks. Huge Cast of Characters – Players encounter numerous characters from the Batman universe, including Catwoman, Two-Face, Harley Quinn, Penguin, Hugo Strange, Victor Zsasz, Calendar Man, The Joker, The Riddler and other iconic characters yet to be revealed. Featured VO Talent – Mark Hamill and Kevin Conroy reprise their roles as The Joker and Batman respectively.

name: World Series of Poker 2008 - Battle for the Bracelets - Ultimate Archive
description: Players join the World of Poker and join many main events. Sometimes, they want to reach the best title of this game. A famous poker star leads the game with 32 other pros. Two commentators return to provide their insights. The game supports various poker styles in all games, so players become the custom creators for their experiences. Interactive tutorials are available to help the newbie receive important information from famous people. Therefore, in the beginning, players can compete against others online or learn from tutorials based on their skills. The event attracts many skilled professionals and offers multiple ways to participate. Overall, this game is suitable for many player types.

name: Castlevania Lords of Shadow 2 - Revelations
description: Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2 returns in an epic adventure set in an open, modern day world. Fans of the series will play as Dracula for the very first time and uncover the shocking secrets behind the “Lords of Shadow” saga! Revelations (Story of Alucard in the Japanese version) is the first downloadable content (DLC) for Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2. It was released on March 25th, 2014. Players control Alucard and discover what happened to him during Dracula’s final hours of sleep.

name: Need for Speed - Most Wanted
description: Need for Speed: Most Wanted takes place in Fairhaven City, where players can explore as they wish and race aggressively. The main resource is SpeedPoints, which helps you upgrade vehicles and climb the Most Wanted List. Without storylines, players only focus on becoming the top racer. Races include Sprint, Circuit, and Speed Runs. At the same time, police pursuits add excitement and challenge to every racer. Players can find and swap cars throughout the city. Almost all vehicles are available from the start, and through time, you will find more unlocks. Multiplayer is available, and this mode helps players express their skills and their car’s beauty. Therefore, they will always go to repair shops that offer vehicle maintenance and customization.

name: Tomb Raider
description: A young archaeologist travels with a crew to find an ancient Japanese kingdom, but they sail into a dangerous area. Besides the warning dangers, a storm strands them on an island. To survive, the protagonist must find the crew by exploring the island. She fights against a mysterious cult if it is necessary. This new version focuses more on action sequences and combat than previous entries. Puzzles are simplified, and exploration is limited to interconnected hubs. The player explores the island linearly through various areas. Therefore, they will be careful when climbing, using tools, and navigating different terrains. Campsites serve as checkpoints and upgrade locations to prepare before the journey. Health regenerates automatically when in cover, and players can continue to face the dangers.

name: Metal Gear Solid HD Collection
description: All three games in the Metal Gear Solid HD Collection have been updated. Peace Walker, Metal Gear Solid 2, and Metal Gear Solid 3 are the games of choice here. There are new achievements and better graphics. But the mechanics are the same. Peace Walker retains the multiplayer mode. Mission and Mother Base are two primary styles of play, with action segments in the first mode and the managed army in the second one. At the same time, a picker screen allows players to choose missions with both available Main Ops and Extra Ops. Therefore, you have to play the first mode because of its story-based features and interactive cutscenes. Optional Extra Ops have a range of objectives. The goals appear from document retrieval to target practice to make the missions more diverse. In this set, you’ll find the style of the series that combines strategic management with stealth action.

name: Uncharted 2 - Among Thieves
description: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves is a sequel to Uncharted: Drake’s Fortune. The game follows Nathan Drake in searching for the lost fleet of Marco Polo. He hopes to find a great treasure. The gameplay is similar to the first game, but it includes new features. There are stealth segments and improved climbing mechanics. Drake often works alone, but sometimes he has companions. The game has puzzles to solve and various locations to explore. Multiplayer modes are new to the series. They include competitive and cooperative play. Players can team up or compete against each other. The PS4 release only has a single-player mode, but it adds a photo mode. This mode allows players to pause and create photos from the game.

name: Battlefield 4
description: Battlefield 4 is a military shooter set in the near future when, continuing the story of the previous version. The game focuses on multiplayer mode with four signature roles. Therefore, you can find suitable roles through their unique abilities and gadgets. Their potential can be upgraded when passing many matches and challenges. Team-based modes provide Conquest and Rush, which are the most popular games to play. In addition, maps are large with vehicles but can be changed significantly. Many modes of the previous version still remain and are attached to the new ones. Overall, the gameplay becomes more diverse and allows for freely choosing based on the like.

name: Call of Duty 3
description: The game focuses on the fight in Normandy, France, during World War II. Players control allied soldiers from four nations to complete the mission in the campaign mode. At the same time, the game is around real events, like 88 days before Paris’ liberation. You can use the environment or destroy it if it is necessary. Cinematics explain events between missions to help understand the historical events. Enemies work together and use tactics. In addition, you can join the deathmatch and team-based games with your friend or compete against other opponents. The game also provides multiple classes with unique abilities. Therefore, you can build teams that match in power and strategy.

name: Dark Souls II - Webhallen Edition
description: The Webhallem Edition of Dark Souls II comes in a numbered bag and metal case and includes the following content: Limited Dark Souls Hood 30cm tall Warrior Knight Figurine Limited Ring in a pouch and engraved text “Go Beyond Death” Official Soundtrack CD Autenthic Cloth Game Map Collectible hardbound artbook This edition is limited to only 740 pieces. This edition is available only through webhallen.com website.

name: Uncharted 3 - Drake's Deception - Game of the Year Edition
description: In addition to Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception, this also includes: - Multiplayer maps (Graveyard, Old Quarter, London Streets, Oasis) - "Flashback maps" which are 8 remade maps from versions 1 and 2 - 25 multiplayer skins, and Killzone 3 skins - Fort Co-Op (this happens in the fortress from 'Drake's Fortune') - Rogue skins pack (from 14 enemies)

name: Resident Evil HD Remaster
description: Resident Evil HD Remaster

name: Tomb Raider - Underworld
description: Tomb Raider: Underworld continues the journey of Lara, who searches for her mother. The game extends the plot of the previous versions by adding global locations. The game explores monomyth and Norse mythology. Through the gameplay, the heroine should focus on exploring and solving puzzles to progress. Lara has new moves to go through many locations. A sonar map helps with orientation and hints. The game has no QTE events, but time slows in critical moments. Players keep full control of Lara. Level design is more non-linear, so you can freely discover locations like the Arctic, Thailand, and the Mediterranean Sea. Climbing and riddles are important parts of gameplay. The game builds on previous entries but adds new elements.

name: Hunted - The Demon’s Forge
description: The elven woman and human warrior have all been mercenaries and partners for a long time. In many missions, they see many dark visions and go through an epic fight to save the world. The game focuses on the co-op gameplay, so the heroes must work together. You can play many roles with your friends, such as melee combat or archer. In addition, your positions will not be fixed when you can switch them at any time. This creates many chances for many strategies. At the same time, all characters use abilities directly, which are learned and upgraded with crystals. Overall, the game features some co-op puzzles and requires teamwork to progress in powers.

name: Borderlands - Game of the Year Edition
description: Lock, Load, & Face the Madness! Get ready for the mind-blowing insanity, as one of four trigger-happy mercenaries, taking out everything that stands in your way. With its addictive action, frantic first person shooter combat, massive arsenal of weaponry, RPG elements and four-player co-op, Borderlands is the breakthrough experience that challenges all the conventions of modern shooters. Borderlands places you in the role of a mercenary on the lawless and desolate planet of Pandora, hell bent on finding a legendary stockpile of powerful alien technology known as The Vault.

name: Gran Turismo 5
description: Gran Turismo 5 is a racing game and the sixth in the series that has heritage elements. Besides the nostalgia, the game has many new features. Players can choose from over 1,000 cars to form a favorite collection because each of them has detailed interiors. The game includes famous brands like Ferrari and Lamborghini. There are more than 20 tracks, and sometimes, players can join special events. They include NASCAR and kart racing. In addition, in A-Spec mode, players race in different events. B-Spec lets players be crew chiefs. The game has improved graphics and physics. Cars can show damage and wear. Weather changes during races to change your feelings. Players can upgrade their cars. The game offers a rich racing experience.

name: Far Cry 2
description: In an African country, a civil war comes from two main factions for control. As a mercenary, players find and eliminate the dangerous team. A vast 50 square kilometer area allows for exploring freely. Missions for various factions help gain reputation and diamonds to buy everything. Safe houses become the place you should go back to because of their usefulness. Other mercenaries offer assistance if helped, enhancing missions or providing tips. The player must balance fighting factions by finding The Jackal and managing malaria symptoms. Available multiplayer modes include team-based and capture-point battles with up to 16 players, so you can play with your friends. To make the experience more diverse and creative, the game features different classes and weapon loadouts for multiplayer.

name: Call of Duty - Ghosts
description: The game takes place around a conflict between two factions that have been fighting for a decade. Therefore, many cities are destroyed. To stop this situation, players control various characters and follow a US special forces team. Their mission is to find a brainwashed member after he has been captured. The game also features a large multiplayer portion with various modes. Standard modes like free-for-all and team deathmatch are so familiar to many FPS lovers. For some new things, you can find Blitz, where players must reach portals at the enemy spawn point to score. Therefore, players can try many missions in a campaign or play with other players in multiplayer modes.

name: Shin Koihime Musou - Otome Taisen * Sangokushi Engi - Platinum Release
description: Shin Koihime Musou - Otome Taisen * Sangokushi Engi - Platinum Release

name: Tekken 6 - Titan Collection
description: After the tournament win, Jin Kazama took over Mishima Zaibatsu. From there, he became a tyrant and started wars. Lars Alexandersson wants to end this situation. Gameplay allows players to choose characters for the tournament and win the opponents as much as possible. At the same time, the winning condition is knocking out the others or time-out. The gameplay is similar to previous versions but adds some enhancements. Six new characters join the roster to complete the story mode. Players can also fight online with human opponents to ensure the rank of their powers. When you pass many matches, characters compete in the King of Iron Fist tournament.

name: Ultra Street Fighter IV
description: INTRODUCTION Rising from the ashes of its predecessors like the Phoenix of legend, Ultra Street Fighter IV dons the mantle as the third upgraded incarnation of the iconic Street Fighter IV, the latest gem in a long-revered fighting game series that debuted in 1987. The Japanese trailblazer, Capcom, unimpressed with the offerings of Super SF IV and Arcade editions, decided to take a stab at perfection. Thus, Ultra Street Fighter IV was born, teeming with 44 warriors, resplendent in every costume ever released for the beloved game. BALANCING THE BATTLEFIELD The game’s architects at Capcom sought not to rewrite the rulebook, but to fine-tune it, turning a deaf ear to radical overhauls and listening intently to the voice of the gamers. Implementing nuanced gameplay balance changes, they crafted a battlefield that elevates the thrilling combat dance between two fighters to new heights of pleasure. The gamers have six fresh stages of unleashing havoc: Pit Stop 109, Mad Gear Hideout, Cosmic Elevator, Blast Furnace, Half Pipe, and the prehistoric wonderland Jurassic Era Research Facility. A SMORGASBORD OF GAMING MODES Undoubtedly, Ultra Street Fighter IV is a game that caters to all. With a diverse array of game modes, the experience is tailored to fit any gamer’s preference, whether solo or in the company of local or global compatriots. The icing on the cake, the game teases its most devoted fanbase with new, meticulously crafted challenges, cementing its status as a fan favorite. AN EXPANDED ROSTER OF FAMILIAR FACES In a nod to the series’ diehard fans, five characters from the Arcade Edition were added to the 39-strong roster. Players can now step into the oversized boots of Hugo, a towering wrestling behemoth, or wield the disciplined might of Rolento, an American soldier with German roots. The women’s corner sees the entrance of the pink-haired law enforcement officer, Poison, and Kenya’s very own princess, Elena. RETAINING THE CLASSIC VISUAL AESTHETIC Staying true to its roots, Ultra Street Fighter IV maintains its classic, cartoon-like visual aesthetics achieved through the innovative use of cel-shading technology. This artistic choice ensures the game’s graphics retain their youthful charm despite the passage of time. The game, although featuring 3D environments and characters, is true to its genre and sets its clashes on a 2D plane, serving an intense visual cocktail to the players. TWO PURCHASING PATHS TO PERFECTION Ultra Street Fighter IV offers two purchasing options to its player base, fulfilling its commitment to inclusivity. As a standalone game, it delivers a full-fledged version teeming with content. But it presents as a DLC expansion for those who already own Street Fighter IV or the Arcade Edition. As a bonus, the standalone version shows its buyers a comprehensive collection of all ever-released costumes, previously available only as paid DLC. With such flexibility, it’s no wonder the game continues to reign supreme in the hearts of gamers worldwide.

name: Far Cry 3 & Far Cry 4 - Double Pack
description: Dive into the wild world of Far Cry with this double package including Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4.

name: Far Cry 3 & Far Cry 4 - Double Pack - Reloaded Cut
description: Dive into the wild world of Far Cry with this double package including Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4.

name: Dead Space 3 - Awakened - Gold Bundle
description: Dead Space 3 - Awakened - Gold Bundle

name: Mass Effect
description: INTRODUCTION Revolutionizing the RPG landscape with its dynamic elements of action, Mass Effect on PS3 emerges as an elaborate brainchild of the esteemed BioWare, the brilliant minds behind notable titles such as Baldur’s Gate, Neverwinter Nights, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic. Marking the inception of a trilogy, this gaming spectacle delves into an intricate universe brimming with action, alliances, and alien civilizations. ENGAGING PLOTLINE WITH MEANINGFUL CONSEQUENCES Unfolding in the year 2183, the narrative of Mass Effect catapults players into a universe where humanity treads a path peppered with cooperation and conflicts and ceaselessly strives for dominance amidst alien civilizations. Gamers step into the boots of Commander Shepard, humanity’s first Spectre and a dedicated harbinger of peace. His colossal mission? Thwart the nefarious plans of Saren, a renegade operative with a vengeful grudge against the human race. Shepard and his team embark on a thrilling expedition across uncharted worlds, only to uncover threats far more dire than initially anticipated. A VIBRANT UNIVERSE OF DISCOVERY AND STRATEGY Beyond the captivating narrative with its impactful choices that shape the fate of an entire galaxy, Mass Effect also excels at offering explorative gameplay. Players unveil lost civilizations, encounter fascinating life forms, procure vital resources, and unlock potent technologies. The game’s strategic depth is further amplified with a team command system that transforms battles into tactical contests. As the leader of a three-member team, Shepard exercises the power to direct his comrades, strengthening them over time by channeling experience points into specific skills. THE MAKO AND THE STARS BEYOND Mass Effect enhances its interstellar allure by arming players with their starships. This formidable vessel serves as a ticket to cosmic exploration across myriad planets. But the thrill doesn’t stop there; including Mako, a robust combat vehicle, enriches ground-based movements and conflicts. Whether soaring through the cosmos or navigating the challenges of alien terrains, the game ensures that adrenaline never leaves the side of its players. THE ESSENCE OF EQUIPMENT MANAGEMENT While captivating plots and stellar explorations contribute significantly to the game’s appeal, the importance of equipment management in Mass Effect cannot be overstated. Players must thoughtfully allocate time to carefully select their gear, comprising armor, weapons, accessories, and more. The balance between offense and defense, aggression and caution, firepower and resilience hinges on the player’s ability to choose wisely and gear appropriately. DIALOGUE SYSTEM THAT BREATHES LIFE INTO CHARACTERS Finally, one of the crowning glories of Mass Effect is the lifelike Non-Player Characters (NPCs) dotting the universe. Thanks to the comprehensive dialogue system crafted by BioWare, interactions with these characters feel more like intricate conversations rather than transactional exchanges. These engagements, rich in depth and personality, make the universe feel alive and responsive, further immersing players into the vast, captivating cosmos of Mass Effect.

name: Far Cry 3 - Blood Dragon
description: After a nuclear war, the Earth is recovering its damage. The US government is trying to create peace with some countries. Therefore, a Commando has the mission to investigate a remote island. From there, he receives information related to the powers of Colonel Sloan. Sloan has gained powers from mutant dragon blood, so the protagonist should stop the plans and build a cyborg army. Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon gets the futuristic theme in a post-apocalyptic world. In particular, the game combines action with the open world where players can explore a vast island and complete side quests. The protagonist levels up automatically when reaching enough experiences.

name: Grand Theft Auto - San Andreas
description: “Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas” is an action-adventure video game series developed by Rockstar North. This is a prominent game released in 2004 by Rockstar Games. The game revolves around the protagonist Carl “CJ” Johnson, a member of the American gang who fights with other gangs for territory. “Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas” is played with a third perspective, in the game the player can freely interact with the game world. With gameplay similar to the previous games in the series, players can control the character moving around the city to do missions. Characters have skills such as swimming, running, walking, climbing as well as the skills to use weapons and drive to fight with competitors. Players can control the vehicles on the way by stealing them. When not on duty, players are free to move around the city to cause havoc and attack the people. Players can be arrested by the police if they cannot escape in time. It is the 2004 best-selling game of its novel gameplay with over 27.5 million copies sold.

name: Ni no Kuni – Shiroki Seihai no Joou – All in One Edition
description: Ni no Kuni – Shiroki Seihai no Joou – All in One Edition

name: Dead Space 2 (Collector’s Edition) - Enhanced Cut
description: This Collector’s Edition comes packed with bonus materials for hardcore Dead Space fans. Highlighted is a replica of Issac’s Plasma Cutter gun from the game, complete with trigger-activated LED lights. Also included are a voucher to download Issac’s Unitology Suit and Force Gun, the game’s original soundtrack on CD, and a Necromorph concept art lithograph. the PlayStation 3 version also includes the critically acclaimed Dead Space Extraction with PlayStation Move compatibility

name: Resident Evil - Revelations
description: The game gives players action elements with horror feelings. Terrorists destroyed a sea-based city, and players will follow Jill Valentine and Chris Redfield. Through exploration, you can face many horror survival situations. Players must manage resources and solve puzzles in the vast environment that will attract them with many secrets ahead. At the same time, enemies appear in smaller numbers and confined spaces, but you should be careful to act based on the current weapons. Some chapters are more action-oriented, and the locations include classic monsters and offer more ammunition. The game balances horror and action, providing a varied experience for players. Overall, the mystery surrounding Queen Zenobia and the terrorist attack will be discovered.

name: God of War - Ascension
description: God of War: Ascension still follows Kratos, a son of Zeus, in the alternative legends. Kratos breaks his oath with Ares after being tricked into fighting and escaping imprisonment. At the same time, the game remains gameplay like the previous versions. The protagonist has his Blades of Chaos attached with new weapons and learns four magical disciplines. In this game, players can join online multiplayer for the first time. Players can face one of four gods before battles to receive new abilities. Through the quest, levels and new items will appear and become the goal for everyone. In addition, four multiplayer modes in the game include Team Favor of the Gods and Capture the Flag.

name: Sleeping Dogs
description: Sleeping Dogs is an action game set in Hong Kong, which is considered a crime world. Players control Wei Shen, a police officer infiltrating the Triads, to find the truth of the underworld. He reconnects with old friends and works for the organization. The game has missions and open-world exploration. Players earn experience points for different actions. These unlock upgrades through a skill tree to upgrade the skills and defeat many enemies. The city is full of activities like racing, gambling, and karaoke. The game has elements similar to those of Grand Theft Auto. Therefore, Shen can interact with citizens and their routines. He can also perform various athletic moves while on foot. The game combines story missions with free exploration to help them choose their path based on their preference in the environment, which is detailed and interactive.

name: Batman - Arkham City - Collector’s Edition
description: Developed by Rocksteady Studios, Batman: Arkham City builds upon the intense, atmospheric foundation of Batman: Arkham Asylum, sending players soaring into Arkham City, the new maximum security home for all of Gotham Citys thugs, gangsters and insane criminal masterminds. Set inside the heavily fortified walls of a sprawling district in the heart of Gotham City, this highly anticipated sequel introduces a brand-new story that draws together a new all-star cast of classic characters and murderous villains from the Batman universe, as well as a vast range of new and enhanced gameplay features to deliver the ultimate experience as the Dark Knight. Batman: Arkham City is third-person Action-Adventure game that delivers an authentic Dark Knight experience rooted in an original and engrossing story as well as a combination of melee combat, stealth, investigative and speed-based challenge gameplay. A sequel to 2009’s Batman: Arkham Asylum, Arkham City features the full range of classic enemies seen in the previous game, in addition to Catwoman, who is a playable character and has her own storyline in the new release. Additional features include: a range of new gadgets, an increased number of possible melee opponents and a range of movement options for Batman that include leaping, sliding, gliding and the grapple hook. In addition to the game on Blu-ray disc, the Batman: Arkham City Collector’s Edition contains a wealth of exclusive items fit for collectors and fans alike. See the complete list of these items below. Featured VO Talent – Mark Hamill and Kevin Conroy reprise their roles as The Joker and Batman respectively.

name: Battlefield - Bad Company 2
description: The story of B-Company is continued in Battlefield: Bad Company 2. The group is tasked with securing a hoax gadget. General Braidwood requires them to stop Aurora. Private Preston Marlowe is the focus of the game. He solves puzzles regarding Aurora. To finish objectives, the player employs various weapons and locates new weaponry to unlock them. Up to 32 players can participate in the multiplayer modes. Squad-Rush, Squad-Deathmatch, etc., are the game modes to attract players. Four classes are available to players: Assault, Engineer, etc. Every class has its own special tools and weaponry. By defeating opponents and accomplishing tasks, players can get experience points. They raise the rank and enable new gear.

name: Super Street Fighter IV
description: Super Street Fighter IV updates the original game. It was planned as DLC but became a full game. New online modes are available. Team Battle allows up to eight players, or Replay Channel lets you watch and save replays. In particular, Endless Battle features rotating opponents and Bonus stages from Final Fight and Street Fighter II return. Original game owners can import costume DLC with two free packs if they have previous DLC. All 25 characters get a new third costume because the game offers more variety and features. Players can enjoy new modes and characters to make fans find familiar elements and fresh content. At the same time, the lower price makes it accessible to more players. Overall, Super Street Fighter IV enhances the fighting game experience.

name: SoulCalibur IV
description: The tale of Soul Edge and Soul Calibur continues when they seek to bring back a legendary ruler. Players need to thwart this terrible scheme. With improvements, the game offers 3D blade fighting gameplay, and destructible armor from the first game is back. The new Soul Gauge gauges the degree of defense, and Critical Finish moves come from Soul Crush. In particular, most of the usual cast returns but only on consoles are Yoda and Darth Vader. The two new characters are Hilde and Algol, so there are five extra characters in all. Conventional modes are still available, but Tower of Lost Souls replaces Chronicles of the Sword. Regular and unique varieties exist for the Versus mode. With ranked and unranked matches, online play helps characters experience thrilling battles and make gear stronger.

name: Taiheiyou no Arashi - Senkan Yamato, Akatsuki ni Shutsugeki su! - Gold Release
description: Taiheiyou no Arashi - Senkan Yamato, Akatsuki ni Shutsugeki su! - Gold Release

The game, although featuring 3D environments and characters, is true to its genre and sets its clashes on a 2D plane, serving an intense visual cocktail to the players. TWO PURCHASING PATHS TO PERFECTION Ultra Street Fighter IV offers two purchasing options to its player base, fulfilling its commitment to inclusivity. As a standalone game, it delivers a full-fledged version teeming with content. But it presents as a DLC expansion for those who already own Street Fighter IV or the Arcade Edition. As a bonus, the standalone version shows its buyers a comprehensive collection of all ever-released costumes, previously available only as paid DLC. With such flexibility, it’s no wonder the game continues to reign supreme in the hearts of gamers worldwide.

name: Gran Turismo 6
description: Gran Turismo 6 is the sixth game in the series that possesses new physics for tires and suspension. The game offers many tracks and cars. Therefore, players can enjoy special events like Vision GT and have a great time in the races. This feature includes futuristic car concepts to satisfy players’ curiosity. Players can even drive on the moon. The game has various new circuits. Some tracks have changing weather and time to give a new feeling. The night sky is accurate. Players can drive at Hadley Rille on the moon. The Top Gear track is not in this game. It’s now in a different racing series. The game has many features and options. Players can explore different locations and try various vehicles. The game provides a realistic driving experience by combining simulation with fun elements.

name: Tekken Tag Tournament 2
description: Ladies and Gentlemen, gather as we embark on a triumphant journey through a digital wonderland of epic battles, fierce fighters, and deft maneuvers. Enter the thrilling world of Tekken Tag Tournament 2, a masterpiece crafted by Bandai Namco for PS3, X360, and WiiU. Diving into the heart of this renowned subseries, we experience bouts of multiple contenders enriched by a tagging mechanism that opens up fresh tactical opportunities and alters the dynamics of each encounter. This extraordinary tournament first sprang to life in 1999, and now, its successor continues the legacy. CELEBRATING THE PLOT AND MECHANICS Immerse yourself in the grandeur of Tekken Tag Tournament 2 as it weaves non-canonical narratives featuring your favorite Tekken stalwarts. While the game revolves predominantly around intense tag-team combat, it doesn’t neglect its characters’ intricate backstories and aspirations. With a roster boasting over fifty fighters from various Tekken sagas, the opportunities to devise your perfect tag team are infinite. MASTERING THE ART OF TAGGING Our much-lauded game takes the art of switching between fighters and elevates it to a new level. The battleground brims with stunning throws involving both of your chosen fighters, intricate and secret combos, and many other techniques, many of which have been lovingly adopted from the acclaimed Tekken 6. Don’t blink; you might miss a tagging maneuver that could alter the fight’s outcome! EXPLORING INTERACTIVE ARENAS The thrill of battle intensifies as you step into the diverse arenas of Tekken Tag Tournament 2. Not only do these venues provide a visually stunning backdrop to your fight, but they also introduce interactive elements that can swing the tide of the match. That wall in the corner? It’s not just for show – bash your opponent’s head against it for a satisfying stun! DIVERSITY OF GAME MODES Tekken Tag Tournament 2 ensures you’ll never tire of the fight by offering a generous selection of game modes. Whether you’re a novice seeking tutorials, a warrior yearning for training matches, or a competitor hungry for the Arcade or Versus mode, the game has something for you. Battle it out in 2 vs. 2, 1 vs. 1, or 2 vs. 1 fights, testing your skills against AI or your friends in online and local multiplayer settings. TAILORING YOUR FIGHTERS’ LOOK AND WEAPONRY Step into the stylist’s seat and customize your fighter’s look or handpick their arsenal. Tekken Tag Tournament 2 offers the joy of personalizing each character’s appearance and equipping them with weapons of your choice to enhance their effectiveness. Remember, style matters, and nothing beats delivering a knockout punch in a bespoke outfit! So, dear reader, are you ready to dive into the thrilling world of Tekken Tag Tournament 2? Prepare to feel the adrenaline, the thrill, and the satisfaction as you immerse yourself in this mesmerizing universe of tag-team combat. Strap in, pick your fighters, and let the tournament commence!

name: Infamous 2
description: Cole MacGrath faces The Beast in inFAMOUS 2. He escapes to New Marais with Zeke and Lucy while they plan to defeat the enemies with a special device. In particular, Cole remains the old power and continues unlocking the new ones to defeat the Beast. Based on your choices, the future will change in a good or bad way. In particular, Good or evil choices affect his karma and available powers. Side missions involve helping citizens or causing chaos. Being good gains allies but requires careful actions, while everyone can turn against Cole because he has become totally evil. Therefore, everyone decides their game style by completing various tasks, such as protecting people and restoring electricity. In particular, some missions are exclusive to good or evil paths.

name: Assassin’s Creed II - Game of the Year Edition - Gold Cut
description: Assassin’s Creed II - Game of the Year Edition - Gold Cut

name: Grand Theft Auto IV & Episodes from Liberty City
description: Grand Theft Auto IV & Episodes from Liberty City

name: Resident Evil 5
description: In Resident Evil 5, you will control Chris Redfield as the protagonist. Five years after Resident Evil 4, Chris is dispatched to Kijuju in Africa. He collaborates with a local agent named Sheva Alomar to apprehend Ricardo Irwing. This man has a goal to engage in the bioweapons trade. To confront them, the protagonist should go to the hordes of infected villagers called Rajini. Through the travel, Chris knows the truth of the tragedy that was orchestrated by former acquaintances. The gameplay from the previous game is carried over into this one. Over their shoulder, players observe the action. Chris battles infected opponents with shooting and object-throwing abilities because of melee, grenade, and rifle attacks. Sheva stays by Chris’s side all the time. Sheva can be controlled locally or virtually by a second player. Additionally, if players want to defeat opponents to survive and earn points, they can try the mercenaries.

name: Tomb Raider Trilogy
description: The Tomb Raider Trilogy includes three games and extra content when you still follow Lara Croft, a brave explorer. She searches for ancient artifacts and solves puzzles after traveling to exotic locations worldwide. Therefore, she encounters friends and foes along the way. The gameplay focuses on action and adventure, and our heroine can run, swim, and use new tools. Through the adventure and flashbacks, the story reveals the past that explains her motivations and personal struggles. Amanda Evert returns to become a rival, and you should compete with her to receive a powerful artifact. At the same time, players must overcome challenges and uncover secrets. Lara will go from the Himalayas to England. This is surely a great adventure for players.

name: Resident Evil 6 Anthology - Definitive Collection
description: Resident Evil: Director’s Cut is related to the original game when being a slight remix. The game offers three modes, with the original mode unchanged. For the newbie, the game gives more ammo and health attached with auto-targeting. From there, arrange mode will be opened, where you can find the new outfits, camera angles, and key items. These changes challenge veteran players. The default pistol is now chromed and stronger. The game still has an uncut opening video and shows more graphic content. Overall, the game aims to surprise players and offer new experiences with the changed and unchanged elements.

name: Diablo III - Reaper of Souls – Ultimate Evil Edition
description: INTRODUCTION Summon the storm of fury right in the comfort of your abode. Diablo III: Reaper of Souls – Ultimate Evil Edition has rallied more than 15 million game warriors to smite the sinister legions of the underworld. You are invited to join this noble crusade, taking arms against the forces threatening the mortal realm. This package presents Diablo III and the Reaper of Souls expansion set in one comprehensive volume. Brace yourself as a chilling wind of malevolence is blowing your way. A SEIGE LIFTED BY DEMONIC DESTRUCTION The game is about taking down the fiendish hordes rampaging across all five acts of the epic storyline. But that’s not all; you could roam the open world in Adventure Mode. Here, you get to seek out and dispatch the primeval evils hidden in the corners of the mortal realms while earning bounties. The freedom to choose how you engage with the game is part of what has endeared it to its millions of players worldwide. RISING TO THE OCCASION AS A TRUE CHAMPION Choose from a diverse roster of humanity’s last defenders—the crusader, wizard, monk, demon hunter, witch doctor, or barbarian—and amplify your prowess with powerful abilities and legendary gear. It’s not just about selecting a character but about immersing yourself in a role that resonates with you and crafting a legacy on the battlefield. MASTERING A DYNAMIC BATTLEFIELD This game isn’t for the faint of heart. You are tasked with annihilating legions of vile creatures across varied, randomized 3D environments. Confront countless demonic villains, discover quests in fresh locations, and revel in the loot that rains down with every playthrough. The battlefield is forever changing, forcing you to adapt and ensuring that no two gaming experiences are identical. CALLING UPON THE POWER OF FRIENDSHIP The path before you need not be walked alone. Engage in solo play or team up with up to four heroes locally on a single screen or online with fellow players. Cooperation and camaraderie make for a richer experience, where strategy and synergy can mean victory and defeat. READY TO UNLEASH HELL IN YOUR LIVING ROOM? With Diablo III: Reaper of Souls – Ultimate Evil Edition, you’re not just playing a game but stepping into a world of epic fantasy. From crushing hordes of evil to standing as a champion, from conquering dynamic battlefields to calling upon allies, there is a lot to love about this game. It’s not just a journey; it’s your crusade. So, are you ready to embrace the call and face the wickedness on its way?

name: Dragon Age - Origins
description: INTRODUCTION Ah, the allure of Dragon Age: Origins. This console-spanning role-playing gem, courtesy of BioWare, calls forth a sense of nostalgia for the gaming studio’s halcyon days. Celebrated for their repertoire of riveting RPGs, from the groundbreaking Baldur’s Gate to the iconic Mass Effect, BioWare has been painting our digital dreamscapes for decades. In their latest masterpiece, they return us to an epic fantasy landscape that’s both novel and familiar, reminiscent of their triumphant RPG history. EPIC TALE OF HEROIC TRIUMPH The heart of Dragon Age: Origins lies in its rich, fascinating narrative set in the kingdom of Ferelden on the sprawling continent of Thedas. Populated by many races, this locale has become the playground for the dreaded dark spawn, a formidable force of monsters led by a chilling archdemon. As a player, you’re offered a prestigious place among the Grey Wardens, an esteemed group of courageous individuals committed to combating this threatening evil. Embarking on this single-player adventure, you’re plunged into an immersive journey ranging from 60 to 100 hours, further enhanced by downloadable DLC expansions. MULTIPLICITY OF MORAL DILEMMAS One distinctive feature of this game is its insistence on choice. Dragon Age: Origins does not shy away from presenting players with thought-provoking dilemmas where the ramifications of your decisions ripple throughout the gameplay. Take, for instance, a haunting scenario where you meet a possessed child. You’re forced to make a heart-wrenching decision: execute the child yourself or allow the sacrifice of another person to salvage the child’s soul. Every quest has multiple paths, and your choices mold your character and impact the world around you. DIALOGUES THAT RESONATE The game elevates the RPG experience through its intricate dialogue system. Drawing from Mass Effect, conversations in Dragon Age: Origins are punctuated by detailed character mimics, nuanced reactions, and various dialogue options. A staggering 900 thousand words contribute to these engrossing exchanges, brought to life by a talented cast of over 140 voice actors. Whether interacting with primary or secondary characters, players are guaranteed an auditory treat that enriches the gaming experience. COMPREHENSIVE CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION Your adventure in this captivating world begins with the customization of your protagonist. You choose your race, gender, class, and origin story from several compelling options, such as a city-dwelling elf, a noble human, a commoner dwarf, or an enigmatic mage. Your chosen narrative origin casts a shadow over your future exploits in the game, personalizing your gameplay experience. THRILLING REAL-TIME COMBAT Combat in Dragon Age: Origins is a delicate dance of strategy and skill. Engagements unfold in real-time, though an active pause feature allows for careful consideration of your next move. Victory relies on a tactical blend of abilities, talents, and spells. Your party, capped at four characters, can be controlled directly or set to behave based on preassigned scripts. These characters range from the intriguing, like Zevran the assassin or Morrigan the witch, to a lovable Mabari war hound. Comrades not actively in your party await their turn at the camp, offering opportunities to deepen relationships and further explore their stories. VISUAL FEAST FOR THE EYES The game’s presentation is a sight to behold. From a third-person perspective or an isometric viewpoint evoking classic RPGs, the detailed environments and dynamic interplay of light and shadow make the world of Dragon Age: Origins a visual treat. With locations as diverse as the bustling city of Denerim, the tranquil Brazilian forest, the sturdy dwarven fortress of Orzammar, or the ruined mage tower of the elves, the game offers varied and immersive landscapes for exploration and conquest.

name: Hitman HD Trilogy
description: The Hitman HD Trilogy includes three remastered games and a bonus. Especially, Agent 47 is the main character, but he tries to leave his violent past behind. The missions still appear and make him return to his role. A priest gets kidnapped, so he must act. The game has the stealth experience when you control the protagonist from the third perspective. Players complete missions around the world and assassinate targets. Sometimes, you should protect the targets, and stealth is still the core feature. Agent 47 can sneak or use disguises. He has many weapons, but they always have the limits in use. Guards are smart and investigate suspicious activities because of their reaction to visible guns and running. Therefore, there is a long journey of waiting for players ahead.

name: Sniper Elite III
description: Sniper Elite III

name: Fallout 3 - Titan Edition
description: After World War II, technology developed quickly and gave hope to people for a prosperous future. Conflict returned in 2077, so the world was annihilated by nuclear weapons with only vault survivors. Some underwent significant mutations while the globe turned into a nuclear wasteland. After two centuries, people departed from the Vaults to take Earth back. The main character hails from Vault 101, where he was raised in a strict household. Abruptly, his father exits the vault. He must be located by the hero. Along the way, he discovers unspoken realities. One role-playing game is Fallout 3, with 3D shooter components. Features from earlier games are retained but emphasize battle and exploration more. Gamers are free to explore the environment where they can go to places and converse with fictional people. The primary mission is most linear, but it presents moral options in the closing moments. In addition, players can finish side tasks as well.

name: Tekken 6
description: After the tournament win, Jin Kazama took over Mishima Zaibatsu. From there, he became a tyrant and started wars. Lars Alexandersson wants to end this situation. Gameplay allows players to choose characters for the tournament and win the opponents as much as possible. At the same time, the winning condition is knocking out the others or time-out. The gameplay is similar to previous versions but adds some enhancements. Six new characters join the roster to complete the story mode. Players can also fight online with human opponents to ensure the rank of their powers. When you pass many matches, characters compete in the King of Iron Fist tournament.

name: Far Cry Compilation
description: Far Cry Compilation

name: Call of Duty - World at War
description: The game is a military first-person shooter with weaponry and linear levels to try a realistic war. Players are in the midst of action with NPC teammates. Missions involve clearing houses, planting bombs, or defending positions. Health regenerates when out of the fire. The game introduces a co-op campaign for up to four players, which is attached to two available campaigns. One begins in 1942 on Makin-Atoll, where Miller seeks vengeance. The other starts in Stalingrad, following Petrenko. Both of them recreate real missions. In particular, the multiplayer mode is similar to Call of Duty 4, including various game types and a ranking system. Players earn experience points to unlock weapons and abilities. Custom classes can be created for multiplayer matches.

name: Uncharted 3 - Drake's Deception - Game of the Year Edition - Iconic Cut
description: In addition to Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception, this also includes: - Multiplayer maps (Graveyard, Old Quarter, London Streets, Oasis) - "Flashback maps" which are 8 remade maps from versions 1 and 2 - 25 multiplayer skins, and Killzone 3 skins - Fort Co-Op (this happens in the fortress from 'Drake's Fortune') - Rogue skins pack (from 14 enemies)

name: Far Cry - Wild Expedition - Signature Cut
description: Far Cry: Wild Expedition is a compilation bundle of the games in the Far Cry franchise, released to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the original game. The bundle contains Far Cry 2, Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon, whilst releases outside of the United States additionally include Far Cry Classic, an HD remake of the first game in the series.

name: Crysis 3
description: Crysis 3 allows for controlling Laurence “Prophet” Barnes in 2047. Prophet wears a nano suit with powerful abilities, and thanks to it, he can return with fully stored memories. Manhattan is under a dome to protect alien remnants. Prophet and elite soldiers hunt the Alpha Ceph. The story unfolds over seven chapters, and the game provides some audio diaries that can explain some plot elements. When going through urban and jungle environments, you can take advantage of stealth kills by using weapons like bows. At the same time, enemies include humans and aliens. With various weapons and configurable nanosuits, you can adapt to different situations. Players earn upgrade points to enhance their abilities. A tactical visor helps locate items and enemies.

name: Beyond the Future - Fix the Time Arrows
description: Beyond the Future - Fix the Time Arrows

name: LittleBigPlanet Karting
description: Being a kart racing game, this game takes place in the LittleBigPlanet world. Players can race on many tracks or in arenas. Depending on their skills, they can play against real people or computer rivals. Four players can play on one console in the local mode, or this number will increase to eight online. Racers can get weapons and power-ups during races that help to hinder enemies. Besides the standard modes, different gameplay like races, hunts, and battles will be found later. You can try to experience and find the story of this world with others. The plot continues the last event of the previous versions when bad guys want to steal prizes. Therefore, you will play the role of the hero who must win races to get them back.

name: Fast & Furious - Showdown - Legacy Series
description: With the success of the blockbuster “Fast & Furious 6”, the popular gaming firm Activision decided to develop “Fast & Furious: Showdown”, the “follow-up” action racing game developed by Firebrand Games. Right from the first time, it was launched, the game has given players the experience of the dramatic and exciting racing games that we have witnessed on the screen. In particular, the game also has the presence of familiar characters in the series “The Fast and Furious”, except for the notable absence of the famous character in the film, Dominic Toretto. The gameplay in “Fast & Furious: Showdown” focuses on cooperative driving and chases and fights on vehicles. The game offers players various types of missions centered around driving around in semi-destructible rounds. These tasks can range from regular car racing to surviving certain cycles. Also in some missions, the player character may need to steal another vehicle by jumping from the front of their vehicle to another. All cars have HP bars and some nitro features. The plot of “Fast & Furious: Showdown” begins with the cut scene of the character Monica Fuentes finding Riley Hicks digging everywhere through files in her office. Riley introduces herself and says she will meet Luke Hobbs in 24 hours, and needs to know everything Hobbs has done. The following missions were events told by Monica to explain what Hobbs had solved. Through this, we see various events from the movie, such as the safe dragging scene from “Fast Five”, or the hijacking scene from “Fast & Furious”.

name: Dark Souls - Artorias of the Abyss
description: Dark Souls: Artorias of the Abyss is a downloadable content pack for the 2011 action role-playing game Dark Souls. Artorias of the Abyss is set a hundred years before the events of Dark Souls. The player is taken back into the past by a primeval human known as Manus, Father of the Abyss, who was resurrected and tortured by the sorcerers of Oolacile a century prior, hoping to unlock his dark power. Manus' power went wild and created the Abyss, a dark void that threatens to swallow the entirety of Oolacile. Anor Londo sent Knight Artorias to slay Manus, but he was unable to withstand the dark onslaught due to his lack of Humanity and became possessed himself, only able to save his wolf companion, Sif.

name: Resident Evil 4
description: Resident Evil 4

name: Darksiders II
description: Darksiders II is an action-adventure game with a story that runs parallel to Darksiders. A Horseman of the Apocalypse named Death tries to prove his brother’s innocence and brings humanity back to life. Specially, the game has hack-and-slash gameplay, where you can freely pass challenges in large open worlds or go to dungeons. Players can ride horses or travel fast. Sometimes, many puzzles require players to solve thanks to some actions, like climbing, running on walls, and swimming. From the first game, he’s more agile than War in helping players try new experiences with new partners. New abilities are unlocked and are necessary in any RPG game, including a grappling hook and a portal gun. Therefore, you can perform many attacking types. In particular, anyone will be excited when completing some levels that have big bosses to fight. Overall, the game mixes action, exploration, and puzzle-solving.

name: Battlefield - Bad Company 2 - Limited Edition - Vault Cut
description: In Battlefield: Bad Company 2, the Bad Company crew again find themselves in the heart of the action, where they must use every weapon and vehicle at their disposal to survive. The action unfolds with unprecedented intensity, introducing a level of fervor to vehicular warfare never before experienced in a modern warfare action game. The 'B' company fight their way through snowy mountaintops, dense jungles and dusty villages. With a heavy arsenal of deadly weapons and a slew of vehicles to aid them, the crew set off on their mission and they are ready to blow up, shoot down, blast through, wipe out and utterly destroy anything that gets in their way. Total destruction is the name of the game — either online or offline, enemies will soon learn there is nowhere to hide.

name: Watch Dogs - Gold Archive
description: The developer adds new content to the original version of Watch_Dogs. In particular, you can try the main game and some DLC when still following Aiden Pearce in Chicago. He’s a hacker seeking revenge for his niece’s death. The city runs on ctOS, which controls everything. With his ability, he can hack anything to find more information about people and do various tasks. The game has many side missions that give skill points for upgrades. Players can find many activities in the game, like hacking, shooting, or driving skills. From there, you can complete missions and escape the police. The game world is open to explore freely and find more mini-games called digital trips. Overall, the game mixes action, stealth, and hacking elements.

name: Assassin’s Creed I+II Welcome Pack
description: When Altair and Ezio come together, they make you an irresistible deal. From Jerusalem to Renaissance Italy, the two assassins discover secrets hidden in the depths of history, and avenge the wrongs dealt to them. Although both games are now available as Best Priced Editions, this is a two games in one ultimate value pack.

name: Red Dead Redemption - Undead Nightmare
description: INTRODUCTION In the gaming world, Red Dead Redemption: Undead Nightmare is more than just an action-packed adventure—it’s a comprehensive anthology of riveting DLCs for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. It’s like a juicy steak with a side of mouth-watering extras: Undead Nightmare Pack, Outlaws to the End Co-Op Mission Pack, Legends and Killers Pack, Liars and Cheats Pack, and even the Multiplayer Free Roam update content. Please fasten your seat belts as we delve into this exhilarating ride and explore why this game is the cat’s pajamas. UNDEAD NIGHTMARE: ZOMBIE FUN WITH A TWIST Is this game’s primary draw? The Undead Nightmare Pack. You’ll be in the boots of John Marston, the same protagonist from the base game, fighting tooth and nail to find a cure for a zombie outbreak that’s threatening to take over. Using the Blunderbuss, a new addition to your arsenal and a short-barreled shotgun that fires zombie remains, you’ll confront four distinct types of undead. As if that’s not thrilling enough, watch out for infected critters that might just give you a heart attack when you’re on foot! NEW CHALLENGES AND MULTIPLAYER THRILLS Fancy rescuing potential survivors or battling waves of the undead with your comrades in arms? The game offers new challenges, missions, and events like Missing Persons and the fan-loved Undead Overrun Mode. So, don your headset, call up your mates, and prepare to defend humanity in the most entertaining way possible! CO-OP MISSIONS: TEAMWORK MAKES THE DREAM WORK Next up, the Outlaws to The End Co-Op Mission Pack serves up six lip-smacking co-op missions. Feel like a hero in The Escape, attacking bandits, nabbing their loot, and cleaning up the town of Tumbleweed. Or try your hand at cowboy chores with The Herd, herding cattle into Armadillo, with the minor inconvenience of snipers and horse riders aiming to take you down. Never a dull moment, right? LEGENDS AND KILLERS PACK: MORE MULTIPLAYER MADNESS The Legends and Killers Pack takes the multiplayer frenzy up a notch. Not only does it offer nine new maps and eight playable characters, but it also introduces a wicked new weapon – the Tomahawk axe. So, brace yourself to lob axes in a virtual battle that feels too real! LIARS AND CHEATS: A WHOLE NEW GAMING EXPERIENCE Lastly, the Liars and Cheats Pack further diversifies the gameplay. Immerse yourself in Liars Dice and Poker mini-games designed for online play, or partake in adrenaline-pumping multiplayer horse races. You’re in for an unforgettable gaming journey with a new weapon—the Explosive Rifle—and its challenges, seven gang hideouts, four hunting zones, and the multiplayer Stronghold Competitive Mode. Adding 15 characters from the single-player campaign to the multiplayer mode is the cherry on top! To sum it all up, Red Dead Redemption: Undead Nightmare is more than just a game—it’s a thrilling universe of action, adventure, and pure unadulterated fun that never fails to impress. So grab your controller and get ready to dive in!

name: Ni No Kuni - Wrath of the White Witch
description: After saving him from drowning, the mother of Oliver dies. He cries over her doll, which becomes a fairy lord named Drippy. Drippy reveals a parallel world with connected souls. Oliver follows Drippy to find his mother’s double, Alicia. Ni no Kuni is a role-playing game in which Drippy hopes Oliver can save his world. Players control Oliver and his Familiars, who are summonable creatures. Enemies roam the world, and battles start upon contact. Combat is real-time through timed attack commands. Oliver can switch with Familiars in the limited battle time. At the same time, he helps people balance personality traits. He takes surplus traits from some and gives them to others who lack them. He also runs errands for merit stamps, which he exchanges for rewards. The story is similar to the previous one but diverges midway.

name: Borderlands - Game of the Year Edition - Master Cut
description: Lock, Load, & Face the Madness! Get ready for the mind-blowing insanity, as one of four trigger-happy mercenaries, taking out everything that stands in your way. With its addictive action, frantic first person shooter combat, massive arsenal of weaponry, RPG elements and four-player co-op, Borderlands is the breakthrough experience that challenges all the conventions of modern shooters. Borderlands places you in the role of a mercenary on the lawless and desolate planet of Pandora, hell bent on finding a legendary stockpile of powerful alien technology known as The Vault.

name: Far Cry 4
description: INTRODUCTION “Far Cry 4”, a riveting installation in the globally acclaimed first-person sandbox shooter series, offers players an immersive experience across multiple platforms like PC, PS4, and more. Spawned from the innovative minds at Crytek in 2004, the franchise fell under Ubisoft’s adept leadership a year later, who have since unfailingly churned sequels and spin-offs to satiate gamers’ thirst for adventure. Far Cry 4, meticulously crafted primarily in Ubisoft Montreal’s creative crucible, collaborates with the company’s diverse departments, giving birth to the first series installment accessible on Xbox One and PlayStation 4. A COMPELLING NARRATIVE SET IN A MYSTICAL LAND Far Cry 4 takes players on a thrilling journey to Kyrat, a quaint fictional realm in the Himalayas. A place steeped in tradition and simple lifestyles, Kyrat is trapped in a vicious civil war perpetrated by the eccentric warlord Pagan Min, the self-styled ruler of Kyrat. His iron-fisted rule and disdain for civilian casualties fuel the raging conflict. The protagonist, Ajay Ghale, becomes embroiled in this deadly power struggle upon his arrival in Kyrat, intending merely to fulfill his dying mother’s final wish. IMMERSIVE GAMEPLAY IN A RICHLY DETAILED WORLD The gameplay gently unravels Kyrat’s enigmatic secrets, drawing players deeper into its rich tapestry. Kyrat’s unique geography is an exciting potpourri of locales, from snow-clad mountain trails to dense forests, pulsating cities, and intriguing ancient ruins. Players enjoy the liberty to traverse the expansive open-world map of this Himalayan country, leveraging diverse modes of transport to satisfy their wanderlust. Furthermore, the protagonist can participate in spiritual meditations, transporting him to the mythical realm of Shangri-La. A MULTI-FACETED JOURNEY OF DISCOVERY During the campaign, players encounter a mix of plot-driving missions, side quests, and optional objectives, such as liberating checkpoints, timed trials, or hunting the wilderness’ exotic fauna. Being an accurate FPS production, Far Cry 4 arms players with a varied weapon arsenal, from basic pistols to heavy machine guns, daggers, knives, and bows, and introducing a crossbow for the first time in the series. AN INVITING ARENA FOR MULTIPLAYER MAYHEM The game goes beyond single-player adventures, offering a platter of multiplayer variations. In the novel co-op mode, players can rally their friends to assist in accomplishing side missions or to make exploring the open world a shared delight. CONCLUSION The allure of Far Cry 4 stems not just from its enthralling story or detailed open world but from the freedom it gives players to explore, fight, and shape their journey. Ubisoft has outdone itself with this installment, and players worldwide eagerly await what adventure they will be invited to embark on next.

name: Assassin’s Creed
description: The game starts when a bartender disappears in 2012. He used a device called Animus to access the memory in the past. Therefore, he plays the role of the ancestor, an assassin named Altaïr. This happens because the kidnappers need his memories. From 1191 in the Holy Land, during the Third Crusade, Altaïr is ordered to kill nine important people that cause war and corruption. The gameplay combines modern knowledge with a powerful assassin. At the same time, the game offers free movement and choice, so players can make some performances on the buildings. Players can find many ways to complete missions and gather information. Therefore, they can choose how to approach targets.

name: Assassin’s Creed IV - Black Flag
description: The main game and the DLC are included in only one version. For the plots, the life of Edward Kenway resonates with the protagonist, and he should turn into a renegade assassin to fight the Templars and the Assassins alike. They search for Sage and try to find old technologies. The sixth significant chapter in the series is titled Black Flag, and the modern-day story arc is continued. Though the world has expanded, familiar aspects are still present. The Caribbean Sea is free for players to help them explore and satisfy their curiosity. There are three major cities besides minor ones. Edward knows where to look for treasure maps and how to hunt. He is granted access to the upgradeable ship named Jackdaw. To have a favorable naval combat. You should select and hire crewmen. In addition to well-known gaming principles, the game features both land and water adventure.

name: Assassin's  Creed Double Pack - Platinum Cut
description: Assassin's Creed® Double Edition includes the two first chapters of the critically acclaimed Assassin's Creed® series. Experience the art of the original master assassin’s in two historical eras: the Third Crusade and the Renaissance. - In Assassin's Creed®, you are Altair, a lethal master assassin with one single purpose: to kill the Saracens and Crusader leaders who profit from and encourage the war in the Holy Land. - In Assassin's Creed® II, play as Ezio Auditore da Firenze and take part in an epic story of family, vengeance, and conspiracy, set in the pristine yet brutal backdrop of Renaissance Italy.

name: MotorStorm - Apocalypse - Master Edition
description: MotorStorm: Apocalypse leads players to an earthquake-hit urban area. The game focuses more on the storyline and allows players to race through a festival. Three characters represent the related difficulty levels. During the races, the earthquake sometimes causes chaos and makes falling buildings and explosions. In addition, players can understand the story through cut-scenes. Players will pass through twelve races per character. Boost is important in the races. At the same time, it can be used at unlimited times but can overheat the engine. Water cools the engine, or you can go airborne. The race becomes more interesting when some vehicles have special controls to ram or punch opponents.

name: Dead Space 3
description: Dead Space 3 is the third version of the horror series in the galaxy. The game starts when players control a soldier at a base on Tau Volantis. In this place, they found the Markers, the important investigated target. After that, the timeline begins in 2314, and you will face the protagonist named Isaac Clarke. Clarke travels to Tau Volantis with Ellie Langford and John Carver. They aim to find the origin of the Markers and prevent future Necromorph, which is the main monster of the series. In addition, the challenges come from the crucial temperature and oxygen levels. Therefore, Clarke should be careful when using many tools before entering the environment. You can not destroy the monsters by a headshot; you can only target specific body parts of each Necromorph type.

name: Metal Gear Online
description: Metal Gear Online was released as the multiplayer component to Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots, but with a standalone release for Japan. Up to 16 players can play in a variety of modes that are staple to the online shooter genre, like Capture and Team Deathmatch. The original servers shut down on June 12, 2012, but the mode has been revived to be playable on both PS3 and on PC via emulators thanks to the https://savemgo.com/ & https://mgo2pc.com/ projects.

name: Assassin’s Creed III
description: Introduction Ubisoft’s acclaimed video game, Assassin’s Creed III, graces the PC and X360 platforms as the illustrious fifth entry of the storied franchise. The game, bearing the triumvirate numeral, not only represents the unfolding of an expansive narrative but also introduces us to the third progenitor of Desmond Miles in this intricate chronicle. THE RIVETING TALE OF CONNOR Diving into the game, you’ll find yourself stepping into the moccasins of a Metis named Connor. This robust tale spans three decades (1753-1783) in colonial North America, birthing from a love affair between an Indian woman and a British man. When chaos sparks between the colonists and Indians, devastating Connor’s home village, he pledges to wage war against oppression and seek justice. The narrative weaves around monumental events like George Washington’s siege of Boston, the New York Great Fire, and the notorious Paul Revere’s Midnight Ride. A FAMILIAR YET INNOVATIVE GAMEPLAY While the story ventures into a novel historical epoch, the game mechanics retain their well-loved roots. Freedom of exploration and a penchant for eliminating targets stealthily persist as the game’s cornerstone. Still, innovation isn’t lost; you’ll spend more time on solid ground, embodying an unseen predator. Your new avatar is more aggressive, sporting a deadly tomahawk alongside the classic hidden blade. A string of improvements, like dual counters and auto-targeting enemies, adds zest to the combat system. THE WILDNESS CALLS The vast wilderness flourishes between cityscapes, serving as more than mere transition points. Connor is at his prime—scaling rocks, leaping across tree branches, and traversing rugged terrains with unparalleled agility. The ability to hunt game for tradeable skin and fur marks a significant shift in the economic system. A standout feature in the wilderness is the thrilling naval battles, where you can seize control of a ship and decide its fate on the high seas. A TECHNOLOGICAL TRIUMPH The improved graphic engine of the third numbered entry boosts the game’s visual allure, featuring meticulous character models, crisp textures, and an array of stunning effects. A significant leap forward is the introduction of a seasons cycle that adds depth and immersion to gameplay, like hindrances posed by snowdrifts in the wilderness. The capacity to showcase up to 1000 character models on the screen further augments the game’s technical prowess. A FRESH MULTIPLAYER EXPERIENCE Lastly, the game invites you into its captivating new multiplayer modes, built on the familiar foundation of eluding other players’ sights. In one of these engaging modes, teams of players lock horns to gain control over specific map points, breathing fresh life into the game’s competitive scene. In conclusion, Assassin’s Creed III encapsulates a blend of engaging narrative, familiar yet enhanced gameplay, breathtaking wilderness, superior technology, and innovative multiplayer modes, making it a magnet for gamers worldwide. There’s more to this game than meets the eye, and there’s plenty of proof in the pudding—or should we say, in the assassination!

name: Metal Gear Solid 4 - Guns Of The Patriots – 25th Anniversary Edition
description: Metal Gear Solid 4 - Guns Of The Patriots – 25th Anniversary Edition

name: Dragon Age - Inquisition
description: INTRODUCTION Dragons are afoot, realms are in chaos, and the call for a hero reverberates across the world of Thedas! Welcome to the third chapter of the epic saga from BioWare, Dragon Age: Inquisition. This addition to the series sees the developers responding to player feedback from earlier editions, masterfully blending the preferred elements of the first installment with the best of the second and even sprinkling in some fresh, exciting features. BREATHTAKING NARRATIVE: MORE THAN A DECADE LATER Our adventure kicks off a decade post-Dragon Age: Origins. Thedas finds itself in disarray – Ferelden, not yet recovered from the fifth Blight, a Darkspawn invasion, and Orlais, embroiled in civil unrest. Add to that an ongoing clash between mages and Templars, a ripped seam between the mortal world and the Fade, resulting in a demon onslaught. Enter the Inquisition, a politically independent entity that takes on this terrifying threat. As the player, you helm the Inquisition, tasked with finding the source of this demonic invasion and gathering enough power to thwart it. The character creation tool allows customization of everything from class and gender to race, all contributing to a fully-voiced, immersive protagonist. ROLE OF COMPANIONS: MORE THAN JUST BACKUP Accompanying your character are numerous companions, including familiar faces from previous chapters. Their significance lies not only in battle support but also in the narrative. By interacting with them, you unveil their stories, intentions, and ambitions. They react to your actions, which directly influence their perception of you. And yes, those beloved Dragon Age romances remain crucial to these companion relationships, showcasing interpersonal dynamics with a more realistic, mature approach. CHOICES AND CONSEQUENCES: GREY MORALITY Throughout your journey, you face complex moral dilemmas where the clear line dividing good from evil is blurred. These decisions impact the plot significantly, with consequences sometimes unfolding much later. For those wanting to import decisions from previous games or newcomers looking to create their history, the Dragon Age Keep website provides a solution. This platform allows you to generate a personalized save game to import, offering a unique storytelling experience. SIDE MISSIONS AND STRATEGIC GROWTH: REPUTATION IS POWER While the primary plot line unfolds, players engage in side quests and minor conflicts that are peppering Thedas. As Inquisitor, your decisions represent the entire organization, shaping its reputation and relationships with other groups. Progress in the game leads to character growth and the increasing significance of the Inquisition. Higher standing translates into tangible benefits like a personal army capable of capturing fortresses harboring crucial information. WORLD EXPLORATION AND COMBAT: A JOURNEY ACROSS THEDAS Given the scale of events in Dragon Age: Inquisition, players traverse the expansive continent of Thedas. While not fully open-world, locations offer more size and diversity than in previous chapters. Travel and exploration occur via a world map and on foot or horseback. Unlocking key plot areas requires a certain reputation level, achieved through side quests, diplomacy, artifact collection, and defeating dangerous creatures. As for combat, the developers have aimed to satisfy both strategists and action lovers. Players can issue orders to party members during active pauses or let AI control the action, allowing a focus on one character. The updated AI leads to organized enemy groups that support each other and respond to battlefield situations, requiring careful observation and strategic planning from players. TECHNOLOGY: A STUNNING DISPLAY The Frostbite 3 engine is powering this masterpiece, known for its application in Battlefield 4. The technology allows for creation of vast open spaces and intricate environment interactions. Destruction and reconstruction of environment components enable access to new locations. Added to this is a dynamic day-night cycle and weather conditions directly impacting gameplay. This chapter in the Dragon Age saga promises a compelling narrative, rich gameplay, and an immersive visual experience.

name: Resident Evil Zero HD Remaster
description: Resident Evil 0 reveals the truth behind the Mansion Incident, the catalyst for the entire storyline of the Resident Evil series. This remastered version takes the story and gameplay of the original and adds stunning HD graphics, 5.1 channel surround sound, optional modernised controls and widescreen TV compatibility. Get ready to discover the terrible secrets lurking in the origins of evil.

name: Diablo III
description: Diablo III is the third game in Blizzard’s franchise. The story takes place twenty years after Diablo II. A star falls on the cathedral in Old Tristram. The hero investigates this event. Players can choose from five classes. The game is a dungeon crawler with hordes of enemies. In particular, maps are randomly generated where the surprising things exist with four acts and four difficulty levels. Each character has multiple abilities, and to win the battle, equipment needs to be customized. Players can use dyes and gems to enhance gear. Followers can accompany the hero in solo mode or cooperate with other players in multiplayer and public games. The auction house allows item trading. Achievements add replay value. Random elements ensure varied gameplay experiences.

name: Batman - Arkham Origins Collector’s Edition
description: Developed by WB Games Montreal, Batman: Arkham Origins features an expanded Gotham City and introduces an original prequel storyline set several years before the events of Batman: Arkham Asylum and Batman: Arkham City, the first two critically acclaimed games of the franchise. Taking place before the rise of Gotham City’s most dangerous criminals, the game showcases a young and unrefined Batman as he faces a defining moment in his early career as a crime fighter that sets his path to becoming the Dark Knight. As the story unfolds, players will meet many important characters for the first time and forge key relationships. The Batman: Arkham Origins Collector’s Edition will include the following extensive bonus content: 1, Exclusive Arkham Origins premium statue featuring LED effects produced by TriForce. 2.Beautifully rendered and highly detailed statue measuring approx. 9″ x 13″ x 11.5″ 3. 80-page, full-color hardcover art book measuring approx. 7.5″ x 10.75″ x .5″. 4.Two key pieces of evidence taken directly from the Gotham City Police Department crime lab, Batman Wanted Poster, Batwing Prototype Schematic , Anarchy logo stencil, Glow-In-The-Dark map of Gotham City, Wayne Family Photo, Assassin’s Intel Dossier, which includes files on the 8 assassins as well as Black Mask’s contract, 1st Appearance Batman Skin: Look just like Batman did during his first appearance in Detective Comics #27, released in 1939.
