name: Fallout - New Vegas
description: With the theme of a post-apocalyptic world, Fallout: New Vegas follows a war between different groups in Naveda. Players are couriers who survive an attack and want to find the background of the enemies and their plot. Therefore, they should explore the wasteland and complete quests to become stronger with level up and new abilities. The game offers various weapons and crafting options. In particular, players can influence different factions and towns because their choices affect the emotions of others. Therefore, if you are not careful, you are considered enemies. The game combines action, exploration, and role-playing elements when offering an open-world experience for players to enjoy.

name: Dark Souls II
description: The Kingdom of Drangleic was once prosperous and majestic, and led to its downfall and desolation because of mysterious exile. A cursed traveler arrives in Majula village, seeking a cure for his affliction. Happily, an enigmatic woman tells him the ways of surviving by gathering Four Grand Souls. This quest may save him and redeem Drangleic. Dark Souls II continues the story of the previous version but changes the background with a dark medieval fantasy setting. In addition, the gameplay is still challenging when it requires the skills of players. They can experience the third-person action RPG and the world exploration. Because of precise timing and careful stamina management, players can experience the top difficulty in this series. However, they can dodge or block attacks to survive and choose the right attacking moments. In addition, the game allows extensive character customization by choosing their class, gender, and appearance.

name: God of War Origins Collection
description: Prepare to be spellbound as you delve into the beginnings of the mighty Kratos through the ultimate assemblage of God of War: Chains of Olympus and God of War: Ghost of Sparta, neatly packaged onto one Blu-ray disc! Rendered flawlessly in 1080p high-definition and breathtaking stereoscopic 3-D, this collection pulls you into the tormented narrative of the Spartan Warrior. You’ll discover the grim history that ceaselessly haunts Kratos, understanding his excruciating choice between redemption and the salvation of the ancient realm teetering on the brink of destruction. EXEMPLARY GAMEPLAY FEATURES Exhibiting two monumental adventures neatly encased on a single Blu-RayTM Disc, God of War: Origins Collection captures the attention of gamers and casual players alike. The remastered HD resolution breathes new life into the classic tales, offering an incredibly immersive gaming experience. Imagine the thunderous clashes, the anguished roars of Kratos echoing through your living room in stunning high-definition – it’s practically like being there! EMBRACING THE THIRD DIMENSION The full 3D support adds another layer to the compelling narrative, enabling players to fully experience the intensity and emotion that this game uniquely delivers. It’s not just about playing a game; it’s about living it! Imagine engaging with the God of War universe from a 3-dimensional perspective; it’s like reaching into the game and interacting with the world of ancient Greece firsthand! TRIUMPHANT REWARDS AND COMPATIBILITY The game provides full PlayStation Network Trophy support, igniting the competitive spirit within every player. Celebrate your victories and accomplishments with trophies that highlight your gaming prowess. Further enhancing the overall experience is the compatibility with Dual Shock, improving the tactile aspect of gameplay and delivering an even more immersive experience. BONUS CONTENT APLENTY This compilation doesn’t stop at providing awe-inspiring gameplay; it generously offers bonus content! Including DLC contents from GOW Ghost of Sparta, it brings to the table the formidable Legionnaire Kratos and the enigmatic Forest of the Forgotten. These additions breathe further life into the gameplay, ensuring you’re always on your toes, ready for what comes next. INTERACTIVE DEEP-DIVE INTO THE MAKING The “God of War: Game Directors Live” video is the cherry on top of this epic compilation. This interactive and informative addition allows players to dive deep into the directors’ minds, offering insight into the creative process and the monumental effort that went into creating such a widely beloved game. This behind-the-scenes peek into the creation of the God of War: Origins Collection is a testament to the love, sweat, and passion poured into every detail of the game. Immerse yourself in the enthralling world of the God of War: Origins Collection. Journey with Kratos through his dark past, experience epic battles in stunning high-definition and dive deep into the ancient world brought to life like never before. It’s not just a game; it’s an unforgettable adventure!

name: Resident Evil - Operation Raccoon City
description: The game is a spin-off of the famous Resident Evil. From the third perspective, you will experience the action gameplay. The horror elements are also reduced. The story is non-canon and takes place in September 1998. Players control a member of the USS Umbrella’s security team. They must stop Dr. Birkin’s plan to sell the G-Virus to the government. From there, the game allows for selecting four characters from six classes at the start. They have unique abilities and weapons. You should not forget to use the cover mechanics to make the matches more interesting. Infected humans and mercenaries become your opponents with different weaknesses that you can take advantage of. For the game modes, the game possesses a co-op connection between four players.

description: Injustice – Hero no Gekitotsu

name: Gran Turismo 6 - Anniversary Edition
description: The next stage in the evolution of the world’s most popular and comprehensive racing simulator is upon us. Gran Turismo 6, the latest installment in the highest-selling series, will reach stores this Holiday season. Known for blurring the lines between virtual and reality, the Gran Turismo series has revolutionized the racing genre in the last 15 years, allowing fans to drive the most prolific collection of cars on the world’s most legendary racetracks. Gran Turismo 6 takes the real driving simulator experience to a whole new level. Having set the standard for the racing genre in the last 15 years, the fully refined physics engine will create the most authentic true-to-life driving experience across more than 1200 vehicles on 33 locations with 71 different layouts. Box Contains Special Polyphony designed 15th Anniversary Steelbook GT6 game 1M in-game credits Custom paint chips, custom race suit, custom race helmet and custom avatars 20 cars with special 15th Anniversary custom livery and performance enhancement.

name: Uncharted 3 - Drake’s Deception - Special Edition

description: Injustice – Hero no Gekitotsu - Elite Pack

name: Just Cause 2
description: A familiar CIA agent named Rico returns and goes to Panau to find a colleague, Tom Sheldon, who is missing. The Agency wants their money back and thinks Tom switched sides. Rico must join the criminal groups to create chaos and the chance to find Tom. In addition, a vast island allows for exploring freely and supports cars, helicopters, and planes. Causing havoc earns points, which advances the story and unlocks items. With money and upgrades in hidden crates, players can order weapons and vehicles from the black market. Players can use more tools like the hook that pulls enemies or Rico. Players can perform many quick actions to progress, such as high-speed carjacks and unlocking gates.

name: Battlefield Hardline
description: INTRODUCTION Switching gears from the typical battlefield scene, “Battlefield Hardline” is the new age installment in the Battlefield series, traversing war zones to crime-ridden streets. Trading tanks for police cruisers, this adaptation brings an exciting blend of first-person shooting and crime thriller elements, masterfully crafted by Visceral Games, renowned for their chilling Dead Space series, rather than the usual Battlefield maestros, EA DICE. THE STRIKING STORY A departure from war-torn landscapes, “Battlefield Hardline” catapults players into the heart of the police vs. criminals struggle. As Nick Mendoza, a rookie detective with a score to settle, players are set on a cross-country chase against ex-partners-turned-lawbreakers, giving a fresh cinematic twist to the gaming experience. Borrowing from the formula of hit TV shows, the narrative is episodic, each with its unique cliffhangers. Sprinkled amidst the action, the game enriches its history with engaging detective sequences, where players can collect evidence, hunt down suspects, and complete side missions to gain the extra bucks for upgrades and weaponry. MAPS AND ENVIRONMENTS The gaming environment of “Battlefield Hardline” is magnified, exhibiting larger maps than its predecessors. While some may be comparatively smaller, the urban settings and the panoramic deserts of the United States lend a realistic vibe to the gameplay. Utilizing the Levolution system, a crowd-favorite from Battlefield 4, facilitates a high level of environmental destruction, thus making each playthrough unique. Coupled with an enhanced AI system, players are in for a distinct experience whenever they revisit a mission. THE THRILL OF MODERN COMBAT “Battlefield Hardline” is set in the current era, equipping players with an extensive arsenal of modern weapons, each fitted with tactical accessories, to wage war against crime. Besides the usual military-grade hardware, players can wield unconventional enforcement tools such as stun guns, sawed-off shotguns, and police batons. The game also offers a plethora of handy gadgets like zip lines and grappling hooks. The vehicular action is exciting, ranging from helicopters to civilian cars and combat vehicles to boats. MULTIPLAYER MADNESS As with any Battlefield game, the multiplayer component is the cornerstone of “Battlefield Hardline.” Players can join either the ranks of the law or the side of the lawbreakers, bringing an exhilarating PvP experience. The game introduces innovative modes like “Heist,” where players either commit the perfect bank robbery or stop it dead in its tracks, and “Blood Money,” a high-stakes, fast-paced struggle between two teams over a massive pile of cash. In “Rescue,” players partake in high-intensity hostage situations, and “Hotwire” mode puts players in a thrilling high-speed chase. Additionally, traditional methods like “Team Deathmatch” remain available, keeping the game rooted in its lineage. TEAMWORK MAKES THE DREAM WORK In multiplayer mode, efficient teamwork is the name of the game. The importance of collaboration is highlighted, with players stepping into the shoes of one of four character classes: the Operator, the Mechanic, the Enforcer, and the Professional. Each class is equipped with unique abilities and gear, driving the need for effective communication and cooperative strategies. Thus, in “Battlefield Hardline,” individual heroics give way to well-coordinated team efforts, making the victories all the more satisfying.

name: Minecraft Story Mode - The Complete Adventure
description: “Minecraft Story Mode: The Complete Adventure” is an action-adventure video game series developed by Telltale Games. Like previous games, the game is modeled on the Minecraft open-world game. “Minecraft Story Mode: The Complete Adventure” was released to fans in 2016 with new in-game improvements. Entering the game, players will create the appearance of the Lego character they will control. The game has all 8 Episode stories so the player can choose and start exploring that story. The player will control his character along with his friends to search for the Command of the Stone to save the world from terrorists. Players will choose the words displayed in the game to continue the story with everyone while exploring the world and on missions. The player will then control the character to search for weapons around the character to assemble into weapons for battle characters. Every choice of player’s dialogues of the player’s game will lead them to various mysterious stories in “Minecraft Story Mode: The Complete Adventure”

name: Mass Effect Trilogy
description: “Mass Effect Trilogy” is a special boxed set containing games belonging to the hit series of the same name including: “Mass Effect”, “Mass Effect 2” and “Mass Effect 3”. The first trilogy of games centered around a character created by the player called Commander Shepard and the mission to save the galaxy from a mechanical race called the Reaper, and his subordinates, including Saren Arterius. The first game to see Shepard faced Sovereign, a pioneering Reaper, who planned to allow the current Reaper fleet to hibernate in a dark space to invade the Milky Way and destroy all living life, continuing a mysterious cycle of destruction. The second game takes place two years later and shows Shepard fighting Collector, an alien race that kidnaps the entire human colony in a plan to help Reaper return to the Milky Way. The third and final version of the trilogy focuses on the final battle against Reaper. All of the first three major parts of the Mass Effect series have been credited with sales success as well as widespread acclaim. The trio is highly regarded for its storytelling, character development, voiceover, and the universe, and emphasizes the player’s choice that affects the experience of playing.

name: Mortal Kombat - Komplete Edition
description: Mortal Kombat Komplete Edition delivers the critically acclaimed game, all previously released downloadable content (DLC), plus digital downloads of the 2011 release of Mortal Kombat: Songs Inspired by the Warriors album with a bonus track, and the 1995 Mortal Kombat film on the PlayStation Store or Xbox Live Zune. The DLC includes fan-favorite warriors Skarlet, Kenshi and Rain, as well as the infamous dream stalker Freddy Krueger. The game also offers 15 Klassic Skins and three Klassic Fatalities (Scorpion, Sub-Zero and Reptile). Mortal Kombat: Songs Inspired by the Warriors is a collection of electronic music inspired by the game and is executive produced by JFK (of the DJ/ production duo MSTRKRFT and Death From Above 1979)

name: The Elder Scrolls V - Skyrim Legendary Edition
description: Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year awards, experience the complete Skyrim collection with The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Legendary Edition, including the original critically-acclaimed game, official add-ons – Dawnguard, Hearthfire, and Dragonborn – and added features like combat cameras, mounted combat, Legendary difficulty mode for hardcore players, and Legendary skills – enabling you to master every perk and level up your skills infinitely.

name: Battlefield 3
description: Battlefield 3 uses the Frostbite 2 engine and offers fast-paced multiplayer. To start the game, you can try a single-player campaign and a cooperative mode. Battlelog provides in-depth statistics and allows players to create Platoons. The campaign is set in 2014 and follows Staff Sergeant Henry Blackburn, who is interrogated about a potential attack on New York. Missions occur during his encounters with Blackburn with terrorists. Therefore, to solve them, you can find similar things to other shooters, including vehicle segments. Multiplayer modes possess Conquest, Rush, and Team Deathmatch, which you can choose from based on your preferences. Players can control various points on a map or destroy M-Com stations. The game balances teamwork and individual skill. Because of a range of weapons and vehicles, players can create many strategies to win.

name: Grand Theft Auto - Episodes from Liberty City
description: Grand Theft Auto: Episodes from Liberty City is a compilation disc with two expansion packs for GTA IV. The interesting point is that the game doesn’t require GTA IV to play. It includes The Lost and Damned and The Ballad of Gay Tony. This release marks the debut of these Windows expansions. In Liberty City, players follow a new storyline of the protagonist named Johnny Klebitz. He is the vice president of a biker gang while the president is in rehab. However, the president returns and causes conflicts. The game focuses on teamwork with gang members. Players must protect their peers. The city is fully accessible from the start. New vehicles, mostly bikes, are introduced. Johnny rides a custom, nearly indestructible bike. The story intersects with the plot of the original version. Niko Bellic appears and plays an important role. The events in both games occur simultaneously.

name: Need for Speed - Shift
description: For winning the Need for Speed World Tour, players should pass closed circuits or famous tracks. With skill and adjusted settings, they earn stars to unlock tiers and access the competition. Stars come from podium finishes and objectives with earned points through precision or aggression. To motivate players further, leveling up unlocks upgrades and bonuses and helps them receive badges. In addition, races take place in various locations and allow for customizing the cars. To improve their skills, players can try many objectives, from simple to challenging. The point system rewards different driving styles based on special events and unique challenges. The ultimate goal is becoming the champion. Therefore, customization options are available for cars and become necessary to express your style. The game balances realism and accessibility.

name: Gran Turismo 5 Prologue
description: GET READY TO BURN RUBBER: INTRODUCING GRAN TURISMO 5: PROLOGUE Gather round, racing enthusiasts and PlayStation fans, and buckle up for a fast-paced journey into the world of Gran Turismo 5: Prologue. This adrenaline-pumping game, developed by Polyphony Digital and published by Sony Computer Entertainment, has earned its place on the pedestal of racing video games for PS3. If you like the taste of tarmac, the sound of screeching tires, and the sight of dust kicked up by your competitors, you’re in for a treat! Let’s zoom into the nitty-gritty details. DRIVING WITH A PLOT TWIST Gran Turismo 5: Prologue does not disappoint with its unusual plot. While typical racing games focus solely on speed, GT5: Prologue adds a unique narrative twist. The game revolves around a character aiming for the pinnacle of motorsports glory. Alongside your racing career, there’s a subplot involving rivalry, treacherous curves of career decisions, and the passion that fuels the path to glory. This may sound like an excerpt from a thrilling novel, but who said race tracks couldn’t be filled with drama and suspense? CHARACTERS THAT DRIVE THE STORY The game is populated with characters that are as diverse as the cars you drive. The main character, a competitive driver with a heart full of high-octane fuel, is our underdog, striving for greatness internationally. Supporting characters include the sage-like mechanic, the main character’s mentor, rivals who spur the protagonist to push beyond their limits, and even a love interest thrown in for that extra gear of complexity. This rich blend of characters makes the storyline more than just about the next race; it’s about relationships, rivalries, and personal growth. TURNING ON THE IGNITION: FEATURES OF THE GAME Gran Turismo 5: Prologue is known for its impressive features. It boasts over 70 incredible vehicles from top manufacturers worldwide. You can race these speed machines across six stunningly designed tracks, including the Daytona International Speedway and the Suzuka Circuit. The game also has advanced physics, contributing to its highly realistic driving experience. The car handling, weather conditions, and even the impact of tire wear and fuel usage significantly influence the race outcomes. Now, if you think this sounds more like a physics lesson than a game, remember – it’s all fun and games until someone loses an axle because they ignored tire wear! THE CHECKERED FLAG: A CONCLUDING GLIMPSE In conclusion, Gran Turismo 5: Prologue is more than a racing game; it’s an immersive experience that combines high-octane racing with a gripping storyline and engaging characters. This game offers a unique blend of features that satisfies the need for speed while keeping players engaged with its compelling narrative. So, if you’re a fan of burning rubber, intense rivalries, and cars that are so realistic, you can almost smell the fresh leather, get ready to start your engines with Gran Turismo 5: Prologue! And remember, it’s not just about crossing the finish line—it’s also about the friends and rivals you meet along the way. Happy racing, folks!

The game is all about fast cars, with 64 vehicles in total. The Bugatti Veyron and the Subaru WRX STi are among them. Multiplayer online is available. Like other games in the series, the gameplay allows for stealth or shooting, but hiding to complete missions is still the most suitable.

name: Gran Turismo HD Concept
description: Gran Turismo HD Concept (グランツーリスモHDコンセプト Guran Tsūrisumo HD Konseputo) was the first installment of the Gran Turismo racing series to be released on the PlayStation 3. It was made available as a free download which was released on the PlayStation Store on December 24, 2006. A Blu-ray Disc version, called "Install Disc", was released in Japan in limited quantities in September 2007. This game was intended to be a sneak preview, in the likes of Gran Turismo Concept, preceding the release of a full version title but the Gran Turismo HD project was canceled and replaced by Gran Turismo 5 Prologue.

name: Resistance 2
description: Resistance 2 is set in an alternate history in the 1950s, which provides the backdrop. Europe was conquered by alien chimeras. After the previous version, this game follows in its footsteps. Nathan Hale is back in the lead role. In the US, he battles Chimera. Hale is on the task team known as The Sentinels and is able to manage his Chimeran infection through medication. There is a variety of weaponry in the game, but some are from the original game. At the same time, the capacity of weapons is restricted. The cover allows health to replenish. Both cooperative and competitive modes are available in multiplayer. You can play as one of eight different classes in co-op. Players can compete in teams of up to sixty in four primary modes of competition. In particular, chimerans and humans are both available to players and are divided into teams for larger battles. You can gain numerous qualities and complete various missions throughout the game.

name: Gran Turismo 6 - Master Collection
description: Gran Turismo 6 is the sixth game in the series that possesses new physics for tires and suspension. The game offers many tracks and cars. Therefore, players can enjoy special events like Vision GT and have a great time in the races. This feature includes futuristic car concepts to satisfy players’ curiosity. Players can even drive on the moon. The game has various new circuits. Some tracks have changing weather and time to give a new feeling. The night sky is accurate. Players can drive at Hadley Rille on the moon. The Top Gear track is not in this game. It’s now in a different racing series. The game has many features and options. Players can explore different locations and try various vehicles. The game provides a realistic driving experience by combining simulation with fun elements.

name: Metal Gear Solid V - The Phantom Pain - Complete Version
description: INTRODUCTION Consider “Metal Gear Solid 5: The Phantom Pain,” a fresh chapter in Konami’s renowned stealth action series from the Land of the Rising Sun. Created by the acclaimed Kojima Productions studio, this series traces its lineage back to the halcyon days of 1987, unfolding a complex narrative through its several core and numerous side titles. Each installment intertwines with the others, offering alternative viewpoints on the unfolding events over the years, all under the watchful eye of its creator and director, Hideo Kojima. A CLOSER LOOK AT THE MAIN CHARACTER The heart of “The Phantom Pain” lies in the figure of Punished Snake (familiarly known as Big Boss), an iconic protagonist in the expansive Metal Gear universe. Players acquainted with “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker” would find this character quite familiar. After nine grueling years in a coma, brought about by severe wounds, including losing his left hand, Snake awakens. These tumultuous events preceding his unconsciousness are narrated in the game’s prologue, “Ground Zeroes.” The story kicks into gear when, shortly after waking up, Snake’s hospital comes under siege, forcing him to make a daring escape. He isn’t alone, though. A shadowy patient, known only as Ishmael, lends a helping hand. A REVOLUTION IN GAMEPLAY The brains behind “The Phantom Pain” have infused considerable modifications into the gameplay mechanics. The most transformative of these? Introducing an open-world environment, a first for the series, provides players unparalleled freedom and diverse opportunities for amusement. Another significant update? The powerhouse FOX Engine, created by the tech wizards at Kojima Productions, is fueling the game. This cutting-edge tech boasts stunningly realistic visuals and enhanced physics capabilities that revolutionize the gaming experience. DIVE INTO THE OPEN WORLD A noteworthy aspect of the gameplay in “The Phantom Pain” is the open-world setting. This feature gives players the joy of exploration and allows them to select their path. It offers the freedom of choice and the ability to strategize while creating a more engaging and immersive experience. This open-world design and the innovative FOX Engine create a game world where the unexpected is the norm, and surprises lie in wait around every corner. THE FOX ENGINE: CRAFTING REALITY The FOX Engine, the heart that powers “The Phantom Pain,” is an engineering marvel. Developed by the talented programmers and engineers at Kojima Productions, the engine’s strengths are jaw-droppingly realistic visuals and advanced physics capabilities. These fundamental elements bring the game to life, making the Metal Gear universe more immersive. The fidelity of the visual details and the real-world physics create a gaming experience that is nothing short of breathtaking. REINVENTING THE METAL GEAR EXPERIENCE The creators of “The Phantom Pain” have done more than just update the game mechanics and introduce a stunning engine; they have reinvented the Metal Gear experience. The changes to gameplay, the evolution of the story, and the strikingly realistic visuals, are all combined into a holistic gaming experience that remains true to the core values of the series while pushing the boundaries of innovation. As we delve into the captivating universe of this game, it’s clear to see why it holds such a cherished spot in the hearts of gamers worldwide.

name: Elder Scrolls IV - Oblivion
description: Once upon a time, in the game world, a game known as “Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion” was unleashed upon the PlayStation 3 platform, forever changing the landscape of action role-playing games (RPGs). A brainchild of Bethesda Game Studios, Oblivion kept gamers captivated with its rich lore, immersive gameplay, and engaging character development. With humor tickling at the corners of every adventure, it’s as if every NPC (non-playable character) took a comedy course at the “Bethesda School of Laughs.” Get ready for a quirky, detailed, and delightful ride through the realms of Cyrodiil! THE ENGAGING PLOT Rumor has it that the game starts with the player’s character in jail (talk about hitting rock bottom early), but this isn’t your ordinary prison break story. The Emperor of Tamriel, Uriel Septim VII, trustingly hands over the Amulet of Kings, a family heirloom with tremendous power, to the player’s character. The goal? To find the lost heir and save the world from a Daedric invasion led by the mischievous god Mehrunes Dagon. Players journey through the world of Cyrodiil, battling various creatures and thwarting devious plots to restore balance to the realm. DIVERSE CHARACTERS Life in Oblivion is never dull, thanks to the many characters sprinkled throughout the game. Each character boasts a distinct personality, so it’s easy to distinguish Martin Septim’s earnest charm from the Adoring Fan’s zealous fandom. You might even encounter a talking dog or a rather articulate mud crab on your travels! Be it the wisecracking city guard who advises against swimming after a large meal or the friendly troll who bakes surprisingly tasty bread, every interaction in Oblivion is a memorable experience. MAIN FEATURES OF THE GAME “Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion” packs many gameplay features that have kept players hooked. For starters, the open-world design allows players to wander freely across the diverse landscapes of Cyrodiil, adding a sense of wonder and excitement to the exploration. You can be a mighty hero saving the world one quest at a time or spend hours hunting deer in the forest. Oblivion truly lets you play your way! The radiant AI system takes interactivity to a new level, with NPCs leading their own lives and reacting to the player’s actions realistically. Add to this the expansive skill and leveling system, coupled with the ability to create and customize your character, and it’s clear why this game has stood the test of time. AN UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEY In conclusion, “Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion” is more than a game; it’s a ticket to an unforgettable journey. It’s about befriending orcs, arguing with shopkeepers, and accidentally eating questionable mushrooms. It’s about the adrenaline rush of a last-minute save and the triumphant joy of defeating a demanding boss. Most importantly, it’s about laughter because where else can you have a deep philosophical conversation with a chicken? Only in Oblivion, my friends, only in Oblivion.

name: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 13 - Masters Collector's Edition
description: The world's number one selling golf video game franchise returns with an array of exciting new features, including an original feature that gives you the opportunity to experience first-hand Tiger's golf legacy! Relive Tiger Woods' most memorable golf moments from child prodigy to golfing legend! Also, through unique online and social features, create your own country club, and use coins earned through game play or team up with country club members to play exclusive golf courses. Offering even more access to The Masters tournament, this Collector's Edition includes five bonus golf courses as well as a version of the Augusta National Tournament Practice Facility. Also included is a unique in-game Green Jacket ceremony sequence and a variety of bonus pro-shop items.

name: Minecraft Story Mode
description: Minecraft: Story Mode is an ongoing episodic point-and-click graphic adventure video game that was based on the survival video game Minecraft, with the first episode released worldwide in October 2015 for Microsoft Windows, OS X, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, Wii U, Xbox 360, Xbox One, Android, and iOS, with subsequent episodes each following a month or two afterwards. The game was being developed by Telltale Games, in association with Mojang, the original developer of Minecraft. The game follows the episodic format that Telltale used for its titles The Walking Dead, The Wolf Among Us, Tales from the Borderlands and Game of Thrones, where player choices and actions have significant effects on later story elements, as well as the opportunity to tell a story in the otherwise open ended nature of Minecraft. The game centers around a new character, named Jesse, as they and their allies attempt to save their world.

name: Mass Effect 3
description: The Alliance military removes Shepard from service due to past Cerberus ties. The Reapers attack Earth suddenly, and the Defense Committee seeks Shepard’s help. Anderson reinstates him and sends Shepard to the Citadel for aid while Anderson stays to defend Earth. Mass Effect 3 concludes the trilogy and blends tactical combat with role-playing elements. Players can import saves from previous games, which affects the story. The game offers three modes: action, story, and role-playing. Combat features are similar to the previous game, but melee combat is enhanced. Weapons can be modified to upgrade abilities and add new options. The game introduces a new multiplayer mode called Galaxy at War. It allows up to four players to fight in the co-op with the choice of any race from the universe. In particular, the gameplay combines squad-based combat with character customization and dialogue choices. Throughout the game, players can select different classes and upgrade their skills based on their preferred style.

name: Street Fighter X Tekken - Legacy Edition
description: Street Fighter X Tekken combines two fighting game series. It uses Street Fighter mechanics with Tekken characters. The game has a 2D visual style and tag team gameplay. Players can switch characters during fights and combos. Victory comes when one character loses all health. Special attacks use a Cross Gauge. Street Fighter characters use six buttons, while Tekken characters use four. The game introduces Gem and Pandora systems. Gems boost character stats when activated. Pandora’s mode sacrifices one character to strengthen the other. Local and online multiplayer are available. The game focuses on fast-paced action and strategic character switching. Cross Rush, Cross Arts, and Cross Assault are key attack types you should choose depending on the situation and the opponents. Players must manage their Cross Gauge carefully to execute powerful moves. At the same time, the gem system creates curiosity for players because of character customization and strategy.

name: Assassin’s Creed I+II Welcome Pack - Premium Cut
description: When Altair and Ezio come together, they make you an irresistible deal. From Jerusalem to Renaissance Italy, the two assassins discover secrets hidden in the depths of history, and avenge the wrongs dealt to them. Although both games are now available as Best Priced Editions, this is a two games in one ultimate value pack.

name: Rayman Legends/Rayman Origins
description: The Rayman Origins & Rayman Legends Double Pack is a compilation of the two Rayman games, Rayman Origins and Rayman Legends. It was released in Europe on PC, Sony PlayStation 3, Sony PlayStation Vita, and Microsoft Xbox 360. It is available as either a physical copy or a digital download. At least some of the physical copies for PC use the Rayman Origins DVD from the 2013 Rayman Collection.

name: Castlevania - Lords of Shadow
description: Gabriel Belmont is a knight in the Brotherhood of Light. His wife’s soul is trapped between Earth and Heaven. The Lords of Shadow are responsible for this tragedy and possess a God Mask that can revive Marie. Therefore, Gabriel, Zobek, and another member have a journey across Earth. They face werewolves, vampires, and undead beings. Gabriel vows to save Marie, even if he risks falling into darkness. With a 3D reboot, Castlevania: Lords of Shadow is set in 1047 and is similar to God of War in gameplay. Players use a Combat Cross whip to fight enemies. They can buy combos with experience points. The whip can also be a grappling hook or saw. Gabriel gains light and dark magic abilities. Light magic heals, while dark magic increases damage. Players can use secondary items like silver daggers and holy water. The game features familiar characters and enemies, including a character guide and tips. When solving secret arks levels, players can collect magic gems to enhance their abilities. Everyone also replays levels to unlock trials and achievements. Therefore, the game offers over 20 hours of gameplay and high replayability.

Though the world has expanded, familiar aspects are still present. The Caribbean Sea is free for players to help them explore and satisfy their curiosity. There are three major cities besides minor ones. Edward knows where to look for treasure maps and how to hunt. He is granted access to the upgradeable ship named Jackdaw. name: Lego Batman - The Videogame - Titan Pack
description: This game adapts to make the Batman universe become LEGO characters. Environments are regular to the other version but side-scrolling with 3D depth. The story is new and not based on specific movies or comics to give you a diverse experience. For the plot, villains escape Arkham Asylum to create chaos in Gotham. Therefore, players follow Batman and Robin in brawler gameplay to solve puzzles, and enemies appear continuously. With the help, players can explore and switch between characters anytime to survive. Through the game, you can unlock more unique powers that come from changing suits. Each character has their unique powers. For example, Batman can glide or plant bombs, while Robin can walk on metal surfaces.

name: Demon’s Souls
description: King Allant roused the Old One in Boletaria. Demons were let loose by a fog, terrifying people. Boletaria can only be saved by one hero. Demon’s Souls is a role-playing game. Gamers select from various classes. Specially, five realms of demon bosses need to be defeated. Souls are obtained by defeating adversaries for the exchange of goods or improvements. Combat demands the management of stamina. Death lowers health rather than ends the game. Gamers can get back souls they’ve lost. There are online aspects to the game. Other players can send messages and appear as phantoms that can even invade other worlds or play in the co-op. The game mixes distinctive online features and has difficult gameplay that players should complete. It provides a complex, dark fantasy setting with various character options. To advance, players must plan ahead and take lessons from their mistakes.

name: Resident Evil 6
description: Resident Evil 6 continues the fight against zombies. In the beginning, players can choose from three scenarios that have different characters. However, they will have intertwined stories. At the same time, each scenario has unique scenes, locations, weapons, and enemies. The main storylines will follow Leon, Chris, and Jake. Two players can play each scenario together, or you can go through it with a bot partner. After finishing the main scenarios, you can unlock a secret story. The game has new enemies and upgradeable weapons. Players can use vehicles in some parts, so you should move in careful ways. Sometimes, the game provides you with some mini-games to change the experience.

name: Uncharted - Trilogy Edition
description: Uncharted: Trilogy Edition is a compilation pack for the PS3 which includes the following: – Uncharted: Drake’s Fortune – Uncharted 2: Among Thieves – Uncharted 3: Drake’s Deception, in three independent keep cases.

name: Resident Evil 6 - Infinity Pack
description: Resident Evil 6 continues the fight against zombies. In the beginning, players can choose from three scenarios that have different characters. However, they will have intertwined stories. At the same time, each scenario has unique scenes, locations, weapons, and enemies. The main storylines will follow Leon, Chris, and Jake. Two players can play each scenario together, or you can go through it with a bot partner. After finishing the main scenarios, you can unlock a secret story. The game has new enemies and upgradeable weapons. Players can use vehicles in some parts, so you should move in careful ways. Sometimes, the game provides you with some mini-games to change the experience.

name: Infamous
description: A massive explosion destroys parts of Empire City, but happily, Cole MacGrath survives and gains electric powers. Due to a sickness in the city, street gangs take control, and people blame Cole for the explosion. He must choose between using his powers for good or evil. Cole can become a superhero or a villain. inFAMOUS is an action game in an open city. Players control Cole to discover his abilities. Their actions determine if Cole becomes admired or feared, with reactions of citizens based on his reputation. The game is single-player with a fully explorable Empire City. A karma meter tracks good and bad deeds. In particular, experience points improve powers, but some upgrades require specific karma levels. Cole needs electricity to recharge, which can be challenging during power outages.

name: Assassin’s Creed - Rogue
description: Assassin’s Creed: Rogue allows players to follow Black Flag and join the events related to some game series. The gameplay combines land and naval exploration. Players control Shay Patrick Cormac, who becomes a Templar. At the same time, you will feel nostalgic when meeting many characters from previous games. During the French and Indian War, you will travel through main locations, like New York, River Valley, and the North Atlantic Ocean. Besides the journey with the ship named Morrigan, land missions are attached with new weapons and fighting mechanics. Assassins now use familiar techniques against the player. Hunting, building restoration, and gang control are side activities without the multiplayer mode.

name: The Chronicles Of Riddick - Assault On Dark Athena - Platinum Archive
description: The game includes two campaigns where players can continue their journey of players. Riddick and Johns are in hibernation, where Mercenaries find them and bring them aboard. In particular, they transform people into machines to have more benefits. Johns is valuable, so they will think of some solution to earn more money. From there, Riddick knows their plot and decides to escape. The long journey allows players to control Riddick in first-person view when focusing on stealth. There are many dark environments to hide and perform instant kills. Weapons range from fists to guns, and some modern inventions, like mech, are also used. Riddick can heal using NanoMED units with limited charges, so he should consider using them until they are refilled. Overall, the game combines stealth, action, and exploration elements.

name: Batman - Arkham City - Gold Edition
description: Batman: Arkham City is a sequel to Arkham Asylum with the same-name protagonist. Eighteen months after the first game, Quincy Sharp becomes mayor and creates a large prison in Arkham City. Batman enters the prison as Bruce Wayne and fights against Hugo Strange and other villains. The story involves a disease and a secret plan. Many famous characters appear in the game with an open world to explore. Batman can fight, use gadgets, and solve puzzles. He can choose between direct attacks or stealth. Batman has improved abilities and new gadgets through many missions; for example, the Detective mode helps with investigations. Players can complete side quests and collect Riddler trophies. Catwoman is also playable in some missions. The combat system allows for chained combos and throws. Batman’s arsenal includes familiar and new gadgets that are used for fighting, puzzle-solving, and traversing the environment. In the mix of action-and-strategy gameplay, the grappling hook and line launcher have been improved. New gadgets also include ice grenades and disruptors.

name: Dark Souls
description: Long ago, dragons controlled the globe, but they were killed off when humans arrived later. In a fierce struggle, the Four Lords vanquished the dragons. This situation also didn’t endure long because of the start of the Age of Fire. In this world, an odd ailment known as the Darksign can make people cursed to become undead. Therefore, they would keep coming back from the dead until they went insane. One day, a Chosen Undead would manifest. A zombie broke out of an asylum. It was thought to be a sign. Dark Souls is a role-playing game. Gamers can personalize their appearance and select character classes. There are opponents in places that are connected. Combat demands close monitoring of endurance and vigor. In particular, Dark Souls is renowned for its difficulty because common foes in Lordran are not always harmless. Players can communicate through a special internet mechanism. Players can upgrade their skills and gear if they have enough Souls. Humanity has unique advantages and is a rare currency.

name: Yakuza 0
description: Yakuza 0 takes place 10 years before the original game in Kamurocho and Osaka. The plot focuses on Kiryu and Goro. Their destiny, in particular, has a relation in every few chapters, but they never meet. Kiryu or Goro have unique fighting styles, which can be upgraded through challenges and money. In particular, battles involve random encounters with gangs and other yakuza that always happen in reality. Players can use weapons, objects, and special attacks during fights. Through the exploration, you can receive side quests and interact with various characters. At the same time, you can develop the aspect of business management. Kiryu deals with real estate in Kamurocho, while Goro manages host clubs in Osaka. The two persons must compete against local monopolies to earn income and become the top in the businesses.

name: Journey
description: Journey features a robed character exploring a vast desert. Players guide the character towards a distant mountain without explicit instructions. The game has no HUD or hazards. Players can move and whistle to activate glyphs. Flying is possible by using cloth pieces. As the journey progresses, these abilities improve through the main challenge of finding ways to advance. An online cooperative mode allows anonymous players to travel together, but communication is limited to movement and whistling. Proximity between characters enables flying charges. The game focuses on aesthetic cooperation rather than challenges. Although they don’t affect gameplay, hidden glyphs can be activated. The game reveals companions’ usernames after completion. It also emphasizes exploration, simple interactions through a serene atmosphere, and a unique gaming experience.

description: Borderlands Triple Pack

name: Need for Speed - Rivals
description: INTRODUCTION The thrill of flooring the pedal in the high-stakes, fast-paced world of “Need for Speed Rivals” is an experience like no other. This iteration of the famed Electronic Arts racing franchise allows players to test their mettle across various platforms, including PC and PS4. The real kick comes in choosing one’s path – as fearless speedsters ripping the asphalt apart or as the law-enforcement units armed with supercars, ready to take down those daredevils. EMBRACE YOUR INNER RACER OR LAWMAN A unique element that sets “Need for Speed Rivals” apart from its predecessors is the ability to choose a career path as either a racer or a police officer. As a racer, it’s all about gaining points through speed and evasion. These points can then be used to purchase state-of-the-art cars or perform eye-catching modifications that add to the aesthetics and boost your vehicle’s performance. However, the twist is that getting busted or wrecking your car will cost you your hard-earned points. Conversely, as a cop, you get to work with your team to hunt down the ‘speed kings,’ earning higher ranks and unlocking increasingly powerful police cars as you proceed. INNOVATIVE TECH MAKES FOR THRILLING CHASES Both career paths in “Need for Speed Rivals” offer a shared feature – the use of cutting-edge technologies that aid in both pursuit and escape. From unleashing EMP charges to summoning police helicopters, the game has it all. Then supercharged engines deliver a sudden surge of power when you need it most. These advanced technologies add a new strategic element to the race, making each high-speed chase more electrifying than the last. SEAMLESS SWITCH BETWEEN SINGLE AND NETWORK MODE WITH ‘ALL DRIVE’ The’ All Drive’ module is one of the game’s flagship features. This ingenious mechanic allows players to effortlessly switch between single-player and network modes without losing progress in the campaign. It brilliantly bridges the gap between offline and online gameplay, making it an integral part of the game. REALISTIC GRAPHICS COURTESY OF THE FROSTBITE 3 ENGINE “Need for Speed Rivals” operates on the tried-and-true Frostbite 3 engine, an industry stalwart known for its exceptional detail and realistic environment renderings. The racing takes place in the visually stunning Redview County, complete with bustling cities, extensive highways, lush forests, barren deserts, and challenging mountain areas. The freedom to explore the world, discover special locations, and trigger unique actions such as breaking speed records at speed cameras adds another dimension to the gameplay. DETAILED CAR MODELS, INCLUDING THE RETURN OF THE FERRARI The attention to detail extends to the cars themselves. Each “Need for Speed Rivals” vehicle is designed meticulously, promising an immersive experience for car enthusiasts. The game also marks the triumphant return of Ferrari cars, including the gorgeous F12 Berlinetta, further adding to the game’s appeal to petrolheads worldwide. It’s clear why “Need for Speed Rivals” is a fan-favorite racing game – the combination of choice, technology, immersion, and exceptional attention to detail makes it an undeniably thrilling ride.

description: The Webhallem Edition of Dark Souls II comes in a numbered bag and metal case and includes the following content: Limited Dark Souls Hood 30cm tall Warrior Knight Figurine Limited Ring in a pouch and engraved text “Go Beyond Death” Official Soundtrack CD Autenthic Cloth Game Map Collectible hardbound artbook This edition is limited to only 740 pieces. name: Soulcalibur V
description: The SoulCalibur games are 3D fighting games. Players fight opponents using weapons. You have many choices depending on your like. For the story, the game focuses on Patroklos, who helps his cursed sister, Pyrrha. You will love 28 playable characters, and 10 are new. Therefore, you can find the one that is suitable for playstyle and go through different modes. Especially besides Story mode, players can participate in Quick Battle, Arcade, and Training. To determine your power limits, Online mode is a suitable choice when fighting against skilled opponents. The story is told through voiced pictures and cutscenes to attract players. Overall, players can fight various difficulties when choosing between single-player and multiplayer experiences.

name: BioShock
description: BioShock is a first-person shooter game set in 1960, when the story begins with a crashing plane in the Atlantic Ocean. Happily, the only survivor named Jack, finds an underwater city called Rapture that was built in the 1940s as a paradise of free will. However, Jack discovers chaos and ruin instead. He must learn about Rapture’s fate while trying to survive. The game has elements similar to System Shock games. Rapture’s setting combines sci-fi, art deco, and steampunk styles. The plot unfolds through recorded messages left by inhabitants. Players can use firearms and plasmids, which are like magic abilities against deformed citizens called Splicers. Therefore, combat involves using different weapons and plasmids strategically. Players can also hack devices and customize their characters. The game blends action with light RPG elements, but it focuses more on combat than its predecessors

name: Killzone 3 - Legacy Bundle
description: The game starts after the events of the previous version when ISA forces attacked Helghan and eliminated Emperor Visari. Therefore, troops are pulling back to the fleet. Players control Sergeant Tomas Sevchenko with his comrade Ricardo Velasquez to face heavy resistance. While retreating, Rico disobeys orders to save pinned soldiers, although they are in a dangerous situation. Six months later, after returning to Earth, the Helghast senate elects Admiral Orlock to hold the position of leader. After the war, Chairman Stahl develops a deadly weapon to attack Earth. To stop the plot of the enemies, Rico and Sev should rescue prisoners and be ready for any war that will happen. In particular, the game improves on its predecessor through the use of turrets and vehicles for more firepower. You can find new galaxy technologies like a new jet-pack that allows limited flight.

name: Assassin’s Creed II
description: The Templars apprehended Desmond Miles, and the Animus device helped him relive past events and go up against the Templars with new friends. Desmond discovers the existence of Ezio in 15th-century Italy thanks to the upgraded device. At the same time, the cities of Italy serve as the backdrop with the Renaissance culture and historical personalities. Players have the option to ride horses or walk around urban areas. Items, weaponry, and armor can be purchased by players with additional weapon types at their disposal. A wide array of weaponry and armor are at Ezio’s disposal. All across the game globe, players can find treasure. The game has both combat and open-world exploration. The ability to swim and use boats is offered to the players. From rooftops, you can see the entire landscape using Eagle Vision. An integral part of the gameplay is the ability to run and jump freely.

name: Mass Effect - Elite Collection
description: INTRODUCTION Revolutionizing the RPG landscape with its dynamic elements of action, Mass Effect on PS3 emerges as an elaborate brainchild of the esteemed BioWare, the brilliant minds behind notable titles such as Baldur’s Gate, Neverwinter Nights, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic. Marking the inception of a trilogy, this gaming spectacle delves into an intricate universe brimming with action, alliances, and alien civilizations. ENGAGING PLOTLINE WITH MEANINGFUL CONSEQUENCES Unfolding in the year 2183, the narrative of Mass Effect catapults players into a universe where humanity treads a path peppered with cooperation and conflicts and ceaselessly strives for dominance amidst alien civilizations. Gamers step into the boots of Commander Shepard, humanity’s first Spectre and a dedicated harbinger of peace. His colossal mission? Thwart the nefarious plans of Saren, a renegade operative with a vengeful grudge against the human race. Shepard and his team embark on a thrilling expedition across uncharted worlds, only to uncover threats far more dire than initially anticipated. A VIBRANT UNIVERSE OF DISCOVERY AND STRATEGY Beyond the captivating narrative with its impactful choices that shape the fate of an entire galaxy, Mass Effect also excels at offering explorative gameplay. Players unveil lost civilizations, encounter fascinating life forms, procure vital resources, and unlock potent technologies. The game’s strategic depth is further amplified with a team command system that transforms battles into tactical contests. As the leader of a three-member team, Shepard exercises the power to direct his comrades, strengthening them over time by channeling experience points into specific skills. THE MAKO AND THE STARS BEYOND Mass Effect enhances its interstellar allure by arming players with their starships. This formidable vessel serves as a ticket to cosmic exploration across myriad planets. But the thrill doesn’t stop there; including Mako, a robust combat vehicle, enriches ground-based movements and conflicts. Whether soaring through the cosmos or navigating the challenges of alien terrains, the game ensures that adrenaline never leaves the side of its players. THE ESSENCE OF EQUIPMENT MANAGEMENT While captivating plots and stellar explorations contribute significantly to the game’s appeal, the importance of equipment management in Mass Effect cannot be overstated. Players must thoughtfully allocate time to carefully select their gear, comprising armor, weapons, accessories, and more. The balance between offense and defense, aggression and caution, firepower and resilience hinges on the player’s ability to choose wisely and gear appropriately. DIALOGUE SYSTEM THAT BREATHES LIFE INTO CHARACTERS Finally, one of the crowning glories of Mass Effect is the lifelike Non-Player Characters (NPCs) dotting the universe. Thanks to the comprehensive dialogue system crafted by BioWare, interactions with these characters feel more like intricate conversations rather than transactional exchanges. These engagements, rich in depth and personality, make the universe feel alive and responsive, further immersing players into the vast, captivating cosmos of Mass Effect.

name: Uncharted 3 - Drake’s Deception - Special Edition - Ultimate Cut
description: The Explorer Edition comes with a Wooden Travel Case that can hold up to 19 PS3 games and includes: Uncharted 3: Drake’s Deception (Special Edition) Full size replica of Drake’s belt buckle Full size replica of Drake’s necklace Exclusive statue of Nathan Drake from Sideshow Collectibles Uncharted 3 PS3 Slim custom sticker

name: BioShock Infinite
description: Booker DeWitt must find Elizabeth in Columbia to pay his debts. The floating city has warring factions. Especially, Elizabeth has mysterious powers. She will help the Booker in the travel of two peoples, but they are hunted by Comstock and Songbird. The game uses mechanics from previous BioShock titles. Vigors give players superpowers, such as controlling crows or charming enemies. Possession is a vigor that can control humans or machines, so you will discover more vigor with multiple uses. To defeat many strong enemies, Booker can be upgraded with gear and permanent bonuses. Different gear types can be equipped as needed to adapt to any dangerous situation in the journey. The setting explores exceptionalism, religion, and racism. Elizabeth can create tears in space-time, revealing parallel universes.

name: Killzone 2
description: In the same-name series, Killzone 2 stands as the third installment. The game unfolds in Helghan, the Helghast’s homeworld. To quell the war machine and apprehend Emperor Visari, the ISA retaliates on Helghan’s territory. Therefore, players control Sergeant Tomas “Sev” Sevchenko, a seasoned member of the special forces. Sev commands a band of warriors against the Helghast menace. Cinematic, staged action is the main focus of the gameplay. Played from a first-person perspective but can be switched to a different view for vehicle combat. Sneaking up on an opponent while hiding is a common tactic. Warzone is the multiplayer mode and offers seven different classes and five different mission kinds. At the same time, you can add bots to fill spaces when there are not enough 32 players.

name: Assassin’s Creed III
description: Assassin’s Creed III is a historical action-adventure game and also the fifth main game in the series. It follows Desmond Miles and his ancestors. Desmond uses a machine called Animus to relive memories and seek answers about a threat to Earth. The game takes place in Colonial America during the American Revolution. The main character is Connor, a Mohawk tribe member, and players also control his father. Because of an open-world environment, they can explore Boston, New York, and other locations. Naval missions are also included. The game incorporates historical figures and events to create motivation from players. Gameplay involves stealth, combat, and exploration. The Animus creates a virtual reality experience. Desmond also has missions in the present day that take place in various countries. The game blends historical fiction with science fiction elements.

name: Resident Evil - Chronicles HD Collection
description: INTRODUCTION The chronicle of the Resident Evil: Chronicles franchise is an intriguing tale unto itself. Birthed from the renowned survival horror series that Capcom has been churning out since ’96, this offshoot diverges from the usual gameplay path. Its genre isn’t the classic third-person action games that fans have come to know and love, but rather first-person rail shooters—a venture designed to harness the power of the Wii Remote. The devs surmised that the PlayStation Move could achieve a similar impact, leading them to shape the Resident Evil: Chronicles HD compilation with this intent for the PS3 platform. GAMES INCLUDED IN THE BUNDLE The Chronicles HD compilation doesn’t just offer one game; it hands you two exclusive titles previously nestled in the Nintendo Wii’s library. The games included are Resident Evil: The Umbrella Chronicles from 2007 and Resident Evil: The Darkside Chronicles, which arrived two years later in 2009. That’s twice the fun, twice the thrill, and twice the nightmare-infused adrenaline! PLOT OF THE UMBRELLA CHRONICLES Now let’s talk about the plot for The Umbrella Chronicles. This narrative is a compressed overview of the storylines from Resident Evil Zero, Resident Evil, and Resident Evil 3: Nemesis. Additionally, it adds an extra layer of story involving the downfall of the infamous Umbrella Corporation. As players, you can step into the shoes of several familiar characters like Rebecca Chambers, Billy Coen, and even the ominous Albert Wesker, as well as others. The playground is vast, from haunted mansions and police stations to rustic villages and the eerily familiar streets of Raccoon City. THE DARKSIDE CHRONICLES STORYLINE Moving onto The Darkside Chronicles, the spotlight is on Leon S. Kennedy and Claire Redfield, familiar faces from Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil Code: Veronica X. The narrative weaves in new elements, intertwining them with the original threads of Leon and Claire’s stories, promising a thrilling revisit for the veterans and a terrifying welcome for the newbies. TECHNICAL ACHIEVEMENTS OF CHRONICLES HD Compared to their original versions, the games packaged in the Chronicles HD bundle for PS3 showcase impressive technical upgrades. They boast High-Definition graphics, PlayStation Move controller compatibility, and even an achievements system. You heard right; this compilation lets you flex your survival horror skills with shiny trophies to show off! And although the PlayStation Move was a focus, fear not – you can still play these games with your trusty regular gamepad. PURCHASING OPTIONS Lastly, let’s talk about purchasing options because, let’s face it, we all love choices. The PS3 compilation of Chronicles HD is purchasable as a complete bundle on the PlayStation Network service. However, if you’re more inclined towards one title than the other, or your wallet isn’t quite as generous, you can buy either game separately. Because in the world of Resident Evil, flexibility is just as important as survival.

name: Dead Space
description: The Ishimura, a starship, sends a distress signal during a mining operation on Aegis VII. Another ship goes to investigate. Happily, it causes it to crash into the Ishimura. The crew is attacked by terrifying monsters, and only three people survive, including an engineer named Isaac Clarke. To survive, he must fix the ship’s damaged systems and discover the truth behind the events. Dead Space is a third-person sci-fi shooter with elements of survival horror. Players control Isaac, fighting reanimated corpses called Necromorphs. This combat is related to strategic dismemberment with mining tools. It is considered a weapon with secondary fire modes that Isaac can also have special abilities. With the theme of the galaxy, the game includes zero-gravity sections.

name: LittleBigPlanet 2
description: LittleBigPlanet 2 is a side-scrolling platformer. It allows players to move between three plains. The game features Sackboy as the main character. He must save Craftworld and Avalonia. An inter-dimensional vacuum cleaner called the Negativatron threatens these worlds. Sackboy teams up with Larry Da Vinci and The Alliance. They work together to defeat the enemy and create their own levels. It includes more sophisticated customization tools that provide more options for complex content. One new feature is the Controlinator. It allows players to assign action triggers to controller buttons. Another addition is Sackbots. These are AI-controlled sack-people. LittleBigPlanet 2 builds on its predecessor’s gameplay. However, it introduces new elements to enhance the experience so players can enjoy unfolding the main story and their own adventures.

description: The Tomb Raider Trilogy includes three games and extra content when you still follow Lara Croft, a brave explorer. She searches for ancient artifacts and solves puzzles after traveling to exotic locations worldwide. Therefore, she encounters friends and foes along the way. The gameplay focuses on action and adventure, and our heroine can run, swim, and use new tools. Through the adventure and flashbacks, the story reveals the past that explains her motivations and personal struggles. Amanda Evert returns to become a rival, and you should compete with her to receive a powerful artifact. At the same time, players must overcome challenges and uncover secrets. Lara will go from the Himalayas to England. This is surely a great adventure for players.

name: Burnout Paradise – The Ultimate Box
description: Burnout Paradise does not have Game menus. Paradise City is open for players to explore with the start of an event at every intersection. In Showtime mode, players can crash at any location. Credit is earned for licenses and cars in the primary game mode. Five different events exist: Burning Route, Marked Man, etc. Over 80 automobiles are in the game, but if you do not drive carefully, they can receive realistic damage. Environmental harm is another possibility that can help you have a realistic race. The game allows you to take camera-based mugshots because pictures related to the defeat of players are taken. There are add-ons for the game, like the Cagney Pack, the Bikes Pack, and the Party Pack. For the challenging lovers, there are trophies in the PlayStation 3 version when they pass the specific demands. In addition, you should not skip several little enhancements to the game.

name: Minecraft - Story Mode
description: “Minecraft: Story Mode” is a series of point-and-click adventure video games developed by Telltale Games. The game was developed based on the Minecraft Sandbox video game. Telltale Games has released the first 5 episodes of the series in October 2015 and the next 3 episodes in March 2016. In the game, the main character that the player will control is called Jesse, probably male or female at the will of the player to join the journey to save the world and defeat Hurricane Wither. Players can create Jesse character appearance such as gender, skin color, outfit, … Like previous games, “Minecraft: Story Mode” allows players to collect items, prizes Quiz and chat with other characters in the game to learn about the plot and identify the next goals they have to accomplish. Every player’s decision will greatly influence the events in the current and subsequent game episodes. In addition to the puzzles in the game, players can also participate in other action battle scenes through fast-time events to defeat the enemies along the way. “Minecraft: Story Mode” also has other main characters like Jesse’s friends and pet pig.

name: Hitman - Absolution
description: Agent 47 returns in this version when following Blood Money’s events. Diana Burnwood goes rogue, and Benjamin Travis orders her assassination. Therefore, Agent 47 must kill the target and retrieve a teenage girl. He hesitates to kill Diana and opens a larger conspiracy. Through the linked missions, players go to many locations, eliminate targets, and escape undetected. Stealth and non-lethal approaches earn more points and require many strategies. Through upgrades, you can optimize the skills of Agent 47s. The Instinct allows wall vision, point shooting, and bluffing. In addition, the performance of a hitman can be shown by using covers, dragging bodies, and realizing acrobatics. The game focuses on stealth actions when you can perform combat and receive fewer rewards.

name: Grand Theft Auto V (GTA 5) - Definitive Edition
description: Grand Theft Auto V is set in Los Santos with three exceptional protagonists: Michael, Trevor, and Franklin. Players can switch between them instantly because each character has unique missions and personalities. At the same time, they often work together for heists that require planning and hiring henchmen. The gameplay involves gunfights and an open world. Players can steal various vehicles and roam freely or complete missions. Illegal activities are possible, but they increase the wanted level. In particular, police pursue players with high wanted levels. Players can lose the police by hiding or changing vehicles. Michael meets Franklin during a car repossession job. They become friends and burn down a mansion together, which belongs to a drug lord. He demands compensation. Michael and Franklin rob a jewelry store. Trevor, Michael’s old partner, joins them after hearing about the heist. Their lives then become increasingly chaotic.

name: Resistance - Fall Of Man
description: The game is a first-person shooter. The U.S. and Britain fought together against the Chimera. This monster infects life forms and turns them into mutants without conscience. Players control Nathan Hale, who is a U.S. Army Ranger. Hale battles hordes of Chimera to destroy all monsters and save the world. The game has a single-player campaign and multiplayer modes. It offers co-op and split-screen options with customizable online gameplay. The game uses a motion sensor feature that helps players escape from enemies. There are many weapons to choose from. Players can use at least a dozen different weapons based on their preference. The game combines action and strategy elements. It provides an immersive experience for players who enjoy shooters and sci-fi themes to become true heroes.

description: Far Cry: Wild Expedition is a compilation bundle of the games in the Far Cry franchise, released to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the original game. The bundle contains Far Cry 2, Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon, whilst releases outside of the United States additionally include Far Cry Classic, an HD remake of the first game in the series.

name: Uncharted 2 - Among Thieves - Fortune Hunter Edition
description: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves is a 2009 action-adventure third-person shooter platform video game developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 3 game console. It is a sequel to the 2007 game Uncharted: Drake’s Fortune. It was first shown and announced on December 1, 2008. Officially announced in the January 2009 issue of Game Informer, it was released in October 2009. The story follows Nathan Drake, as he travels around the world, along with Chloe Frazer and old friends Elena Fisher and Victor Sullivan to find the fabled Cintimani Stone and Shangri-La in a race against Serbian mercenaries. The plot draws heavy inspiration from Marco Polo and his travels through Asia, which sets many plot points along the way. A widespread critical success, Uncharted 2 received praise for its elaborate set pieces, character design, storytelling, graphics, technical innovation, and gameplay mechanics. It was named by Metacritic as the most critically acclaimed game of 2009 It went on to win the Game of the Year (or equivalent) award from each of the following: IGN, Eurogamer, Game Informer, Joystiq, Kotaku, Giant Bomb, AIAS, X-Play, Game Developers Choice Awards, and the Spike Video Game Awards for the year 2009. It is widely considered one of the greatest video games of all time. The game has also proved a commercial success, having since sold over 6 million copies worldwide. A sequel, Uncharted 3: Drake’s Deception, was released in November 2011. The game was re-released for the PlayStation 4 in October 2015, along with the other two entries in the series as part of Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection.

name: Metal Gear Solid V - Ground Zeroes
description: The game still remains the core gameplay that becomes the signature of all series. Players will try the stealth and action experiences. For the plot, the game takes place after Peace Walker but before The Phantom Pain and has an open world with a day-night cycle. Players control Big Boss (Snake) in 1975 to infiltrate Camp Omega and rescue Paz and Chico. The game offers freedom in approach. Players can use stealth or direct combat, but you will find ways to use these actions conveniently. At the same time, Snake can mark enemies with binoculars to make the secret attack more accurate. The stealth is always attached to the surrounding environment and shadows. The climax will appear when players are detected and try to avoid the alerts.

Players can choose from four characters with unique abilities. In this version, the new features are the low gravity and O2 kits. You will use these kits to provide air and enhance movement. Players should pay attention to new weapons, including laser guns and cryogenic weapons that can freeze enemies and smash them.

description: Crysis 2 is a first-person shooter video game developed by Crytek, published by Electronic Arts and released in North America, Australia and Europe in March 2011 for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360. Officially announced on June 1, 2009, the game is the second main installment of the Crysis series, and is the sequel to the 2007 video game Crysis, and its expansion Crysis Warhead.[2] The story was written by Richard Morgan,[3] while Peter Watts was consulted and wrote a novel adaptation of the game.[4] It was the first game to showcase the CryEngine 3 game engine and the first game using the engine to be released on consoles.

name: Dark Souls - Artorias of the Abyss - Definitive Pack
description: Dark Souls: Artorias of the Abyss is a downloadable content pack for the 2011 action role-playing game Dark Souls. Artorias of the Abyss is set a hundred years before the events of Dark Souls. The player is taken back into the past by a primeval human known as Manus, Father of the Abyss, who was resurrected and tortured by the sorcerers of Oolacile a century prior, hoping to unlock his dark power. Manus' power went wild and created the Abyss, a dark void that threatens to swallow the entirety of Oolacile. Anor Londo sent Knight Artorias to slay Manus, but he was unable to withstand the dark onslaught due to his lack of Humanity and became possessed himself, only able to save his wolf companion, Sif.

It takes place in decayed and overgrown Aperture Science Labs. The gameplay revolves around portals. Players can shoot portals to bridge gaps. Test chambers require solving puzzles with cubes, turrets, and platforms. GLaDOS returns, but her role changes. Chell gets help from Wheatley, a small robot. description: Metal Gear Solid 4 is the fourth main game in the series and concludes the previous version’s plot. It brings back many familiar characters with the main antagonist, Liquid Ocelot. The story unfolds through lengthy cut-scenes, so the series knowledge is helpful. Solid Snake looks old due to accelerated aging but is on a mission to stop Liquid Ocelot. In 2014, Liquid plans to control the Sons of the Patriots system and wants to build an army. The game has five acts and an epilogue. New actions include rolling, firing, and hiding in bins. With the improved camera, shooting now uses a shoulder perspective. Close Quarters Combat is redesigned to allow Snake to interrogate guards. Octocamo replaces the old camouflage system with a stress meter instead of a stamina one. The game offers many weapons and gadgets that players can customize. In addition, the Solid Eye and Metal Gear Mk.II are new tools.

They are larger and have unique abilities. The character changes become easier when players can switch and use other figures on the portal. Levels have platform maps with puzzles, enemies, and treasures with a three-star rating. After clearing the first level, players can replay it to reach high performances. In many reward types, some treasures give equipment that changes characters’ looks and improves abilities.

name: Uncharted 3 - Drake’s Deception - Ultimate Collection
description: Drake’s Deception is the third Uncharted game. It follows Nathan Drake, an adventurer. Sully is his loyal friend. The story shows Nathan’s youth and modern times. A new melee combat system is introduced. Players can kick and evade enemy attacks. Quick-time events are used in combat. The game searches for the lost city Iram. The adventure spans diverse environments in many locations, including England, France, Syria, and a large desert. The gameplay is similar to the previous version. Climbing and shooting are still important. Cinematics blend seamlessly with gameplay. Stealth is now encouraged. Players can collect artifacts for trophies. Puzzles require manipulating items and using Drake’s notebook. Hints appear if players struggle to help Drake pass new challenges and mysteries. The game has 22 story chapters and balances action, puzzle-solving, and exploration. Multiplayer modes are included.

Two new chapters are included when following Chris and Jill in a mansion and telling about Jill after a fight. The interesting things found in this edition are the new costumes, the The-Mercenaries-Reunion mode, and an online mode. For the original plot, players will follow Chris when he goes to Africa and teams up with Sheva. The infected creatures called majini are the target for this mission. Like the previous game, Chris faces enemies with guns and melee attacks. A second player can control her locally or online, so you can play with your friend and go through the dangerous areas.

name: Borderlands 2
description: Borderlands 2 is a first-person shooter game after five years from the first game. A new mineral called Eridian was discovered on Pandora, so Hyperion Corporation decided to occupy the planet. Four vault hunters fall into Jack’s trap. Happily, a ClapTrap robot rescues them and leads them to a resistance group. The game combines shooting with role-playing elements because players can choose from their favorite class. It has unique skills and weapon preferences. The RPG elements are present through experience points, which allow players to upgrade skills. Weapons vary in stats and elemental damage. Players can play alone or with others in multiplayer mode. The game world is now continuously connected. Non-player characters have schedules and move around. This is different from the first game, where they stayed in one place.
