name: Killzone Trilogy
description: INTRODUCTION In a world where retreat has no place, the Killzone Trilogy defies the norms. In a unique box set, brace yourself to conquer the unforgiving and cunning Helghast through Killzone, its sequel, and the third installment. The groundbreaking series starts with the original game, now embellished with HD visuals remastered to a clarity you’ve never experienced before. Take a partner into the fray with the high-stakes two-player campaign mode of the second and third installments. To top it all off, the box set also includes the Killzone 2 Map Pack Bundle and Killzone 3 Map Pack Bundle. If you already own the latter two games, you can get your hands on Killzone alone via the PlayStation Store. Now, let’s embark on the journey to explore the allure of this fascinating game trilogy. ALLURE OF REMASTERED HIGH-DEFINITION VISUALS The beauty of the Trilogy starts with the presentation – in splendid High Definition. The remastered HD visuals in the original game are like adding a fresh coat of ultra-glossy paint to an already classic sports car. It heightens the experience and makes everything more vivid, accurate, and enjoyable. These enhanced graphics are not mere window dressing but essential to the occasion. They bring every particle of the hostile environment, every facial expression of the brutal Helghast, and every intricate detail of weaponry into sharp focus. It is a symphony for your eyes that commands you to play on. ENGAGING TWO-PLAYER CAMPAIGN MODE Next is the two-player campaign mode in this captivating Trilogy’s second and third installments. Here, camaraderie and strategy form a potent mix. The feeling of having a comrade, a fellow soldier, sharing your battles and victories elevates the gameplay to a new level. You and your partner strategize, communicate, adapt, and conquer together. It’s you and them against a common enemy – an experience that’ll pump your adrenaline like nothing else. INCLUDES BONUS MAP PACK BUNDLES The Trilogy comes with an extra kick – the addition of the Killzone 2 and 3 Map Pack Bundles. Think of these as your playgrounds of destruction. These maps provide new terrain, challenges, and opportunities to test combat skills. The fact that these are included in the bundle makes this package’s value sky-high. Every map presents a new theatre of war, a new battlefield to conquer – each one is a test of your mastery of the game. INTELLIGENT AND CHALLENGING OPPONENT – THE HELGHAST Let’s talk about your foe. The Helghast aren’t your run-of-the-mill enemies who roll over at the first sign of danger. No, they are intelligent, strategic, and ruthless. The AI of the Helghast challenges you at every turn, providing a gripping contest of skill and strategy. Their unpredictability and intensity make every encounter feel fresh and exciting. You must adapt, strategize, and bring your A-game whenever you face them. This game doesn’t require you to play – it demands that you think. THE CHOICE TO DOWNLOAD KILLZONE SEPARATELY And finally, for those who have already savored the thrill of the second and third games, there’s an option to download the original Killzone separately via the PlayStation Store. This caters to players who want to revisit the series’ origins without purchasing the complete trilogy set. It’s a thoughtful feature that respects the existing fanbase, reinforcing the love for the series and its history. In the end, the Trilogy offers something for everyone. Whether it’s the joy of HD visuals, the camaraderie of a two-player mode, the thrill of new maps, the challenge of facing a formidable foe, or the option to enjoy the original game separately – the Killzone Trilogy is an epic adventure worth taking.

name: Metal Gear Rising - Revengeance
description: The game is an action version of the Metal Gear series, so its gameplay differs from others. Players will join the match in a fast-paced manner. The protagonist is Raiden, a cyborg ninja who works for a private military company. During a mission, a rival company interferes and kills a politician. To solve this case, Raiden investigates their plans and passes many matches with strong foes. He fights powerful cyborgs and bosses through hack-and-slash gameplay. Raiden uses a blade for combos to destroy all enemies instead of avoiding them. He can also use secondary weapons. A special blade mode allows precise slicing. Raiden can perform zandatsu to restore health and fuel cells. Being a ninja, Raiden can activate the power when they reach the condition for faster movement and special attacks.

All of these gameplay features are presented in a dark story inspired by classic zombie movies with a gritty and engrossing campaign that can be played with up to four players in co-op mode.

description: Celebrating the fifth anniversary of the celebrated The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion, this package allows players who have never played the 2006 Game of the Year to experience Oblivion in its complete form. Included in this package is the Game of the Year release of The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion (featuring the original game and the official expansions Shivering Isles and Knights of the Nine) plus a bonus making-of disc and a game map. He returns to Rome to fight the Borgia. They liberate Rome and combat Templars through missions and the story to earn money. At the same time, players can burn Borgia towers and restore landmarks. The game introduces multiplayer mode that adds a new dimension to the series. Abstergo trains recruits using Animus devices. Players are Abstergo recruits who must assassinate targets. They must avoid suspicion while being hunted. They earn points to upgrade their skills and increase their assassinating rate. The game continues from the previous version and adds new features. Players free Rome from Borgia’s influence and restore the city. They can earn income from banks in Rome.

There are new achievements and better graphics. But the mechanics are the same. Peace Walker retains the multiplayer mode. Mission and Mother Base are two primary styles of play, with action segments in the first mode and the managed army in the second one. At the same time, a picker screen allows players to choose missions with both available Main Ops and Extra Ops. Therefore, you have to play the first mode because of its story-based features and interactive cutscenes. Optional Extra Ops have a range of objectives. The goals appear from document retrieval to target practice to make the missions more diverse. In this set, you’ll find the style of the series that combines strategic management with stealth action.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV - Oblivion

The prisoner must find the emperor’s illegitimate son to save Tamriel from Mehrunes Dagon. Oblivion features action combat and free-roaming environments. In the beginning, players choose their race and class and develop multiple skills. In particular, these skills improve through the use and training offered by NPCs. Enemies level up with the player, so side quests help improve abilities and gain fame. Players can explore towns, forts, and ruins with fast travel that allows quick movement between locations. Shrines grant special skills. Weapons and armor need to be repaired and enhanced to receive various benefits. Mana regenerates over time, and active blocking is available in combat. The game has full voice acting and an AI system for NPC behavior.

name: Resistance 3
description: Resistance 3 is a first-person shooter in an alternative reality where the planet is overrun by Chimera. This creature has evolved from infected humans, so humanity struggles to survive against overwhelming odds. The story follows Joseph Capelli, who lives with his family in Oklahoma. He receives news about a Chimerian tower in New York that causes global freezing. Therefore, Capelli must destroy it to save his family by embarking on a journey to New York with Doctor Malikov. The game features redesigned weapons and upgrades to allow for wielding all weapon types. In addition, they can be upgraded twice using experience points to receive alternative fire modes and enhanced power. The health system has changed, too, because it no longer regenerates automatically. Players must find health packs to replenish their health and carefully complete the missions. These changes add new challenges to the gameplay.

On various levels, Murfy offers some advantages to gamers. Rayman Origins can be accessible to players. In particular, they have some daily tasks and a Kung Foot minigame.

name: Burnout Paradise
description: The racing game Burnout Paradise is available for the Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3. It has a free-form environment known as Paradise City. Gamers are able to roam about and initiate events at any point in time. The lack of menus in the game allows for fluid gaming. Race, Road Rage, Marked Man, etc, are the primary interesting event categories. Players can unlock licenses and vehicles by earning credit. With a 60 frames per second frame rate, the game is all about speed and crashes. Players can destroy anywhere in showtime mode. Environmental objects can be distorted with the enhanced damage system. More than 80 vehicles are ready to participate in the crashing battle. In particular, the action focuses on crashes and combines great speed realized by initiating events.

name: SoulCalibur II HD Online
description: SoulCalibur II HD Online

name: Grand Theft Auto - San Andreas - Signature Collection
description: “Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas” is an action-adventure video game series developed by Rockstar North. This is a prominent game released in 2004 by Rockstar Games. The game revolves around the protagonist Carl “CJ” Johnson, a member of the American gang who fights with other gangs for territory. “Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas” is played with a third perspective, in the game the player can freely interact with the game world. With gameplay similar to the previous games in the series, players can control the character moving around the city to do missions. Characters have skills such as swimming, running, walking, climbing as well as the skills to use weapons and drive to fight with competitors. Players can control the vehicles on the way by stealing them. When not on duty, players are free to move around the city to cause havoc and attack the people. Players can be arrested by the police if they cannot escape in time. It is the 2004 best-selling game of its novel gameplay with over 27.5 million copies sold.

name: Dragon Age - Inquisition - Deluxe Pack
description: INTRODUCTION Dragons are afoot, realms are in chaos, and the call for a hero reverberates across the world of Thedas! Welcome to the third chapter of the epic saga from BioWare, Dragon Age: Inquisition. This addition to the series sees the developers responding to player feedback from earlier editions, masterfully blending the preferred elements of the first installment with the best of the second and even sprinkling in some fresh, exciting features. BREATHTAKING NARRATIVE: MORE THAN A DECADE LATER Our adventure kicks off a decade post-Dragon Age: Origins. Thedas finds itself in disarray – Ferelden, not yet recovered from the fifth Blight, a Darkspawn invasion, and Orlais, embroiled in civil unrest. Add to that an ongoing clash between mages and Templars, a ripped seam between the mortal world and the Fade, resulting in a demon onslaught. Enter the Inquisition, a politically independent entity that takes on this terrifying threat. As the player, you helm the Inquisition, tasked with finding the source of this demonic invasion and gathering enough power to thwart it. The character creation tool allows customization of everything from class and gender to race, all contributing to a fully-voiced, immersive protagonist. ROLE OF COMPANIONS: MORE THAN JUST BACKUP Accompanying your character are numerous companions, including familiar faces from previous chapters. Their significance lies not only in battle support but also in the narrative. By interacting with them, you unveil their stories, intentions, and ambitions. They react to your actions, which directly influence their perception of you. And yes, those beloved Dragon Age romances remain crucial to these companion relationships, showcasing interpersonal dynamics with a more realistic, mature approach. CHOICES AND CONSEQUENCES: GREY MORALITY Throughout your journey, you face complex moral dilemmas where the clear line dividing good from evil is blurred. These decisions impact the plot significantly, with consequences sometimes unfolding much later. For those wanting to import decisions from previous games or newcomers looking to create their history, the Dragon Age Keep website provides a solution. This platform allows you to generate a personalized save game to import, offering a unique storytelling experience. SIDE MISSIONS AND STRATEGIC GROWTH: REPUTATION IS POWER While the primary plot line unfolds, players engage in side quests and minor conflicts that are peppering Thedas. As Inquisitor, your decisions represent the entire organization, shaping its reputation and relationships with other groups. Progress in the game leads to character growth and the increasing significance of the Inquisition. Higher standing translates into tangible benefits like a personal army capable of capturing fortresses harboring crucial information. WORLD EXPLORATION AND COMBAT: A JOURNEY ACROSS THEDAS Given the scale of events in Dragon Age: Inquisition, players traverse the expansive continent of Thedas. While not fully open-world, locations offer more size and diversity than in previous chapters. Travel and exploration occur via a world map and on foot or horseback. Unlocking key plot areas requires a certain reputation level, achieved through side quests, diplomacy, artifact collection, and defeating dangerous creatures. As for combat, the developers have aimed to satisfy both strategists and action lovers. Players can issue orders to party members during active pauses or let AI control the action, allowing a focus on one character. The updated AI leads to organized enemy groups that support each other and respond to battlefield situations, requiring careful observation and strategic planning from players. TECHNOLOGY: A STUNNING DISPLAY The Frostbite 3 engine is powering this masterpiece, known for its application in Battlefield 4. The technology allows for creation of vast open spaces and intricate environment interactions. Destruction and reconstruction of environment components enable access to new locations. Added to this is a dynamic day-night cycle and weather conditions directly impacting gameplay. This chapter in the Dragon Age saga promises a compelling narrative, rich gameplay, and an immersive visual experience.

name: Metal Gear Solid
description: THE LURE OF THE TACTICAL SPY: METAL GEAR SOLID Re-imagine a world where tactical action meets stealth in a game developed by the Japanese wizards of Konami under the capable leadership of Hideo Kojima. This is a world of “Metal Gear Solid” for PlayStation 3, an epic evolution in the Metal Gear series that began its stealthy journey on 8-bit MSX computers between 1987 and 1990. Initially breaking cover on the original PlayStation console in 1999, Metal Gear Solid has since made itself digitally cozy via the PSOne Classic service. A PLOT THAT SPARKS ACTION Metal Gear Solid introduces us to an impending future where danger lurks at every corner. At the heart of the game is the chilling threat of a nuclear assault, with the trigger held by the terrorist organization Next-Generation Special Forces. They’ve seized control of a covert military base, their ransom: satisfy their demands or face nuclear obliteration. Enter our protagonist, Solid Snake, the special forces veteran familiar to fans from previous games. His mission, should he accept it, is to infiltrate the base, ensure the safety of hostages, and neutralize the terrorist threat. His only companion in this mission? Stealth. ENGAGING THE PLAYER WITH INTRIGUING GAME MECHANICS Despite its lush 3D environment, Metal Gear Solid remains true to its roots, with gameplay mechanics nearly mirroring those of its 2D predecessors. The focus here is not on brute force or confrontations but tactical insight and wit. In the guise of Solid Snake, the player must navigate various locations, evading guards and security cameras alike. However, the game isn’t devoid of moments of intense action, with sequences requiring Snake to engage in third and first-person firefights. Boss battles present unique challenges, with each boss possessing a specific weakness. Ten different weapons and a diverse arsenal of mission-critical items aid in these endeavors. UNLEASHING THE ARSENAL: STEALTH AND STRATEGY The arsenal available to Solid Snake is as diverse as the challenges he faces. The player can make Snake run, climb, swim, sneak into boxes, or stalk guards unnoticed. At his disposal are ten different weapons and tools vital for his missions – NV goggles, gas masks, explosives, and more. These tools empower players to choose their approach, allowing them to adopt a playstyle that best suits them. The right tool for the proper mission can be the difference between success and failure. INTRODUCING VR MODE: PRACTICE MAKES PERFECT The VR Mode is an exciting addition to Metal Gear Solid, allowing players to hone their stealth techniques, weapon handling, and sneaking skills. Here, players can experiment and master the tools and skills they need in the main game. This virtual playground offers players a safe space to experiment, make mistakes, learn, and become the ultimate stealth operative. SPECIAL EDITION: RAISING THE STAKES As if all these features weren’t enough, a year after its original PSX release, a special edition of Metal Gear Solid took the stage. This edition enhanced the game with a first-person mode, significantly improved enemy AI, and introduced a new (and most accessible) difficulty level. A bonus disc named VR Missions was included, providing 300 virtual reality training missions. These changes brought even more depth and replayability to the game, ensuring that players always had fresh challenges to tackle. Metal Gear Solid blends the thrill of tactical espionage with heart-stopping action sequences. Its immersive narrative, engaging gameplay mechanics, and innovative features like the VR Mode make it a game worthy of praise and admiration. As the adage goes, “Old soldiers never die; they just fade away.” However, in the case of Solid Snake, they also evolve, adapt, and continue to enthrall.

name: Metal Gear Solid V - The Phantom Pain
description: INTRODUCTION Consider “Metal Gear Solid 5: The Phantom Pain,” a fresh chapter in Konami’s renowned stealth action series from the Land of the Rising Sun. Created by the acclaimed Kojima Productions studio, this series traces its lineage back to the halcyon days of 1987, unfolding a complex narrative through its several core and numerous side titles. Each installment intertwines with the others, offering alternative viewpoints on the unfolding events over the years, all under the watchful eye of its creator and director, Hideo Kojima. A CLOSER LOOK AT THE MAIN CHARACTER The heart of “The Phantom Pain” lies in the figure of Punished Snake (familiarly known as Big Boss), an iconic protagonist in the expansive Metal Gear universe. Players acquainted with “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker” would find this character quite familiar. After nine grueling years in a coma, brought about by severe wounds, including losing his left hand, Snake awakens. These tumultuous events preceding his unconsciousness are narrated in the game’s prologue, “Ground Zeroes.” The story kicks into gear when, shortly after waking up, Snake’s hospital comes under siege, forcing him to make a daring escape. He isn’t alone, though. A shadowy patient, known only as Ishmael, lends a helping hand. A REVOLUTION IN GAMEPLAY The brains behind “The Phantom Pain” have infused considerable modifications into the gameplay mechanics. The most transformative of these? Introducing an open-world environment, a first for the series, provides players unparalleled freedom and diverse opportunities for amusement. Another significant update? The powerhouse FOX Engine, created by the tech wizards at Kojima Productions, is fueling the game. This cutting-edge tech boasts stunningly realistic visuals and enhanced physics capabilities that revolutionize the gaming experience. DIVE INTO THE OPEN WORLD A noteworthy aspect of the gameplay in “The Phantom Pain” is the open-world setting. This feature gives players the joy of exploration and allows them to select their path. It offers the freedom of choice and the ability to strategize while creating a more engaging and immersive experience. This open-world design and the innovative FOX Engine create a game world where the unexpected is the norm, and surprises lie in wait around every corner. THE FOX ENGINE: CRAFTING REALITY The FOX Engine, the heart that powers “The Phantom Pain,” is an engineering marvel. Developed by the talented programmers and engineers at Kojima Productions, the engine’s strengths are jaw-droppingly realistic visuals and advanced physics capabilities. These fundamental elements bring the game to life, making the Metal Gear universe more immersive. The fidelity of the visual details and the real-world physics create a gaming experience that is nothing short of breathtaking. REINVENTING THE METAL GEAR EXPERIENCE The creators of “The Phantom Pain” have done more than just update the game mechanics and introduce a stunning engine; they have reinvented the Metal Gear experience. The changes to gameplay, the evolution of the story, and the strikingly realistic visuals, are all combined into a holistic gaming experience that remains true to the core values of the series while pushing the boundaries of innovation. As we delve into the captivating universe of this game, it’s clear to see why it holds such a cherished spot in the hearts of gamers worldwide.

name: Diablo III – Reaper of Souls
description: “Diablo” is one of the famous role-playing game monuments for the gaming community, one of the products that make the brand for its “father”, Blizzard. Coming to “Diablo III”, players will definitely get the wonderful experience that the game brings. First released in May 2012, “Diablo III” is considered one of the best games in the entire “Diablo” series with many advanced features. Innovative gameplay, attractive and eye-catching graphics have made a strong impression on the fans of the series. Especially, there are 5 character classes that will appear in this game, including Wizard, Demon Hunter, Barbarian, Witch or Monk, with each class possessing a skill set as well as appearance design is extremely attractive and diverse, allowing players to freely choose their favourite class. The game set a record for “fastest-selling PC game” in 2012 when the number of discs sold over 12 million copies. The plot of “Diablo III” takes place 20 years after the events of “Diablo II”, at Sanctuary, a famous dark fantasy world in the series. Deckard Cain and Leah are in the Tristram Church in operation. They look up ancient texts related to an ominous prophecy. A mysterious star falls from the sky to the Church, creating a deep crater where Deckard Cain disappeared. The war between Angels and Demons once again broke out and the player will be tasked with learning the other meteorite and freely exploring the world in Sanctuary.

name: Battlefield - Bad Company 2 - Limited Edition
description: In Battlefield: Bad Company 2, the Bad Company crew again find themselves in the heart of the action, where they must use every weapon and vehicle at their disposal to survive. The action unfolds with unprecedented intensity, introducing a level of fervor to vehicular warfare never before experienced in a modern warfare action game. The 'B' company fight their way through snowy mountaintops, dense jungles and dusty villages. With a heavy arsenal of deadly weapons and a slew of vehicles to aid them, the crew set off on their mission and they are ready to blow up, shoot down, blast through, wipe out and utterly destroy anything that gets in their way. Total destruction is the name of the game — either online or offline, enemies will soon learn there is nowhere to hide.

name: Need for Speed - The Run
description: Jack Rourke is in trouble when owing money to criminals. Now, they require him to pay this impossible loan. Happily, his friend Sam tells him about an event named The Run. The protagonist will join a big race across America if he wants to receive $25 million. However, this race will be dangerous and challenging when Jack must beat 200 drivers to win. Many factions also have the goal to hinder him in this competition. For gameplay, players race from San Francisco to New York. The game inspires real locations that possess a huge track. The game has quick-time events. There are many cars to choose from, and each of them requires new challenges for players. Cars can be upgraded and customized by changing stats and colors and adding body kits.

name: Assassin's  Creed Double Pack
description: Assassin's Creed® Double Edition includes the two first chapters of the critically acclaimed Assassin's Creed® series. Experience the art of the original master assassin’s in two historical eras: the Third Crusade and the Renaissance. - In Assassin's Creed®, you are Altair, a lethal master assassin with one single purpose: to kill the Saracens and Crusader leaders who profit from and encourage the war in the Holy Land. - In Assassin's Creed® II, play as Ezio Auditore da Firenze and take part in an epic story of family, vengeance, and conspiracy, set in the pristine yet brutal backdrop of Renaissance Italy.

name: Darksiders
description: Darksiders follows War, a Horseman of the Apocalypse. He is tricked into starting a war between heaven and hell. Earth becomes enslaved as a result. War loses its powers and must find those responsible. He fights minions of hell and vengeful angels. Sometimes, he makes alliances with demons. The game features third-person hack-and-slash gameplay where players can use various weapons and combos. In particular, they can be upgraded and enhanced with other actions, including dodging, blocking, and jumping. Defeating enemies gives blue souls. These can be exchanged for new attacks and items. Wrath is another important attack resource for War to gain new abilities and progress in the game. The game includes platform puzzles and different gameplay sections. Players can fly, fight on horseback, and shoot angels to pass levels that are linear but can be revisited. He can transform into a powerful Chaos Form. The game encourages the exploration of hidden objects and collectibles.

name: Assassin’s Creed II - Game of the Year Edition
description: Assassin’s Creed II - Game of the Year Edition

name: Minecraft - PlayStation 3 Edition
description: Minecraft is an open world video game originally created by Swedish programmer Markus "Notch" Persson and later developed and published by Mojang. The creative and building aspects of Minecraft enable players to build constructions out of textured cubes in a 3D procedurally generated world. Other activities in the game include exploration, resource gathering, crafting, and combat. Multiple gameplay modes are available, including survival mode where the player must acquire resources to build the world and maintain health, a creative mode where players have unlimited resources to build with and the ability to fly, an adventure mode where players play custom maps created by other players and a spectator mode where players can fly around and clip through blocks, however cannot place blocks. The PC version of the game is renowned for its third-party mods, which add various new items, characters, and quests to the game. The alpha version was publicly released for PC on May 17, 2009, and after gradual updates, the full version was released on November 18, 2011. A version for Android was released a month earlier on October 7, and an iOS version was released on November 17, 2011. The game was released on the Xbox 360 as an Xbox Live Arcade game on May 9, 2012; on the PlayStation 3 on December 17, 2013; on the PlayStation 4 on September 4, 2014; on the Xbox One the next day; on the PlayStation Vita on October 14, 2014; and on the Wii U on December 17, 2015. On December 10, 2014, a Windows Phone version was released.[12] All versions of Minecraft receive periodic updates, with the console editions being co-developed by 4J Studios. Minecraft received five awards during the 2011 Game Developers Conference. Of the Game Developers Choice Awards, it won the Innovation Award, Best Downloadable Game Award, and Best Debut Game Award; from the Independent Games Festival, it won the Audience Award and the Seumas McNally Grand Prize. In 2012, Minecraft was awarded a Golden Joystick Award in the category Best Downloadable Game. As of June 2015, over 70 million copies had been sold, including 20 million between the Xbox 360 and Xbox One and 20 million on PC,[13] making it the best-selling PC game to date and the third best-selling video game of all time. On September 15, 2014, Microsoft announced a deal to buy Mojang and the ownership of the Minecraft intellectual property for US$2.5 billion; the acquisition was completed on November 6, 2014.[14][15][16][17]

name: Assassin’s Creed - Revelations
description: Assassin’s Creed: Revelations has an open world related to some historical events. You will pass the mission of the assassin through stealth skills. Desmond falls into a coma and enters the Animus to relive Ezio’s memories. From there, he travels to Masyaf and Constantinople to search for five keys and unlock an artifact. The game supports features that allow users to travel more quickly. Players can craft bombs to defend important places from enemies. Multiplayer mode will be opened when customization and guild creation are offered. Therefore, each player wants to reach the high ranks. Overall, you will find nostalgic experiences when trying the gameplay that combines exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving. The narrative blends historical events with fictional elements.

name: Batman - The Telltale Series
description: Batman - The Telltale Series

name: Injustice - Gods Among Us
description: INTRODUCTION Giving the arena of combat games a superpowered twist, Injustice: Gods Among Us arrives on the scene. Developed by the esteemed NetherRealm Studios, this gaming juggernaut is helmed by the ingenious Edward J. Boon, famed for his reinvigoration of the Mortal Kombat franchise. Stepping into the shoes of beloved characters from the DC Universe, players navigate a dystopian world where moral lines blur, and clashes of colossal magnitude ensue. ALL-STARS OF THE DC UNIVERSE Drawing from the rich tapestry of DC’s comic book lore and silver screen adaptations, Injustice: Gods Among Us thrusts you into battles featuring iconic characters such as Batman, Flash, and Wonder Woman, to name a few. Plunging into an ominous world where the distinction between hero and villain is vague, the narrative crafted within the game is an irresistible lure to any genre enthusiast. UNFORGETTABLE BATTLE MECHANICS Rooted in the foundational elements of Mortal Kombat, the gameplay model of Injustice keeps to a classic formula – two combatants enter, and one victorious hero leaves. These electrifying duels utilize the characters’ signature powers, ripped straight from their comic book origins. Fancy seeing Superman wielding a car as a weapon or the Flash reducing his foes to rubble with a swift punch? This is your chance to experience such spectacles in glorious 2D combat, all set against a fully-rendered 3D environment. EMBRACING THE ENVIRONMENT Injustice: Gods Among Us steps up the game, literally and figuratively, by integrating the environment into the gameplay. The innovative minds at NetherRealm Studios have imbued each battlefield with interactive objects, allowing each character to interact differently with their surroundings. Watch as Superman hurls a car at his opponent while Flash uses it as a tool for a bone-crushing slam. This feature increases the dynamism of each clash and adds a touch of uniqueness to every character’s fighting style. MULTIPLE STAGES OF MAYHEM While the line between good and evil may have been distorted, one thing is abundantly clear in this game – the non-stop action. Battles in Injustice don’t just occur in one fixed location; they rage across multiple settings, each more glorious than the last. This fluidity of place makes every skirmish feel fresh and intensifies the spectacle that players witness during their clashes. THRILLING GAMEPLAY AND A STRONG STORYLINE Injustice: Gods Among Us has successfully melded an engaging narrative with thrilling gameplay to deliver a top-tier fighting game experience. The narrative’s charm stems from its deft handling of DC’s pantheon of characters, while the gameplay shines due to its marriage of time-tested mechanics and novel innovations. It’s not just about who can punch the hardest; it’s about strategy, environment, and, most importantly, knowing your character. Injustice: Gods Among Us redefines the fighting game genre. Its unique gameplay and interactive environments are a testament to the creativity of NetherRealm Studios and the vision of Edward J. Boon. Whether you’re a fan of Superman’s might or Harley Quinn’s unpredictability, this game ensures that every battle is a spectacle and every punch is an unforgettable experience.

name: F.E.A.R. 3 - Legacy Archive
description: F.E.A.R. 3 - Legacy Archive

name: Dragon Age - Origins – Awakening
description: Introduction There are video games that create a special place in the heart of gamers worldwide, and then there’s “Dragon Age: Origins – Awakening” for PS3. Remember the thrill when you first stepped into the magical world of Ferelden? Or the sweet, burning fury you felt when a dark spawn slew your favorite character? Well, the pleasure or pain is amplified in “Awakening.” But what makes this game such a hit? THE RIVETING PLOT “Awakening” plunges you into the mystical land of Amaranthine, trapped in the throes of the aftermath of the Blight. Just when you thought you could hang up your boots and retire to a life of ale-tasting and dog-petting, the pesky darkspawn are back. But now, they’re smarter, nastier, and some can even talk (the horror!). Your mission? Unearth the cause of this new evolution, quash the growing menace, and maybe rescue a kitten or two from trees in your spare time. This plot has more twists and turns than a dark spawn’s intestines (fun fact: they’re twisty), ensuring a captivating journey for all players. CHARACTERS: FRIENDS, FOES, AND THOSE IN BETWEEN In “Awakening,” new faces join the party, each with a unique flair and memorable personality. Whether it’s the fiercely loyal dwarf Sigrun or the mysteriously brooding elf Velanna, you’ll find a character you like. Plus, some of your old buddies return, potentially ready to stab you in the back, offer emotional support, or just about your nose shape, in true “Dragon Age” fashion. These compelling characters, each with their intertwining story arcs, add a rich, vibrant layer to the game, ensuring that the drama off the battlefield matches the intensity of the one on it. GAMEPLAY FEATURES: MORE THAN JUST BLOOD AND GORE For those with a taste for cold steel and arcane fire, “Awakening” offers a host of new specializations and abilities that transform battles into an explosive display of strategy and raw power. The level cap has been raised, new spells are ready to be mastered, and improved class specializations make combat more intricate and engaging. Don’t forget the economy and trade, which are as accurate as the bags under your eyes from playing all night. There’s also an expanded personal inventory (hoarders, rejoice!) and options for fort upgrades because a hero’s home is their castle, sometimes literally. THE WORLD: DARK, DANGEROUS, AND DAMN BEAUTIFUL Exploring the hauntingly beautiful world of Amaranthine is a treat for the senses. Whether navigating the treacherous labyrinth of the Wending Woods or strolling through the bustling city of Amaranthine, the enhanced graphics and detailed landscapes will leave you breathless (or screaming in terror; dark spawns are still a thing). “Awakening” brings new depth to the “Dragon Age” universe, with complex lore, mysterious ancient ruins, and deadly new adversaries. In conclusion, “Dragon Age: Origins – Awakening” for PS3 is a thrilling, immersive journey that takes the intensity of the original game and dials it up to eleven. So, strap your Grey Warden armor, ready your blades (or staves), and brace yourself for an epic adventure. Just remember: Stay away from the cheese. That’s not a game tip, just some general life advice.

description: Borderlands Triple Pack - Premium Cut

name: Sniper Elite III - Ultimate Edition
description: This ULTIMATE EDITION contains the thrilling main game as well as 9 additional DLC packs, including the biggest environments yet in ‘SAVE CHURCHILL – Parts 1, 2 and 3’ and 6 WEAPONS PACKS – CAMOUFLAGE, SNIPER, EASTERN FRONT, HUNTER, AXIS and PATRIOT. Includes free updates to main game – 6 new MULTIPLAYER MAPS, CAPTURE THE FLAG mode, ‘TWILIGHT STRIKE’ Co-Op Mission, and ‘SHOOTING RANGE’.

name: Sniper Elite V2
description: INTRODUCTION Sniper Elite V2, the highly anticipated sequel to the critically-lauded Sniper Elite, graced our screens in 2012. Armed with a bullet and the onus of rewriting history, the player is thrown into a strikingly authentic simulation of war-ridden Berlin. UNRIVALLED BALLISTIC REALISM Ever wondered what it feels like to be a military sniper, factoring in wind speed, bullet velocity, and the cruel mistress of gravity herself? Sniper Elite V2 turns this thought experiment into an intricate, immersive reality. The game’s exhaustive ballistic simulation accounts for several variables, such as bullet penetration, stability, etc. Its mission? To provide the most authentic military sharpshooting experience to date. Strap on your helmets and camouflage, gamers; it’s about to get real! X-RAY VISION: A MURDEROUS MASTERPIECE Gone are the days when bullet impact was a dull ‘bang’ and ‘splat.’ Sniper Elite V2 takes gory satisfaction to another level. The game’s pioneering kill cam technology gives players a front-row seat to the bloody spectacle, displaying what happens when a bullet meets an enemy body in gruesome detail. Witness hearts rip, livers explode, and intestines make their grand exit. It’s not a spectacle for the faint-hearted, but what a spectacle it is! A HISTORICALLY AUTHENTIC STAGE Who needs a time machine when you have Sniper Elite V2? This game paints a vivid picture of WWII Berlin with period-accurate locations, vehicles, weapons, and uniforms. From the iconic Springfield M1903 to the Mosin-Nagant 1891/30, Sniper Elite V2 proves that the devil is truly in the details. DECISION MAKING: A CHOICE OF POISON The beauty of Sniper Elite V2 lies in its complex web of choices. Do you take the perfect shot, leaving yourself exposed, or opt for a more challenging path that allows your mission to continue? These strategic conundrums keep the adrenaline pumping, ensuring there’s never a dull moment in the world of Sniper Elite V2. THRILLING CO-OP MISSIONS Strap in for a wild ride with Sniper Elite V2’s range of co-op missions. Working alongside another player, you’ll face various challenges, from repairing tanks to scouring the map for essential parts. name: Batman - Arkham City - Game of the Year Edition
description: Batman: Arkham City is a 2011 action-adventure video game developed by Rocksteady Studios and released by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 video game consoles, and Microsoft Windows. Based on the DC Comics superhero Batman, it is the sequel to the 2009 video game Batman: Arkham Asylum and the second installment in the Batman: Arkham series. It was released worldwide for consoles, beginning in North America on October 18, 2011, with a Microsoft Windows version following on November 22. Written by veteran Batman writer Paul Dini with Paul Crocker and Sefton Hill, Arkham City is based on the franchise's long-running comic book mythos. In the game's main storyline, Batman is incarcerated in Arkham City, a huge new super-prison enclosing the decaying urban slums of fictional Gotham City. He must uncover the secret behind the sinister scheme, "Protocol 10", orchestrated by the facility's warden, Hugo Strange. The game's leading characters are predominantly voiced by actors from the DC Animated Universe, with Kevin Conroy and Mark Hamill reprising their roles as Batman and the Joker, respectively. The game is presented from the third-person perspective with a primary focus on Batman's combat and stealth abilities, detective skills, and gadgets that can be used in both combat and exploration. Arkham City expands Batman's arsenal of gadgets and combat attacks and offers a more open world structure, allowing the player to complete side missions away from the primary storyline. The game received critical acclaim, particularly for its narrative, character and world designs, soundtrack, and Batman's combat and navigation abilities. It was tied for the highest-rated video game of 2011 according to review aggregator Metacritic, and was the recipient of several awards including: Game of the Year, Best Action Game, Best Action Adventure Game, Best Adventure Game, and Best Original Score from various media outlets, and it is considered one of the best games ever made. Arkham City was followed by several additional releases: a spin-off mobile game, Batman: Arkham City Lockdown, on December 7, 2011; a Game of the Year edition containing all of the game's downloadable content on May 29, 2012; and Wii U and OS X versions in November and December 2012, respectively. A successor, Batman: Arkham Origins, was released in October 2013, and a narrative sequel, Batman: Arkham Knight, was released in June 2015.

name: Hitman - Absolution - Professional Edition
description: In the aftermath of Hitman: Blood Money, Diana Burnwood, Agent 47’s handler with the International Contract Agency, suddenly goes rogue, carrying out a catastrophic sabotage that includes publicly exposing the Agency. The Agency reforms under Agent Benjamin Travis; Travis assigns 47 to kill Diana and bring Victoria, a teenage girl in her care, to the Agency. Shooting and wounding Diana in her home in Chicago, 47, rather than executing her, comforts the dying Diana, who gives him a letter and asks him to keep Victoria safe from the Agency.[8] 47 hides Victoria at a Catholic orphanage somewhere in Chicago and contacts an International Contracts Agency (ICA) informant named Birdie, who asks him to kill a wealthy gangster nicknamed The King of Chinatown, in order for him to play ball. After eliminating him, 47 meets with Birdie, who briefs him about Blake Dexter, the CEO of Dexter Industries, who may have more information on Victoria. As payment, 47 is forced to give his signature Silverballers to Birdie. 47 learns that Dexter is in the “Terminus” hotel and after evading Dexter’s henchmen, eavesdrops on him. 47 learns from Dexter’s conversation with his secretary Layla that he plans to kidnap and auction Victoria to the highest bidder. 47 attempts to strangle Sanchez, Dexter’s enormous bodyguard, who proceeds to knock 47 unconscious. After Dexter discovers who he is, he almost kills him, but decides as he doesn’t want that kind of attention. Just then, a hotel maid comes in and discovers 47, thinking he is dead. Dexter kills her, plants the weapon with 47, douses the room in alcohol, ignites it, and leaves with Layla and Sanchez. Framed by Dexter for the murder, 47 escapes the hotel and evades the police. 47 contacts Birdie, who tells him to go to a local strip club and kill the owner, Dom Osmond, who works as an informant for Blake Dexter, so that he can protect Victoria. 47 kills Osmond and learns from a phone message in his office that Birdie is being hunted by Wade—–a sociopathic mercenary, who is a close friend of Dexter and is under his employ. Despite killing henchmen that were looking for Birdie, Birdie still sells Victoria’s location to Wade so that he can save his life. 47 reaches Victoria and learns that the necklace Victoria has keeps her alive. Wade and his henchmen raid the orphanage and massacre most of the nuns. 47 is forced to pick up fuse boxes that are scattered across the orphanage, since the elevator to the basement breaks down. After finding them all, 47 installs the fuse boxes and starts the elevator. Despite 47 ‘s efforts, Victoria is still kidnapped by Wade. 47 manages to shoot Wade, but Victoria is then taken hostage by Lenny, Dexter ‘s son. 47 interrogates Wade to reveal Victoria ‘s location—–Hope, South Dakota—–and leaves him to die of his injuries. Meanwhile, Birdie approaches Dexter, offering to broker the ransom of Victoria back to the Agency, but he is rejected. In anger, Birdie secretly provides information about 47 ‘s location to Travis’s assistant, Jade, and information about Dexter to 47, hoping to profit off the situation. After arriving in Hope, 47 retrieves his Silverballers after Birdie informs him of their location at a gun store. Later, 47 kills Lenny ‘s gang and interrogates Lenny himself. The player then drives him to the desert, and the player can either kill him or leave him in the desert. Learning from Lenny that Victoria is at the Dexter Industries HQ, 47 infiltrates the facility and destroys their research data on her while assassinating its scientists, and discovers that Victoria is in fact a genetically engineered clone bred to be a top-class assassin like him; however she can only use the skills of an assassin when she wears her necklace. 47 kills Sanchez in an underground cage fight after learning from him that Victoria was taken back to Hope. Recuperating at a hotel, 47 survives an ICA attack led by The Saints—–elite nuns in leather outfits and kills them. Infiltrating Hope Courthouse Jail, 47 reaches Victoria but is subdued by the corrupt local sheriff Clive Skurky, who is working with Dexter. The ICA, led by Travis, take over the town in an attempt to get Victoria back and kill 47; but she is nowhere to be found, while 47 escapes the jail and the ‘Agency. He then confronts a wounded Skurky in a church, demanding Victoria ‘s location. Skurky tells 47 she is at Blackwater Park, then dies from his wounds. Travis pays a ransom of ten million dollars for Victoria, but Dexter doesn’t keep his side of the bargain and keeps both Victoria and the money. 47 arrives at Dexter ‘s penthouse and kills Layla after she tries to seduce him (and fails). Dexter, not knowing that Layla has been killed, threatens to destroy the hotel’s roof if she doesn’t meet him there within five minutes. As Dexter is about to leave the hotel with Victoria and the money by helicopter, 47 mortally wounds him. 47 saves Victoria, while Dexter, with his dying words, apologizes to his Lenny, and asks for his money. Victoria, who is disgusted by Dexter ‘s words, opens the briefcase containing the ransom and throws the money onto his dying body. 47 and Victoria then leave the hotel. 47 learns from the letter Diana gave to him that Travis created Victoria without the Agency ‘s knowledge; in the letter, she also requests that 47 kill Travis to protect Victoria. Pursuing him to England, 47 finds the ICA exhuming the Burnwood family graves, believing Diana ‘s death to have been faked. After killing Jade, and then his personal guards, 47 corners Travis, who asks him if Diana is dead. 47 refuses to answer and kills Travis.[9] During a closing cutscene, 47 watches Diana and Victoria from afar before a message from Diana welcomes him back to the Agency, revealing that the shot 47 fired at her was non-lethal. Victoria also considers disposing of her necklace to prevent her from hurting anyone, with Diana telling her to do what she has to. Another cutscene then shows Birdie offering information on 47 to Cosmo Faulkner, a detective investigating his case.

name: FIFA 18
description: INTRODUCTION Emerging from the shadows of PlayStation 4 and Xbox One’s 2013 debut, FIFA 18 was in an unusual situation. While EA continued to churn out editions for the now-considered ‘vintage’ PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, the less polished editions for these consoles paled compared to their counterparts. One example was the PlayStation 3 edition, which wasn’t furnished with the esteemed Frostbite engine, exclusive to versions made for PCs, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One. Add to that the conspicuous absence of The Journey mode and Icon cards in FIFA Ultimate Team. The PlayStation 3 version of FIFA 18 saw a facelift in team updates and club attire alterations but not much else. REVOLUTIONIZING GAME MECHANICS FIFA 18 came to the table with many innovations, building upon the foundation of FIFA 17. One groundbreaking addition was the Real Players Motion technology, a state-of-the-art animation system that brought the footballers to life. Cristiano Ronaldo of Real Madrid fame was among those who collaborated in developing this technology. This system ensures the virtual replicas of football greats look, move, and behave exactly like their real-world counterparts. STRATEGIC FOOTBALLER PERFORMANCE In an impressive display of the technology’s adaptability, Real Players Motion doesn’t just focus on the most acclaimed footballers. It considers numerous factors, such as height and attributes, subtly affecting the performances of all players. For example, a physically imposing defender has a high probability of defeating a weaker opponent, but if that weaker player is skilled, they can still present a significant challenge. Also, players with exceptional talent, like Lionel Messi, have a noticeable advantage in ball handling and feinting. GAME MODES: BEYOND THE USUAL FIFA 18 offers a selection of licensed leagues and players and significantly changes its game modes. The story-driven career mode features an enticing continuation named “The Journey: Hunter Returns,” tracking the rise of Premier League hopeful Alex Hunter. This mode takes players around the globe, rubbing shoulders with top footballers like Cristiano Ronaldo, with on-pitch and off-pitch decisions shaping the narrative. REVAMPED CAREER MODE The conventional career mode, where players manage a single club, was also spruced up. Transfer systems were overhauled, and an all-new window was introduced in the menu to track attractive footballers and negotiate contracts. Now, players could deal with clubs, individual players, or agents. If needed, the assistant’s help is always available. Additionally, the AI actively responds to player offers, pushing for the best deals. Cut scenes show the finalization of transfers and award ceremonies for added realism. THE INCLUSION OF ICONS IN FIFA ULTIMATE TEAM A noteworthy feature added in FIFA 18 (only for XONE, PS4, PC, and Switch) is the introduction of Icons in the FIFA Ultimate Team mode. These unique cards represent legendary footballers such as Pele, Thierry Henry, and Ronaldinho. These cards are divided into three types, representing different stages of the players’ careers, each differing in statistics. For instance, Pele’s passing skills in 1958 are far from his prime in the 1970 version. A NOD TO CRISTIANO RONALDO As a cherry on top, Portugal’s Cristiano Ronaldo graces the cover of this edition, further immortalizing the football superstar. Ronaldo’s collaboration with the developers didn’t just end with being a cover star; he was actively involved in shaping FIFA 18. In a pre-release build-up, a trial version of the game was made available for subscribers of EA Access (Xbox One) and Origin Access (PC) services.

Bikers can now duck or jump over obstacles. The tracks are unconventional and have multiple routes. Not all routes suit every vehicle. Tracks wear down during races. This affects vehicle behavior. In particular, small vehicles struggle with vegetation, but big rigs can plow through. Water areas cool engines and change performance. The game offers split-screen play for up to four players. It also had online multiplayer, but servers closed in 2012. The game continues the style of the first MotorStorm. Players will experience many races and pass unique challenges in diverse environments and with vehicle interactions.

name: Risen 3 - Titan Lords
description: Step into the world of spellbinding action and thrilling adventures with Risen 3: Titan Lords, the latest installment in the widely cherished CRPG series. This dynamic product of the German gaming powerhouse Piranha Bytes blends the charm of its predecessors with some fresh, invigorating features. Donning the mantle of a new hero, you’ll journey through an inspired blend of Europe’s Middle Ages, tropical terrains, and the Mediterranean essence that breathes life into the game’s landscape. Buckle up for an immersive ride through the world of the living and the kingdom of the dead! A THRILLING JOURNEY THROUGH TIME AND SPACE With Risen 3, the intrigue starts in a fantasy realm teeming with magic, fashioned after medieval Europe and sprinkled with tropical and Mediterranean influences. As the son of the notorious Captain Steelbeard and brother to Patty, character loyalists would remember from previous versions your quest begins when the Lord of Shadows consumes Patty’s soul. The narrative in this RPG masterpiece allows for the evolution of characters towards humanity or demonic transformation based on your gameplay. A heavenly vision feature is at your disposal, highlighting the game world’s significant aspects and letting you discover both the mortal world and the ethereal realm. COMBAT, STRATEGY, AND MYSTERY Risen 3’s gameplay follows the classic third-person perspective, focussing the camera on your character’s action in line with its forerunners. Your journey comprises world exploration, mission completion, character development, and battling various creatures using an engaging arcade combat system. A notable improvement from its predecessor is the option to block enemy attacks with your team members’ help. Combat mechanics include an array of moves, a simple combos system, and seamless opponent-switching during fights, dodging, and executing so-called “finishers.” Weaponry ranges from guns and crossbows to throwing daggers and numerous combative spells like fireballs and teleportation. AN EXPANSIVE, LIVELY WORLD TO EXPLORE Risen 3’s world, comprising nine islands and continental coastlines, offers unbounded freedom for exploration. Thanks to ships, the transitions between the locales are seamless, with the added elements of climbing and swimming enhancing your gaming experience. Unexpected areas can be accessed by morphing your character into a parrot! The game also hosts six factions, with the option to join three – the Demon Hunter, the Guardians, and the Voodoo Pirates. With membership comes exclusive tasks, promotions, access to superior equipment, and advanced skills. SKILL-BUILDING AND CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT Every action in the game earns Glory Points, serving as a currency for developing your character’s skills. The game presents eight primary categories for skill enhancement – melee combat, ranged combat, cunning, influence, agility, strength, magic, and spirit. As you amass enough points, you can purchase special abilities from trainers, augmenting your gaming prowess and making future gameplay more manageable. INTERACTIVITY AND INNOVATION In this game, the environment is not just a backdrop but a lively participant. Risen 3: Titan Lords allows interaction with the in-game environment, including bonfires, workshops, forges, and altars. Activities such as lock-picking, weapon forging, alcohol distillation, and meat roasting make the gaming experience more interactive and immersive. Notably, this installment introduces exciting sea monster battles and ship deck fights. ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY FOR A RICHER EXPERIENCE Last but not least, the game utilizes a seasoned engine that has proven its worth in the previous versions. This choice ensures a smooth gaming experience and a seamless blend of familiar and novel aspects of gameplay. It’s a testament to Piranha Bytes’ commitment to providing an entertaining, engaging, and technically advanced gaming experience. In conclusion, Risen 3: Titan Lords is an alluring blend of familiar and fresh, offering an immersive journey through varied landscapes, advanced combat mechanics, and various interaction possibilities. It’s the perfect game for both loyalists of the series and new gamers ready to plunge into the world of fantasy and adventure!

name: Dead to Rights - Retribution
description: Jack and his father return in this version. Gangs become more organized to complete their goal. After that, the conspiracy reaches law enforcement. Jack and Shadow face another intense night when terrorists seize Temple Tower. Therefore, many hostages can not survive during negotiations. Jack decides to surrender his badge but uses violence to solve this problem. He battles gang members and chases the mastermind. Through the game, Jack experiences many tragedies, which makes him fight harder. For example, he discovers that trusted friends may be villains. The gameplay focuses on action when controlling Jack or Shadow. This changes depending on the mission. Jack fights with punches and combos to deal damage to multiple enemies simultaneously. Specially, Shadow can attack or guard Jack.

name: Borderlands 2 - Game of the Year Edition
description: Five years after The Destroyer was vanquished, a new valuable mineral known as Eridian was discovered in the crust of the planet Pandora. The powerful Hyperion Corporation, led by Handsome Jack, secured a moon base and eventually occupied the entire planet, depriving it of Eridian. One day, four vault hunters fall into a trap prepared by Jack, but are rescued by a ClapTrap robot and shown the way to a resistance movement that tries to put an end to Hyperion's regime. Borderlands 2, like its predecessor, is a first-person shooter that incorporates character building, quests and procedural content generation elements from role-playing games, particularly roguelikes, along with vehicle-based gameplay from contemporary shooters. The sequel features four new characters embodying four classes that represent different special skills and weapon affinities. Accumulated experience points result in skill points, which can then be allocated to the nodes of one of three skill trees that vary between classes. Weapons differ not only by type, firing speed or damage, they can also cause elemental damage that is more or less effective against specific types of opponents. Players can take on the game's challenges by themselves, or enlist the help of other players in the cooperative multiplayer mode. Compared to the first game, the game world is not split into disjunct pieces anymore, but has become continuously connected. Non-player characters now follow their own schedules and agendas as opposed to being fixed in their position permanently. The Game of the Year Edition of Borderlands 2 includes the following: Base game. Captain Scarlett and her Pirate's Booty Mr. Torgue's campaign of Carnage Sir Hammerlock's Big Game Hunt Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep Ultimate Vault Hunter Upgrade Pack Creature Slaughter Dome Battle Area Mechromancer Character Pack Psycho Character Pack Collector's Edition Content

description: This game stimulates the experience of joining Italian touring cars. Therefore, you can choose from quick races, race weekends, or full seasons. Each of them still provides many challenges. Before the race, anyone will pay attention to tuning options or quickly select with pre-set choices. The game can be suitable for beginners or professional players when giving aids and choosing levels ranging from easy to difficult. There are many tracks and cars to pick from. Through the game, you can unlock more vehicles and try the view from the car. The opponents of players can be other human racers besides the alone racing. Overall, players can try many things in the racing and customize their experience.

To increase the chance of winning, you should choose different cars that suit different events. Players can buy new or used cars from eBay Motors. To earn money, players complete Driver Offers. Bonus objectives provide extra cash. Prestige points unlock higher license categories. Tournaments give more points than Driver Offers. Players can adjust realism settings for more points. Flashbacks allow players to rewind time during races if they have any driving faults. The game offers various car types and handling styles that are suitable for the players’ playstyle. Realism settings include difficulty level and traction assistant. The 24-hour race in Le Mans is a notable event.

description: Long ago, dragons controlled the globe, but they were killed off when humans arrived later. In a fierce struggle, the Four Lords vanquished the dragons. This situation also didn’t endure long because of the start of the Age of Fire. In this world, an odd ailment known as the Darksign can make people cursed to become undead. Therefore, they would keep coming back from the dead until they went insane. One day, a Chosen Undead would manifest. A zombie broke out of an asylum. It was thought to be a sign. Dark Souls is a role-playing game. Gamers can personalize their appearance and select character classes. There are opponents in places that are connected. Combat demands close monitoring of endurance and vigor. In particular, Dark Souls is renowned for its difficulty because common foes in Lordran are not always harmless. Players can communicate through a special internet mechanism. Players can upgrade their skills and gear if they have enough Souls. Humanity has unique advantages and is a rare currency.

name: 50 Cent - Blood on the Sand
description: “50 Cent: Blood on the Sand” is an action video game series released next of the 50 Cent: Bulletproof series. This is a third-person shooter game developed by Swordfish Studios and was released in 2009 by THQ. The game has many genres played for gamers such as shooting directly, fighting cars or fighting between helicopters. The game revolves around the protagonist, 50 Cent, a rapper trying to join the G-Unit members to destroy the Kamal terrorist who stole the skull encrusted with diamonds and pearls from Anwar to mortgage them. In the game, players can use the money to buy new weapons or upgrade the weapons available in the “Store” of the game. Also if players want to earn super weapons they must earn G-Unit badges to unlock weapons. The gold ingots players collect in the game can be exchanged for support money for purchases in the “Shop” feature. By the time the game was released, “50 Cent: Blood on the Sand” had sold about 56,000 copies in the United States, hitting the biggest sales mark right after its release.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
description: “The Amazing Spider-Man 2” is an open-world action-adventure game based on the most famous superhero in the world of Marvel comics, Spider-Man. Beenox developed the game and it published by Activision. This game is a continuation of the success of the previous version of the same name, “The Amazing Spider-Man”. During that time, the game also had two films produced by Sony Pictures and made the game famous. In the game, the player controls the main character Spider-Man, swinging around New York City and restoring the city order from evil. The action is part of a system called “Hero or Menace”, which allows players to receive rewards and experience for their characters by taking part in the quests they have attributes supplies provided by your smartphone. In missions include: stopping gangsters, rescuing hostages, disabling bombs, … That will get you the “Hero” title, but the game will deduct rewards if you do not participate, or when the mission fails, then you will receive the title “Menace” as a bad guy. After receiving a reward including experience points, players can upgrade their skills as well as improve new features for “Web-Shooters”. In addition to fights with enemies, Spider-Man also can sneak attacks to surprise opponents, very effective when doing missions that penetrate the enemy lair quickly without losing a drop of blood, and this skill also needs to be upgraded by experience points.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV - Oblivion - Game of the Year Edition
description: The base game and two DLC packs are here when a handbook and map appear in the Windows version for North America. Everything starts with Emperor Uriel Septim’s escape to the dungeon. At the same time, this event also alters the destiny of a prisoner when the emperor gives the prisoner a mission. He should locate the illegitimate heritage son. Oblivion cannot harm Tamriel because of the Amulet of Kings. Mehrunes Dagon poses a danger to this equilibrium. The captive holds the key to Tamriel’s salvation. The game has open worlds and combat based on actions. In addition, race and class are customizable options because of a lot of leeway in character development. The interesting thing is that there are no limitations on the number of skills that players can develop. To try the beauty of this dangerous world, both first-person and third-person perspectives are available in the game.

name: God of War HD - Champion Edition
description: God of War blends the alternative Greek myths when you will not find anything familiar. A tormented Spartan named Kratos seeks redemption and serves Olympian gods. After that, he must defeat Ares because of the damage he received. The game mixes 3D action, platforming, and puzzles. Kratos wields the Blades of Chaos for combos. Players collect orbs to upgrade weapons and spells from defeated enemies. Therefore, new abilities will be grown while the story progresses. Various difficulty modes unlock extra content that reveals development insights and cut material. The gameplay balances combat, exploration, and upgrades to fully experience mythological elements with Kratos’ personal journey.

name: Spider-Man 3
description: Spider-Man 3 will help you relive all the events that happened in the 2007 movie. Players control the hero and continue protecting New York City from villains. Like the previous game, the gameplay still remains, and players will find a larger city to explore with many secrets. The game adds some mini-stories that do not appear in the film. From there, this marks the appearance of the new enemies. The powers of Spider-Man still depend on the suits that he wears. For example, the black symbiote costume makes the hero stronger but more aggressive. With the red and blue suit, he is faster and more liked by the public. For the PS3 version, you will try the new feelings with the motion controls and bonus mini-game with the New Goblin.

name: Rambo - The Video Game
description: You will experience the FPS experiences that come from three Rambo movies. In addition, the game limits your movement, and its gameplay is a rail shooter. Many things guide players through levels. Therefore, they should defeat the appearing enemies. QTEs can give you extra objectives. Players can select the weak points of opponents to take them down quickly. Sometimes, you should make stealth sections. Players must kill many enemies and can earn multipliers for linked kills. In addition, the game adds a wrath meter, and you should try to activate it. It will help slow time and provide benefits. A soldier like Rambo uses various weapons, like a knife, guns, and grenades. The game also supports the multiplayer modes for many participants.

name: WWE Legends of WrestleMania
description: WWE Legends Of WrestleMania relive the sports experiences in the 1980s-1990s. Many things help you feel the nostalgia, like events, venues, and signature music. The game offers players simple controls that can create the chain combo to quickly defeat the opponents. During the match, the wrestlers can boost their abilities when reaching the conditions or call managers for help. The main mode has three sections: relive, rewrite, and redefine classic matches. Players earn rewards by completing challenges. In addition, the experiences become more interesting when players can create their own wrestlers. Therefore, they can import characters from another game. Overall, many memories will be returned, and players will express their skills and customize their experiences.

name: The Elder Scrolls V - Skyrim - Dragonborn - Deluxe Edition
description: INTRODUCTION Buckle your dragon-scaled armor and gird yourself for an adventure. Yes, we are diving into the world of Dragonborn, the illustrious third expansion for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, a legend in role-playing games that reigned supreme in 2011. Lauded on multiple platforms, including PC, PS3, and X360, this expansion stands tall against its predecessor, Hearthfire. Forget house building and family starting; Dragonborn unveils an extensive universe, unfolding an enthralling narrative, fresh territories, and formidable adversaries. JOURNEY TO THE ICY ISLAND OF SOLSTHEIM Just a dragon’s flight northeast of Skyrim province, you’ll find yourself on the frosty isle of Solstheim, first introduced in the second expansion of The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind in 2003. Despite the passing of two centuries, the resilient inhabitants have clung fiercely to their sovereignty, resisting the influence of various mainland factions that continue to vie for power. ENCOUNTERING THE MYSTERIOUS MIRAAKU Unravel the enigma of Miraaku, a legendary figure who was the first to bear the title that now rests on your shoulders – Dragonborn—Like a treacherous current, time swept him away into the abyss of insanity centuries ago. Possessing abilities akin to yours, this wayward soul used dragons to fulfill his ominous objectives. Your primary quest: thwart the resurgence of this malevolent madman. EXPANSIVE GAMEPLAY ELEMENTS AND ABILITIES There’s more to Dragonborn than an epic narrative and picturesque settings. It expands the gameplay horizon with fresh elements. Among these, the capacity to soar skywards atop a dragon reigns supreme. An exhilarating experience that promises a newfound perspective on the vast, fantastical landscapes. NEW TYPES OF FOES AND EQUIPMENT Get ready to encounter unfamiliar enemies that will test your mettle. It wouldn’t be a proper expansion if it didn’t put your survival instincts to the test. The new arsenals at your disposal are equally intriguing – weapons, powers, and armor. With them, not only do you stand a better chance against the newfound threats, but you’ll also feel the thrill of wielding newfound strength. ENRICHING THE ORIGINAL GAME Dragonborn goes beyond simply adding new elements. It enriches the base game, enhancing the depth and breadth of your role-playing experience. The new narrative, locations, and opponents are weaved seamlessly into the game’s rich tapestry, ensuring that each encounter feels as much a part of the original journey as the base game itself. To conclude, Dragonborn is more than an expansion. It’s a new chapter in the epic saga that Skyrim weaves, inviting you to write your heroic tale. So gear up, warrior! The world is waiting for your story to unfold.

name: Saw (video game)

In addition, he can see many things from the third perspective. You can easily explore the building and avoid dangers. description: WWE Legends Of WrestleMania relive the sports experiences in the 1980s-1990s. Many things help you feel the nostalgia, like events, venues, and signature music. The game offers players simple controls that can create the chain combo to quickly defeat the opponents. During the match, the wrestlers can boost their abilities when reaching the conditions or call managers for help. The main mode has three sections: relive, rewrite, and redefine classic matches. Players earn rewards by completing challenges. In addition, the experiences become more interesting when players can create their own wrestlers. Therefore, they can import characters from another game. Overall, many memories will be returned, and players will express their skills and customize their experiences.

name: eFootball PES 2021
description: eFootball PES 2021 Season Update is a PES 2020 update, containing the latest player data and club roster, giving you all the critically acclaimed features. Extensive gameplay: Overcoming the defense with the Finesse Dribble feature, the expanded trap mechanics will vary depending on the player’s ability and feel the accuracy of the kick in context. Each player’s individual style of play gives depth to your squad on the pitch. Master League mode: Master League is an iconic single-player mode that puts you in charge of your own club. While working to build and develop your dream team, you have a responsibility to advance growth through options both on and off the pitch. Experience the ups and downs of every season, from the start of the first game to the thrill of the finale. If you are looking for a rich football management experience then this is the mode for you. Matchday mode: Work side by side with new players and seasoned professionals, work together to take part in the biggest tournaments in Matchday Online Mode. Choose your favorite club and recruit other users of the same skill level to contribute to the team’s victory.

name: UFC Undisputed 3
description: UFC Undisputed 3 is a mixed martial arts fighting game that supports licensed fighters from the UFC and PRIDE. If you really like this sport, you should create custom characters in Career mode. Through training and winning matches, they progress to become famous. The game offers various modes like Pride, one that has different rules and allows moves not permitted in UFC. Players can choose between Amateur and Pro grappling controls. The game introduces new features like fighter entrances and damage recovery. Fighting is divided into three stances such as standup, clinch, and ground. Players earn fight purse cred to learn new moves. The game has been made more accessible for new players to start everything from zero, including updated submission and stamina systems.

description: Welcome to the society of the chosen. Live the life of Vito Scaletta, a small-time gangster with plenty of ambition and a talent for taking care of business. As Vito rises through the ranks of a powerful mob family, he discovers that life as a wise guy is as dangerous as it is glamorous. In a gripping and stylish action adventure, Vito must prove himself an efficient enforcer, a skilled getaway driver and a reliable hit-man. Set in a mythic post-war America, Mafia II: Director’s Cut tells an intense story of friendship, loyalty, betrayal and revenge.

description: This collection contains remastered versions of the first three games. In particular, the changes are related to the graphics in high-definition and online multiplayer mode. For gameplay, the games are platform action games when players control two main characters and complete a quest. The gameplay is similar to other 3D platformers when the environment is large and detailed. There are mini-games like space fights and turret shoot-outs. The story is told through cutscenes with non-linear gameplay, so you can return to previous levels. In particular, there are many reasons why you should find many weapons and gadgets. The games have over twenty levels each and provide the story of the heroes who try to save the galaxy. They encounter various challenges and enemies along the way. The games combine action, humor, and exploration.

name: Dante’s Inferno
description: Dante’s Inferno is an action game that follows Dante in the role of a templar knight. He returns home and knows the Death of his beloved Beatrice. The killer stabs Dante, but he resists Death. Dante steals Death’s scythe and descends into hell to rescue the soul of his beloved from Lucifer. The devil plans to marry her and escape hell. Dante travels through nine circles and fights many demons. Through the match, some events will show Dante’s past during the Crusades. Understandably, the gameplay is like that of God of War, where Dante uses some special weapons, such as a scythe and magic cross. He can tame demonic beasts, and the future changes depending on his choices between holy and unholy paths. Players can punish or absolve enemies and trapped characters. When earning enough experience points, you will find ways to develop different skill trees.

name: NIER
description: The game is an action RPG that takes place in the far future. The world is mysterious, and the main character seeks a cure for his daughter with a companion from a talking book. They gained new powers and weapons when completing quests. This leads to battles that use melee, ranged, and magic attacks. Weapons can be upgraded and specialized. Depending on the game versions, you will find many variations in the protagonists based on their appearance and relationships. Players can explore the world and complete tasks with the dynamic combat system. Characters develop to help the story unfold more quickly, and the plot has unexpected turns that make you surprised.

Players can join different race types, such as Time Attack and Drift, to change their feelings. A new mode called LiveTrack changes the track during races. The game combines international racing with league promotion. It offers players diverse cars and race settings.

name: Killzone 2 - Deluxe Bundle
description: In the same-name series, Killzone 2 stands as the third installment. The game unfolds in Helghan, the Helghast’s homeworld. To quell the war machine and apprehend Emperor Visari, the ISA retaliates on Helghan’s territory. Therefore, players control Sergeant Tomas “Sev” Sevchenko, a seasoned member of the special forces. Sev commands a band of warriors against the Helghast menace. Cinematic, staged action is the main focus of the gameplay. Played from a first-person perspective but can be switched to a different view for vehicle combat. Sneaking up on an opponent while hiding is a common tactic. Warzone is the multiplayer mode and offers seven different classes and five different mission kinds. At the same time, you can add bots to fill spaces when there are not enough 32 players.
