name: Sniper - Ghost Warrior 2
description: Introducing “Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2”, the celebrated sequel to a franchise born in the heart of 2010. This game lets you step into the boots of an undercover sniper, traversing dangerous territory to locate and neutralize your targets. The game is the brainchild of Polish powerhouse CI Games, not just known for its predecessor but a cornucopia of mainly other budget-friendly creations. UNMISTAKABLE GAMEPLAY With gameplay that goes against the grain of mainstream first-person shooter games, “Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2” makes a distinct mark. As a sniper, your main armament is your trusted rifle, which means running headfirst into a gunfight is far from the ideal strategy. Instead, picture yourself hidden in the foliage, patiently waiting for that perfect moment to unleash a lethal round. With the element of surprise on your side, you can dispatch foes swiftly and silently. ADVENTURE ACROSS THE GLOBE The game transports you across many locations, from the Himalayas’ slopes to Sarajevo’s war-scarred landscape. Every new locale calls for a fresh approach. Hence the developers have loaded your arsenal with more than just your standard six sniper rifles and sidearm. Night vision goggles and thermal sights have been added to the mix, tools that will prove invaluable in your varied environments. THE INTRICATE PHYSICS BEHIND THE SNIPER RIFLE For the second time, CI Games presents an intricate physics mechanism that brings the sniper rifle experience to life. Novices to the franchise are well catered for, with several game-assist options to smooth their transition into long-range warfare. One notable improvement in this sequel is the enhanced artificial intelligence of the computer-controlled adversaries. PLENTY OF GAME MODES TO KEEP YOU ENGAGED But the fun doesn’t stop with the campaign. The game offers a multiplayer mode, pitting you against living, breathing opponents in a high-stakes face-off. Two teams can lock horns in one of two available maps, adding a whole new layer of complexity and replayability to the game. In summary, “Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2” takes all the elements that made the original great and pushes them further. With its stealth-based gameplay, diverse settings, impressive physics, and engaging game modes, the game has created a distinctive niche in the FPS genre. So, if you’re in the mood for a departure from run-of-the-mill shooter games, this may be the perfect fit for you!

name: Far Cry 4 - Platinum Pack
description: INTRODUCTION “Far Cry 4”, a riveting installation in the globally acclaimed first-person sandbox shooter series, offers players an immersive experience across multiple platforms like PC, PS4, and more. Spawned from the innovative minds at Crytek in 2004, the franchise fell under Ubisoft’s adept leadership a year later, who have since unfailingly churned sequels and spin-offs to satiate gamers’ thirst for adventure. Far Cry 4, meticulously crafted primarily in Ubisoft Montreal’s creative crucible, collaborates with the company’s diverse departments, giving birth to the first series installment accessible on Xbox One and PlayStation 4. A COMPELLING NARRATIVE SET IN A MYSTICAL LAND Far Cry 4 takes players on a thrilling journey to Kyrat, a quaint fictional realm in the Himalayas. A place steeped in tradition and simple lifestyles, Kyrat is trapped in a vicious civil war perpetrated by the eccentric warlord Pagan Min, the self-styled ruler of Kyrat. His iron-fisted rule and disdain for civilian casualties fuel the raging conflict. The protagonist, Ajay Ghale, becomes embroiled in this deadly power struggle upon his arrival in Kyrat, intending merely to fulfill his dying mother’s final wish. IMMERSIVE GAMEPLAY IN A RICHLY DETAILED WORLD The gameplay gently unravels Kyrat’s enigmatic secrets, drawing players deeper into its rich tapestry. Kyrat’s unique geography is an exciting potpourri of locales, from snow-clad mountain trails to dense forests, pulsating cities, and intriguing ancient ruins. Players enjoy the liberty to traverse the expansive open-world map of this Himalayan country, leveraging diverse modes of transport to satisfy their wanderlust. Furthermore, the protagonist can participate in spiritual meditations, transporting him to the mythical realm of Shangri-La. A MULTI-FACETED JOURNEY OF DISCOVERY During the campaign, players encounter a mix of plot-driving missions, side quests, and optional objectives, such as liberating checkpoints, timed trials, or hunting the wilderness’ exotic fauna. Being an accurate FPS production, Far Cry 4 arms players with a varied weapon arsenal, from basic pistols to heavy machine guns, daggers, knives, and bows, and introducing a crossbow for the first time in the series. AN INVITING ARENA FOR MULTIPLAYER MAYHEM The game goes beyond single-player adventures, offering a platter of multiplayer variations. In the novel co-op mode, players can rally their friends to assist in accomplishing side missions or to make exploring the open world a shared delight. CONCLUSION The allure of Far Cry 4 stems not just from its enthralling story or detailed open world but from the freedom it gives players to explore, fight, and shape their journey. Ubisoft has outdone itself with this installment, and players worldwide eagerly await what adventure they will be invited to embark on next.

In the journey, everything will become the bosses with great powers. Enemies become stronger after defeating players. You should be careful to choose from the attacking targets. Therefore, the game does not require one to join the combat all the time. Players can fight and have stealth actions. Through time, many abilities will be unlocked to easily kill enemies.

name: Ratchet & Clank - Quest for Booty
description: Coming to the Ratchet & Clank platform game, players will be tested a series of attractive games in the series of games that continue to be released. One of the most developed games of this game, the most sought after by gamers, is the “Ratchet & Clank: Quest for Booty” game series. This is the second platform game series of this series which is supported by gamers the most in the release time. The game was developed by Insomniac Games and released by Sony Computer Entertainment in 2008. Continuing the previous series, the player will control the character Ratchet to destroy enemies and rescue Clank from Zoni. Entering the game, the player will drive Ratchet around destroying enemies with weapons equipped for the game characters. Players will collect bolts while destroying all enemies and unlocking new levels of the game map. In addition to the mode to destroy enemies, the game also has new features such as puzzle feature, pickup feature with Omniwbler Millennium 12. In particular, Omniwbler Millennium 12 can also be used to control the objects and other obstacles.

You can chase bears or collect gifts to complete quests and open new areas. From there, new trophies and unlocked costumes will come to you. You also pay attention to abilities and earn badges. Each chapter tells a separate story about Naughty Bear.

Match Day updates statistics weekly and offers a Game of the Week. Pro Clubs has seasonal play with unlockable rewards. Ultimate Team is the main game mode. The control makes attacking moves less predictable, and dribbling options have increased. Bot players offer better offensive support to help you improve your skills. In addition, the new mode has 32 minigames with three difficulty levels that you should pass more and more. These can be played alone or with another player. The game improves on previous versions and adds more options for all players to enjoy the great matches together.

name: Quantum Theory
description: Humanity goes near to the elimination after a great war. However, small groups still survive in the wasteland, where strange towers have appeared. These structures have created diablosis that corrupts people. Therefore, to stop this problem, a man called Syd arises and aims to destroy those dangerous towers. The game has a cover-based gameplay when the protagonist can hide and fire from the cover. In addition, he is also required to run between safe spots to continue his attacks. His attacks will change depending on the three weapons carried. He teams up with Filena for special moves, like throwing her at enemies. Besides the single-player modes, you can join gameplay in online multiplayer to compete against other skilled players.

description: Includes Darksiders and Darksiders II Apocalyptic Power of War – Unleash the wrath of War, combining brutal attacks and supernatural abilities to decimate all who stand in your way. Epic Quest – Battle across the wastelands and demon-infested dungeons of the decimated Earth in your quest for vengeance and redemption. name: FIFA Street
description: INTRODUCTION Presenting an unrivaled creation from the esteemed minds behind the EA SPORTS FIFA Soccer franchise, FIFA Street manifests as the epitome of authentic street soccer. By encapsulating the essence of street soccer culture from every corner of the globe, it encapsulates every nuance, from the varied playing environments to the sportswear, even the game’s soundtrack. STREET SOCCER STYLES FROM AROUND THE GLOBE FIFA Street is more than a game; it’s a passport to the world’s iconic street soccer hotspots. Embrace Amsterdam’s silky smooth panna-style or the no-holds-barred London clashes that hinge on every possession. The game offers unprecedented ball control fidelity and responsiveness. Plus, for the first time, your players can take to the air, defying gravity to bypass opponents, while over 50 new skill moves add an extra layer of spectacle. THE QUEST FOR STREET SOCCER SUPREMACY FIFA Street’s World Tour Mode is a sprawling social experience, allowing you to mold your in-game persona, craft a squad of street soccer virtuosos, and ascend the ranks to global stardom. It’s a journey that will take you from local tournaments to the world stage in Rio de Janeiro, the hallowed turf of street soccer. Along the way, take on top-tier licensed clubs and street soccer legends in your quest for glory. COMPETITIVE STREET SOCCER ONLINE The head-to-head online seasons bring an exciting, competitive edge to FIFA Street. With the added incentive of promotion and the looming threat of relegation, you can assemble your team online and pit them against others in 5v5, 6v6, or futsal showdowns. Rising through the divisions won’t be a walk in the park; competition is fierce. COMPLETE AUTHENTICITY AND CUSTOMIZATION The authenticity of FIFA Street is unparalleled, meticulously recreating the playstyles of street soccer practitioners worldwide. You can take on renowned clubs or pit your wits against genuine street players. Customizable matches mean you can alter the pitch size, player count, and match types from trick-heavy games in Amsterdam to physical 5v5 encounters in the UK. THE FIFA STREET NETWORK The Street Network is FIFA Street’s beating heart, turning every spectacular skill move into a stepping stone toward global recognition. Compare your career progress, online ranking, and even share your most impressive in-game tricks using the video upload feature. With over 35 unique venues ranging from Rio’s favelas to Shanghai’s rooftops, FIFA Street truly lets you own the streets.

UH-10 Black Hawks were seen over Skira, and players will be members of this team.

name: Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon - Future Soldier
description: Future Soldier is the fifth main game that possesses tactical shooting elements. Players will have a strategy to approach enemies to complete the missions. In addition, the main campaign has twelve missions that start in Nicaragua. The ghost team Predator that tries to disrupt weapon trafficking is killed by a dirty bomb. Therefore, a new team will replace and continue the investigated source related to the dangerous weapons. Players control four soldiers through a story in various countries. Depending on the situation, players can use guns or silent melee attacks. Soldiers move freely in the environment. They have adaptive camouflage that makes them invisible when moving slowly. Players will become true spies in many important missions.

name: FIFA 15
description: Introduction Grab your cleats, jerseys, and love for the beautiful game! The twenty-second entry in the monumental series of soccer simulation video games, FIFA 15, delivers the exceptional, immersive football experience that fans have come to adore, courtesy of the giants at EA Sports. Let’s navigate the field together as we dissect the novel features that make this game a powerhouse. A BROAD RANGE OF GAMING EXPERIENCE The beauty of FIFA 15 lies in its diversity of gameplay options. Like its predecessors, you steer a handpicked team, participating in nail-biting 90-minute matches and striving to outscore your rivals. The game provides a potpourri of modes, from managing careers and taking part in solitary competitions and seasons to exploring intriguing online modules under the EA Sports Football Club platform’s umbrella. It even has a mode, “Become a Star,” where you single-handedly guide a player’s sporting journey. Such a varied playing field caters to gamers of all preferences, making FIFA 15 more than just a game. A BREATH OF FRESH REALISM FIFA 15 steps up from its predecessor and inches closer to the elusive ‘perfect’ football simulation. Animations have been enhanced, capturing player reactions on the pitch and offering improved presentation off it. The attention to the minutest detail imbues the game with an additional layer of authenticity. With these enhancements, you can feel the thrill, the tension, and the exhilaration as if you were in the stadium yourself, providing an unrivaled gaming experience. TACTICAL MASTERCLASS FIFA 15 offers increased tactical options to the player. Remember Jose Mourinho’s famed ‘parking the bus’ technique? Now, you can replicate it on your console. Fancy keeping the ball in the corners of the pitch? Go for it! The game allows you to experiment with strategies and tactics, making it a playground for football fans. The defense mechanism has also been noticeably refined, focusing more on team effort rather than solo tussles with rivals. This upgrade provides a more comprehensive and realistic gameplay experience. TECHNICAL IMPROVEMENTS AND LICENSING EXPANSIONS From technical bugs in the predecessor, FIFA 15 has indeed leveled up. Those pesky errors that used to affect gameplay have been eradicated, paving the way for a smoother experience. Moreover, adding new team and league licenses has expanded the gaming landscape, offering players more variety and authenticity. This means you can now play as your favorite underdog team and, who knows, even guide them to cup glory! THE POWER OF THE IGNITED ENGINE The power of the Ignite engine, crafted by EA Sports in 2013, is harnessed for the second time in the series for FIFA 15. This technology enhances the visual appeal, facilitating a dynamic turf field that reacts to changing weather conditions and presents refreshed player models that resonate with the modern player’s athletic image. These improvements make the game more immersive, visually stunning, and enjoyable. In conclusion, FIFA 15 is not just a game; it’s an experience. It’s a sporting saga that whisks you into the heart of football. So lace up your virtual boots, step onto the pitch, and let the beautiful game unfold in glory.

The attention to the minutest detail imbues the game with an additional layer of authenticity. With these enhancements, you can feel the thrill, the tension, and the exhilaration as if you were in the stadium yourself, providing an unrivaled gaming experience. TACTICAL MASTERCLASS FIFA 15 offers increased tactical options to the player. Remember Jose Mourinho’s famed ‘parking the bus’ technique? Now, you can replicate it on your console. Fancy keeping the ball in the corners of the pitch? Go for it! The game allows you to experiment with strategies and tactics, making it a playground for football fans. The defense mechanism has also been noticeably refined, focusing more on team effort rather than solo tussles with rivals. This upgrade provides a more comprehensive and realistic gameplay experience. TECHNICAL IMPROVEMENTS AND LICENSING EXPANSIONS From technical bugs in the predecessor, FIFA 15 has indeed leveled up. Those pesky errors that used to affect gameplay have been eradicated, paving the way for a smoother experience. Moreover, adding new team and league licenses has expanded the gaming landscape, offering players more variety and authenticity. This means you can now play as your favorite underdog team and, who knows, even guide them to cup glory! THE POWER OF THE IGNITED ENGINE The power of the Ignite engine, crafted by EA Sports in 2013, is harnessed for the second time in the series for FIFA 15. This technology enhances the visual appeal, facilitating a dynamic turf field that reacts to changing weather conditions and presents refreshed player models that resonate with the modern player’s athletic image. These improvements make the game more immersive, visually stunning, and enjoyable. In conclusion, FIFA 15 is not just a game; it’s an experience. It’s a sporting saga that whisks you into the heart of football. So lace up your virtual boots, step onto the pitch, and let the beautiful game unfold in glory.

name: LEGO Batman 3 - Beyond Gotham - Platinum Edition
description: “Lego Batman 3” is an extremely exciting action-adventure game based on the image of the most famous superhero in DC Comics, Batman. The game was developed by Travel Tales and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment in November 2014 for many different platforms. “Lego Batman 3” is the 3rd version of the “Lego Batman” series of games. Right at the time of launch, the game has met the expectations of many players around the world. Many game critics have also praised the building for its extremely compelling storyline, beautiful and captivating graphics, game humor and variety of characters. The game “Lego Batman 3” also retains the core of the previous versions, with the number of characters in the game up to more than 200 different characters. Players can freely choose any one of the characters in the game from a third-person perspective, mainly fighting the enemies, solving puzzles and collecting Lego ‘studs’, the game’s currency. Players can also perform combined attacks in combat will multiply the number of “studs” earned. Up to two players can play in cooperative mode. In the game, there are many different environments, all based on the famous locations in the DC comic universe. Like previous Lego games, the levels are unlocked for “Free Play” mode when they are completed in Story Mode. “Free Play” allows players to replay any completed level.

name: Darksiders - Collection
description: Includes Darksiders and Darksiders II Apocalyptic Power of War – Unleash the wrath of War, combining brutal attacks and supernatural abilities to decimate all who stand in your way. Epic Quest – Battle across the wastelands and demon-infested dungeons of the decimated Earth in your quest for vengeance and redemption. Play Death: Become the most feared of the legendary Four Horsemen, able to destroy entire worlds and battle forces beyond Heaven and Hell. Replay-ability: Explore a vast open world, complete dozens of side quests and customize your character with a full leveling system, Skill Trees and endless equipment combinations.

name: Max Payne 3
description: Max Payne 3 continues the series when taking place in São Paulo, Brazil. Actually, Max works as a security guard and tries to rescue the kidnapped wife. However, nothing happens normally. Different from the previous version, the game keeps the black film style but is brighter than before. For his mission, Max changes his look and helps players try some new styles. For gameplay, players shoot from the third perspective when they possess bullet time, which slows down the action. Max can use many weapons and is ready to enter a dangerous mission. You can see his health presented by an outline on the screen. Painkillers are necessary to rescue the character and help him heal. The game mixes cutscenes with gameplay smoothly when the story appears in various ways and in various order.

Players control Preacher or Stump in various missions. In addition, you will go through many missions that are scattered in different global locations. The gameplay will retain the core elements from the other versions in the series and add many actions. In addition, you will easily find objectives and targets on the screen. The combat system facilitates the switching of weapons in many difficult situations. Players can make many things to complete, like direct attacking or stealth. For some important targets, you can join car racing missions that require your skills.

description: The game is the updated version for the PS3 platform when the developer adds new features and content. The game is set in Isla Trueno, Colombia, which has beautiful places and rare resources. General Vasquez rules the island, but he overthrew the government. To solve some problems different from Vasquez’s, they sent a special ops team to kill this target. For the gameplay, players control Tyler Wells, who has the role of a Scout Sniper. From the first perspective, they should complete 16 missions with different actions. The protagonist can crawl and hide while lining up shots. His weapons can be different sniper rifles, a silenced pistol, and throwing knives. With these things, you should quickly defeat enemies from far distances. Therefore, the gameplay requires stealth skills and precision shooting from players.

name: PROTOTYPE
description: Alex has a virus that gives him deadly powers. In particular, he can change into people he consumes, and this comes from a Gentek experiment. After the lost memory, he decides to seek revenge and find his past. Elizabeth Green spreads a virus version that can turn people into zombies or monsters. The game is open-world, similar to GTA IV, where players control Alex in Manhattan to freely explore. With the superpowers, he can climb walls and jump high. He is a true disaster, so monsters and the military chase him. He can lift objects, throw them, and shape-shift to defend himself. His hand can transform into claws, shields, and powerful fists. Through the challenges, he must discover the abilities through the matches and upgrades.

name: Fallout 3 - Collector’s Edition
description: Product Description Fallout 3 from the creators of the award-winning Oblivion, featuring one of the most realized game worlds ever created. Create any kind of character you want and explore the open wastes of post-apocalyptic Washington D.C. Every minute is a fight for survival as you encounter Super Mutants, Ghouls, Raiders and other dangers of the Wasteland. Prepare for the future. Amazon.com The third game in the Fallout series, Fallout 3 is a singleplayer action role-playing game (RPG) set in a post-apocalyptic Washington DC. Combining the horrific insanity of the Cold War era theory of mutually assured destruction gone terribly wrong, with the kitschy naivety of American 1950s nuclear propaganda, Fallout 3 will satisfy both players familiar with the popular first two games in its series as well as those coming to the franchise for the first time. ‘Fallout 3’ game logo The Cold War goes Next-Gen The Capital Wasteland Welcome to the nation’s capital. View larger. Brotherhood of Steel member The Brotherhood of Steel is a powerful ally. View larger. The Pip-Boy Model 3000 Customize characters with your Pip-Boy. View larger. The optional turn-based VATS mode The optional turn-based VATS mode. View larger. The Story: Vault 101 – Jewel of the Wastes For 200 years, Vault 101 , a fallout shelter, has faithfully served the surviving residents of Washington DC and its environs, now known as the Capital Wasteland. Though the global atomic war of 2077 left the US all but destroyed, the residents of Vault 101 enjoy a life free from the constant stress of the outside world. Giant Insects, Raiders, Slavers, and yes, even Super Mutants are all no match for superior Vault-Tec engineering. Yet one fateful morning, you awake to find that your father has defied the Overseer and left the comfort and security afforded by Vault 101 for reasons unknown. Leaving the only home you’ve ever known, you emerge from the Vault into the harsh Wasteland sun to search for your father, and the truth. Key Features: Limitless Freedom! – Take in the sights and sounds of the vast Capital Wasteland! See the great monuments of the United States lying in post-apocalyptic ruin! You make the choices that define you and change the world. Just keep an eye on your Rad Meter! Experience S.P.E.C.I.A.L.! – Vault-Tec engineers bring you the latest in human ability simulation – the SPECIAL Character System! Utilizing new breakthroughs in points-based ability representation, SPECIAL affords unlimited customization of your character. Also included are dozens of unique skills and perks to choose from, each with a dazzling variety of effects! Fantastic New Views! – The wizards at Vault-Tec have done it again! No longer constrained to just one view, experience the world from 1st or 3rd person perspective. Customize your view with the touch of a button! The Power of Choice! – Feeling like a dastardly villain today, or a Good Samaritan? Pick a side or walk the line, as every situation can be dealt with in many different ways. Talk out your problems in a civilized fashion, or just flash your Plasma Rifle. Blast ‘Em Away With V.A.T.S.! –Even the odds in combat with the Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System for your Pip-Boy Model 3000! V.A.T.S. allows you to pause time in combat, target specific body parts on your target, queue up attacks, and let Vault-Tec take out your aggression for you. Rain death and destruction in an all-new cinematic presentation featuring gory dismemberments and spectacular explosions. Mind-Blowing Artificial Intelligence! – At Vault-Tec, we realize that the key to reviving civilization after a global nuclear war is people. Our best minds pooled their efforts to produce an advanced version of Radiant AI, America’s First Choice in Human Interaction Simulation. Facial expressions, gestures, unique dialog, and lifelike behavior are brought together with stunning results by the latest in Vault-Tec technology. Eye-Popping Prettiness! – Witness the harsh realities of nuclear fallout rendered like never before in modern super-deluxe HD graphics. From the barren Wasteland, to the danger-filled offices and metro tunnels of DC, to the hideous rotten flesh of a mutant’s face. The Fallout 3 Collector’s Edition includes: Fallout 3: From the creators of the award-winning Oblivion comes Fallout 3, featuring one of the most realized game worlds ever created. Create any kind of character you want and explore the open wastes of post-apocalyptic Washington, D.C. Every minute is a fight for survival as you encounter Super Mutants, Ghouls, Raiders, and other dangers of the Wasteland. Prepare for the future. Vault Boy Bobblehead: Enjoy your very own Vault Boy with this collector’s item direct from Vault-Tec. The Art of Fallout 3: This hardcover book features nearly 100 pages of never-before seen concept art and commentary from Bethesda Game Studios artists. The Making of Fallout 3: Get an exclusive, inside look at Bethesda Game Studios and the team behind the game with this special DVD. Vault-Tec Lunch Box: The entire package comes in a fully customized metal lunch box.

description: Dishonored is a stealth-action game in every event that occurs in Dunwall. At the same time, players control Corvo Attano and seek revenge after being framed. The game offers assassination missions to be completed through violence or stealth. Corvo has weapons and magical abilities. Missions are non-linear and encourage exploration to satisfy the curious feeling. Stealth is a key element, and players can complete the game non-lethally. Corvo can perform various actions like jumping and swimming. Melee attacks, ranged weapons, and magic use the right and the left hand. In addition, a chaotic system affects the environment and NPCs, which require care from players. Stealth skills include aerial attacks and tranquilizer darts. Players can eavesdrop for information, including things to enhance Corvo’s abilities. Guards have different awareness levels.

name: MotorStorm Complete
description: A Japanese re-release of the hit PS3 racer, MotorStorm Complete adds a number of features and content not included in the original Japanese release, most importantly online play as well as over 60 newly added elements from download packs (including new tracks, racers and more.) Developed by Evolution Studios, MotorStorm delivers visceral off-road racing, plunging players into a frenzied environment awash with grit, mud and petrol, in a game that leaves the standard rules of racing in the dust. Gone are the limits of power restrictions, limited classes, and qualifying rounds. Players simply choose their vehicle from a massive range – including dirt bikes, ATVs, sand rails, rally cars, monster trucks, and everything in between – then hit the track in a no-holds-barred sprint to the finish line. Carving a swathe of destruction through the ever-changing wilderness, players must compete in a gasoline-fuelled, horsepower spectacle where the only rule is to try and stay alive.

name: Shadow of the Colossus
description: A young man journeys to a forbidden place. He carries a dead woman and seeks help from a being named Dormin. This god agrees to help but demands consequences before receiving the holy gift. In particular, the man must defeat sixteen colossi that are enormous and tough. However, to save his love, he uses an ancient sword and his horse, Agro, to fight them. The game is set in the same universe as ICO. Players must find and battle the colossi in order without other enemies in the world. Battles involve climbing the colossi and finding weak spots. Each colossus requires different tactics, such as using his weapons and environment to win. Fights take place in various landscapes such as mountains, deserts, and ruins to create different feelings.

name: Batman - Arkham Asylum - Collector's Edition
description: Batman has captured the Joker and returned him to Arkham Asylum. However, the inmates have taken control by Joker, who now runs the facility. Therefore, players take on the role of Batman from the third perspective and navigate through Arkham’s grounds and various wings. Arkham is a super-prison and rehabilitation center for the most dangerous criminals. By combining stealth, detective work, and exciting combat elements, players will apprehend the Joker. Along the way, they encounter some of Batman’s deadliest foes. Fortunately, the hero receives help from surviving guards and information from a computer genius named Oracle. Players utilize an array of gadgets, including the grappling hook and many other weapons. They gain experience points in combat and missions to upgrade Batman’s abilities and arsenal. The game features a controllable camera and an optional first-person view for detailed examinations.

name: Asura’s Wrath
description: Asura’s Wrath follows a demigod who has the mission to fight against beasts called Gohma. He joins an elite group to protect a powerful civilization. For gameplay, players control Asura from the third perspective and try the rail shooter experiences. The story unfolds like an anime with many cutscenes that can attract anyone. To complete the mission, Asura can use many moves like melee attacks, use a ranged cannon, dodge enemies, etc. You do not forget his special modes to increase strength and quickly finish the enemies. In the plot, Asura’s daughter becomes a priestess, but he doesn’t like this. Civilization reduces the planet’s resources through exploitation, and Gohma appears when nature is in danger.

name: The Club
description: The Club is an organization that recruits outsiders for underground bloodsports. All members almost have a talent for killing. Players can choose from eight characters with unique skills. Tournaments take place in various settings. You will pass six rounds and complete different objectives, like speed or survival skills. From the third perspective, the gameplay focuses on shooting. Players earn points and build combos to complete the mission faster. The point is calculated by your performances, fire location, combo multiplier, etc. Multiplayer modes are also available. Therefore, you will find some traditional gameplay in any FPS game, like Deathmatches. Overall, you will have thrilling experiences when you try many modes.

name: Dragon Age - Origins (Collector’s Edition)
description: A Blight was once averted by the Grey Wardens, so the Darkspawns are now assembling to attack Ferelden. At Ostagar, General Loghain soon pulls out in break-out combat. The hero gets lucky, while most of the other soldiers perish. Therefore, he must rally Ferelden together to win the war by having a strong party. In Dragon Age: Origins, players can suspend the real-time party fighting as they wish. Strategic choices and AI commands are available in the game to facilitate the gameplay for the new gamers. Specially, you can use the powers of the party members to destroy foes. You can bring nine friends into the party to have a great time and get experience together. In the battle, character switching and the use of special talents are both possible to create various actions. Although only four members of the group are allowed to go out, everyone in the party still gains experience.

name: Iron Man
description: The Iron Man game is an adaptation of the 2008 movie. Players will go with Tony Stark, a billionaire inventor. After being kidnapped, he builds armor to escape and fights against terrorists. The game adds to the story 12 missions and new villains. In addition, you will find nostalgic experiences when hearing original voices from the film and thrilling cinematics. Players can fight on the ground or in the air when equipping various weapons. Over time, you can make the suit and weapons more powerful. Special armors come from comics and motivate you to unlock. Money is the most important thing when all upgrades depend on it. From there, you will have more chances to defeat many enemy types like soldiers, tanks, and helicopters.

name: PES 2018 - Pro Evolution Soccer
description: INTRODUCTION As a fiercely contending counterpart to FIFA, Pro Evolution Soccer, brought to life by the creators of the acclaimed Castlevania and Metal Gear Solid, Konami, has continuously gripped the heartstrings and wallets of soccer enthusiasts worldwide. The 2018 installation of the Pro Evolution Soccer series, tailored explicitly for PS3, brings an ensemble of diverse soccer teams, despite the observable absence of specific licenses held by Electronic Arts. This variant continues to indulge players with single and multiplayer gaming modes and training programs designed to hone their soccer skills. ENHANCED MECHANICS FOR A REALISTIC EXPERIENCE Pro Evolution Soccer 2018 takes the baton from its predecessor and sprints forward with many enhancements. The Real Touch+ system, a brainchild of Konami’s gifted developers, facilitates more intricate ball handling by virtual soccer players, thereby diversifying the animations during ball receptions, headers, and dribbling. This edition further instills a sense of realism by slowing down match speeds, empowering players with strategic dribbling, and revamping set pieces such as penalties and free kicks. INNOVATIVE GAME MODES OFFERING A VARIETY OF EXPERIENCES In addition to the classic season-long team management, the 2018 edition unveils some exciting new game modes. An online cooperative way, catering to two or three players, graces the screen alongside the return of the Random Selection Match mode with added flexibility. The latter allows players to choose multiple teams, following which the game generates a unique mix of players from the selected groups. TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCEMENTS ELEVATING GRAPHIC QUALITY The game’s graphics have taken a quantum leap in quality compared to previous installations, thanks to the incorporation of the cutting-edge Real Capture technology by Konami. This means players are treated to more lifelike animations and polished player models that lend an authentic feel to the gameplay. Soccer kits fit players more accurately, and developers have even included players’ tattoos for teams in collaboration with developers like FC Barcelona. Furthermore, improved stadium aesthetics, accurate field recreation, and optimal lighting for daytime and evening matches amplify the overall visual appeal. THE INTERSECTION OF PES LEAGUE AND MYCLUB MODES One of the game’s distinguishing features is the integration of PES League with myClub modes, which enables players to immerse themselves in a unique, competitive experience. This blend of methods creates a perfect playground for players to showcase their football managing prowess and push their teams to climb the ladder of success. OVERHAULED USER INTERFACE AND MENUS To round off the advancements, this version introduces a fresh user interface and revised menus, ensuring players can navigate the game more quickly. While seemingly simple, these changes significantly enhance the overall gaming experience and demonstrate the developers’ commitment to continuous improvement. With such impressive enhancements, it’s no wonder this game has won over the hearts of many and continues to be a popular choice amongst gaming enthusiasts.

name: Watchmen - The End Is Nigh
description: Rorschach’s journal reveals his dark thoughts, so He and Nite Owl investigate a jailbreak. Underboss seems responsible, but many things went wrong. The game takes place before the original work. For the gameplay, players can choose from Rorschach or Nite Owl II. You should explore a prison break and uncover a bigger plot. Some actors also appear to give voices to their characters. With the deep combat, characters will show unique styles and moves to unlock gradually. When going through six chapters, you can choose to play solo or co-op with another player. Overall, players have the chance to dive into the complex world of Watchmen.

name: eFootball PES 2021 - Collector's Archive
description: eFootball PES 2021 Season Update is a PES 2020 update, containing the latest player data and club roster, giving you all the critically acclaimed features. Extensive gameplay: Overcoming the defense with the Finesse Dribble feature, the expanded trap mechanics will vary depending on the player’s ability and feel the accuracy of the kick in context. Each player’s individual style of play gives depth to your squad on the pitch. Master League mode: Master League is an iconic single-player mode that puts you in charge of your own club. While working to build and develop your dream team, you have a responsibility to advance growth through options both on and off the pitch. Experience the ups and downs of every season, from the start of the first game to the thrill of the finale. If you are looking for a rich football management experience then this is the mode for you. Matchday mode: Work side by side with new players and seasoned professionals, work together to take part in the biggest tournaments in Matchday Online Mode. Choose your favorite club and recruit other users of the same skill level to contribute to the team’s victory.

name: Call of Duty 3 - Platinum Collection
description: The game focuses on the fight in Normandy, France, during World War II. Players control allied soldiers from four nations to complete the mission in the campaign mode. At the same time, the game is around real events, like 88 days before Paris’ liberation. You can use the environment or destroy it if it is necessary. Cinematics explain events between missions to help understand the historical events. Enemies work together and use tactics. In addition, you can join the deathmatch and team-based games with your friend or compete against other opponents. The game also provides multiple classes with unique abilities. Therefore, you can build teams that match in power and strategy.

name: 007 Legends
description: 007 Legends is a FPS game where you can become a real James Bond in famous movies. The game has six chapters that are inspired by many film parts. The story starts with Skyfall when you will see Bond get shot and remember past missions. The gameplay is so friendly, with many player types when they shoot enemies and use cover. Besides direct attacks, the stealth system can be used in some cases. The game has different types of missions that can be attached to driving and fistfights. You can use gadgets like a smartphone. Players can choose how to heal. Through the missions, the core things are defeating enemies to earn points and upgrade equipment.

name: NeverDead
description: NeverDead is a TFS game where you will see the journey of Bryce, an immortal demon hunter. He has passed 500 years with an immortal curse. After the death of his wife, he works with Arcadia to hunt demons for money. In addition, players will join their investigation of a demonic invasion. Despite his immortality, he can still receive damage from enemies. Bryce fights with guns and a sword, but in some difficult fights, he often loses body parts. With the strong regeneration, he can grow missing parts, but his skills become weaker. In addition, many enemies present their powers that can counter the powers of the protagonist. Therefore, you should play carefully if you want to survive and progress in gameplay and story.

name: Gran Turismo 5 - Academy Edition

name: Syndicate

Therefore, the world is divided into two types of people. Tension exists between syndicates and unchipped civilians. Players control Miles Kilo, which is an agent with a new prototype chip. The storyline concerns espionage and betrayal. When trying the shooting experience, Kilo can carry two weapons and grenades with the health regeneration. The bio-chip of the protagonist is very useful in many situations when slowing time and x-ray vision are needed to detect enemies from far away. He can also hack opponents and add various negative effects to them. Therefore, players will like the absolute powers.

name: Resident Evil - Operation Raccoon City - Special Edition
description: Resident Evil: Operation Raccoon City, known in Japan as Biohazard: Operation Raccoon City (バイオハザード オペレーション・ラクーンシティ Baiohazādo Operēshon Rakūn Shiti?) is a third-person shooter video game for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, co-developed by Slant Six Games and Capcom. It was released on March 20, 2012 in North America, March 22, 2012 in Australia, March 23, 2012 in Europe and April 26, 2012 in Japan. It is part of the Resident Evil series, being set around the same time as Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil 3: Nemesis, and featuring the characters from these two games, though it is a non-canon hypothetical scenario. The game follows a group of elite paramilitary mercenaries for the Umbrella Corporation during the zombie outbreak in Raccoon City. The game was met with a mixed and often negative critical reception. It was a commercial success, selling more than 2 million units.

name: Assassin's Creed IV - Black Flag - Skull Edition
description: Aveline, the first leading female Assassin who headlined Assassin’s Creed III Liberation on the Sony PlayStation Vita system, returns in Assassin’s Creed IV: Black Flag with three missions exclusively on PS3 systems. The year is 1715. Pirates rule the Caribbean and have established their own lawless Republic where corruption, greediness and cruelty are commonplace. Among these outlaws is a brash young captain named Edward Kenway. His fight for glory has earned him the respect of legends like Blackbeard, but also drawn him into the ancient war between Assassins and Templars, a war that may destroy everything the pirates have built. Welcome to the Golden Age of Piracy. This edition contains: PlayStation 3 Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag game Jumbo steel case Artbook Two lithographs Official soundtrack Single player missions: Hidden Mystery and Sacrificed Secrets In-game content: Captain Kenway's Legacy

This comes from a new ability that allows players to switch between different drivers instantly and makes the car chases more interesting. Overall, in this game, players can race, do stunts, and even participate in movie scenes.

name: Fast & Furious - Showdown
description: With the success of the blockbuster “Fast & Furious 6”, the popular gaming firm Activision decided to develop “Fast & Furious: Showdown”, the “follow-up” action racing game developed by Firebrand Games. Right from the first time, it was launched, the game has given players the experience of the dramatic and exciting racing games that we have witnessed on the screen. In particular, the game also has the presence of familiar characters in the series “The Fast and Furious”, except for the notable absence of the famous character in the film, Dominic Toretto. The gameplay in “Fast & Furious: Showdown” focuses on cooperative driving and chases and fights on vehicles. Also in some missions, the player character may need to steal another vehicle by jumping from the front of their vehicle to another. All cars have HP bars and some nitro features. The plot of “Fast & Furious: Showdown” begins with the cut scene of the character Monica Fuentes finding Riley Hicks digging everywhere through files in her office. Riley introduces herself and says she will meet Luke Hobbs in 24 hours, and needs to know everything Hobbs has done. The following missions were events told by Monica to explain what Hobbs had solved. name: Red Dead Redemption - Undead Nightmare - Gold Pack
description: INTRODUCTION In the gaming world, Red Dead Redemption: Undead Nightmare is more than just an action-packed adventure—it’s a comprehensive anthology of riveting DLCs for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. It’s like a juicy steak with a side of mouth-watering extras: Undead Nightmare Pack, Outlaws to the End Co-Op Mission Pack, Legends and Killers Pack, Liars and Cheats Pack, and even the Multiplayer Free Roam update content. Please fasten your seat belts as we delve into this exhilarating ride and explore why this game is the cat’s pajamas. UNDEAD NIGHTMARE: ZOMBIE FUN WITH A TWIST Is this game’s primary draw? The Undead Nightmare Pack. You’ll be in the boots of John Marston, the same protagonist from the base game, fighting tooth and nail to find a cure for a zombie outbreak that’s threatening to take over. Using the Blunderbuss, a new addition to your arsenal and a short-barreled shotgun that fires zombie remains, you’ll confront four distinct types of undead. As if that’s not thrilling enough, watch out for infected critters that might just give you a heart attack when you’re on foot! NEW CHALLENGES AND MULTIPLAYER THRILLS Fancy rescuing potential survivors or battling waves of the undead with your comrades in arms? The game offers new challenges, missions, and events like Missing Persons and the fan-loved Undead Overrun Mode. So, don your headset, call up your mates, and prepare to defend humanity in the most entertaining way possible! CO-OP MISSIONS: TEAMWORK MAKES THE DREAM WORK Next up, the Outlaws to The End Co-Op Mission Pack serves up six lip-smacking co-op missions. Feel like a hero in The Escape, attacking bandits, nabbing their loot, and cleaning up the town of Tumbleweed. Or try your hand at cowboy chores with The Herd, herding cattle into Armadillo, with the minor inconvenience of snipers and horse riders aiming to take you down. Never a dull moment, right? LEGENDS AND KILLERS PACK: MORE MULTIPLAYER MADNESS The Legends and Killers Pack takes the multiplayer frenzy up a notch. Not only does it offer nine new maps and eight playable characters, but it also introduces a wicked new weapon – the Tomahawk axe. So, brace yourself to lob axes in a virtual battle that feels too real! LIARS AND CHEATS: A WHOLE NEW GAMING EXPERIENCE Lastly, the Liars and Cheats Pack further diversifies the gameplay. Immerse yourself in Liars Dice and Poker mini-games designed for online play, or partake in adrenaline-pumping multiplayer horse races. You’re in for an unforgettable gaming journey with a new weapon—the Explosive Rifle—and its challenges, seven gang hideouts, four hunting zones, and the multiplayer Stronghold Competitive Mode. Adding 15 characters from the single-player campaign to the multiplayer mode is the cherry on top! To sum it all up, Red Dead Redemption: Undead Nightmare is more than just a game—it’s a thrilling universe of action, adventure, and pure unadulterated fun that never fails to impress. So grab your controller and get ready to dive in!

It's been praised for delivering a compelling mix of action, stealth and puzzle-solving game-play tied with a dark original storyline penned by five-time Emmy award winner Paul Dini and supported by a famous cast of voice actors, including Mark Hamill as The Joker and Kevin Conroy as Batman.

The game is a continuation of the previous game Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures and was published by Bandai Namco Gamse in 2014. Entering the game, players will control the existing Pac character in the game to participate in the game. Each Pac character will have different skills depending on what player the player wants to use to join the game. Through the bustling streets of Pacopolis, Netherworld or the depths of the ocean and space, players will control the character to explore PacWorld land to carry out the assigned task. Entering the game, the game character is provided with 5 hearts to represent life in the game to participate in destroying enemies. By avoiding enemy attacks and eating them, players will collect gold and medals when they destroy all enemies at that gate. Bronze, silver or gold medals will depend on the number of points the player earns. Each gate is completed players will open the other door.

description: For those who are crazy fans of the world’s most popular manga “Dragon Ball”, “Dragon Ball Xenoverse” is a game that you cannot ignore. Developed by Dimps and published by one of the popular gaming companies, Bandai Namco. First released to the public in February 2015, “Dragon Ball Xenoverse” has created an unprecedented fever in the gaming community when witnessing the return of the characters in the manga and anime. are: Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo, Gohan, … There is also the appearance of an entirely new character that is God of Destruction, Beerus and Whis. The most special feature that makes “Dragon Ball Xenoverse” attractive to players is the ability to create your own character in one of 5 races including Earth, Saiyan, Majin, Namek and Frieza. The match in “Dragon Ball Xenoverse” is designed in 3D, when players can freely move to all 4 directions on the map. In addition, characters in battle can fly into the air, or jump into the water to fight. With the character design, the environment, the voiceover, the sound effects from the basic attack or the technique, all make players think of the past “Dragon Ball” anime, this is a plus point. Positive game. Players will experience a whole new storyline in “Dragon Ball Xenoverse”. The game will focus on two villains named Towa and Mira who are manipulating history and Time Patrol Trunks, who have a duty to stop them. Trunks asks Shenlong to send him a hero (the player’s character), which will help him restore the history. In the game, players will witness the famous historical battles seen in the manga and anime.

name: Payday 2
description: INTRODUCTION Imagine yourself as part of a dynamic crew, embarking on dangerous missions in Washington, D.C., while skillfully navigating through an advanced criminal network. This scenario captures the thrilling essence of “Payday 2”, a co-op first-person shooter developed by the Stockholm-based Overkill Software. This game is the exciting sequel to the smash hit of 2011, and it stays true to its roots while introducing new and engaging features. THE TACTICAL DIVERSITY OF THE GANG Each player in “Payday 2” slips into the shoes of a notorious gang member. These characters aren’t mere palette swaps but carefully crafted personas, each offering a unique gameplay experience. The game provides four specializations for players: Mastermind, Enforcer, Ghost, and Technician. Each field features a distinctive skill tree and allows unique equipment, amplifying the level of strategic planning necessary to succeed in your missions. THE VIBRANT HUB OF CRIME: WASHINGTON D.C. One of the game’s signature features is its setting – Washington D.C., a city that stands as a thriving hub of criminal activity in this virtual world. The story unfolds through many hazardous assignments delivered through the infamous CRIMENET system. But these assignments aren’t just your run-of-the-mill heists. The game steps beyond typical robberies to include diverse tasks such as kidnapping and drug smuggling, keeping the players on their toes at all times. THE EMPHASIS ON COOPERATIVE PLAY “Payday 2” pivots around teamwork. It’s not just about charging in guns blazing; cooperation is a core element, making every mission feel like an intricate dance where every move needs to be coordinated with your teammates. The game can accommodate up to four players, creating a cooperative experience where the stakes rise with increasing opponents, including guards, police officers, FBI agents, SWAT teams, and rival criminals. ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: YOUR SMARTER OPPONENT Another standout aspect of “Payday 2” is its sophisticated AI system. This isn’t your granddad’s artificial intelligence. This AI has been massively enhanced compared to the game’s predecessor. The enemy now exhibits increased difficulty levels and employs clever strategies to keep even the most seasoned gamers on edge. EXPERIENCE UNPREDICTABILITY AND PERSONALIZATION The game breaks the monotony by introducing randomness in its missions. Thanks to this element, players never experience the same task twice. Whether it’s the unpredictable events or the varying locations of AI-controlled opponents, every playthrough is unique. Additionally, the pre-mission shopping phase allows players to influence their gameplay, purchasing items like door codes or securing swift escapes via helicopters. “Payday 2” also features an elaborate system to customize weapons and clothing, ensuring a personal touch to your character’s appearance and arsenal. So there you have it. “Payday 2” – a game that takes you on a thrilling journey of coordinated criminal chaos. A game that transforms you into an integral part of a gang takes you on diverse missions, puts you against intelligent enemies, and lets you carve your path in style. If adrenaline is your drug, then this game is your dealer.

name: Call of Duty - Black Ops III - Premium Edition
description: INTRODUCTION Step into the exhilarating world of Call of Duty: Black Ops II, a military-themed first-person shooter that proudly stands as the ninth entry in the beloved game series. Crafted by the seasoned artisans at Treyarch Studios, who previously graced us with Call of Duty 3, Call of Duty: World at War, and the original Call of Duty: Black Ops, this latest installment continues to redefine the gaming landscape. A FRESH PERSPECTIVE ON STORYTELLING Call of Duty: Black Ops II transports players to 2025 in a daring divergence from the traditional settings. It’s the era of a new Cold War, with the United States and China as principal actors, and the stakes are sky-high – the control of rare earth elements, the lifeblood of expensive electronics and alternative energy. The tale unfolds through the eyes of David Mason, the son of Alex Mason from the first Black Ops, and his formidable foe, Raul Menendez of Nicaragua. Rife with flashbacks from the 80s and familiar faces like Frank Woods, this game is a thrilling roller coaster ride of nostalgic callbacks and futuristic predictions. ADVANCED GAMEPLAY MECHANICS Future warfare has its perks, especially in the form of advanced weaponry and equipment. Imagine taking down opponents with sniper rifles equipped with scopes that can reveal hidden enemies or employing electric charges as ammunition. Adding improved sights and a computer integrated into the uniform lends an extra strategic edge by enabling air support calls. Yet, it’s not just about shooting – there are various activities to partake in. The freedom to maneuver advanced vehicles such as the F-38 fighter and futuristic helicopters sets Black Ops II apart from its predecessors. NEW DIMENSIONS TO STRATEGY In an innovative twist, players can choose how to execute specific missions by providing long-range cover with a sniper rifle or getting up close and personal, guns blazing. This flexibility adds dynamism to the gameplay and allows for personalization according to your preferred play style. Each choice offers a unique vantage point, making every playthrough feel different. EXCITING GAME MODES Black Ops II introduces the innovative Strike Force Operations mode, an amalgamation of real-time strategy with classic FPS gameplay. Take the reins of a drone, lead a foot soldier, or manage the operation from the skies. But be warned, failure in this mode doesn’t result in the game being over; instead, it dampens your standing on the international stage, influencing the game’s conclusion. REFINED MULTIPLAYER AND ZOMBIE MODES The multiplayer mode has received a significant upgrade, with the innovative Pick 10 system allowing for greater customization. It’s all about strategic choices, whether you’re picking improvements, using “Wildcards,” or selecting your weapons. Destruction is your playground, whether drones or the unique microwave gun. With various maps offering varied settings, the game also fosters a strong connection with social media, adding a new dimension to your experience. The iconic Zombie mode also makes a triumphant return, with feedback-driven improvements and three varied game variants, providing an adrenaline-pumping co-op experience. TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCEMENTS Call of Duty: Black Ops II leverages a heavily modified graphics engine that traces back to Call of Duty: World at War and the first Black Ops. The improvements include enhanced physics, partial environment destruction, and extraordinarily detailed locations, all while maintaining the series’ hallmark smooth animation at 60 frames per second. With DirectX 11 at its core, the game ensures that players are treated to a visual spectacle befitting this highly anticipated installment.

name: Thief
description: INTRODUCTION Swathed in the shadowy allure of a Victorian-gothic-steampunk universe, “Thief” is a riveting action game that hauls you into the life and escapades of a master looter named Garrett. Brought to life by the talented team at Eidos Montreal, known for their hand in creating Deus Ex: Human Revolution, Thief is an inventive reimagining of the much-loved series, no longer crafted by Looking Glass and Ion Storm. THE ADVENTUROUS PLOT Our nimble hero, Garrett, returns to the stage after vanishing for years into the ether, slipping back into the labyrinthine cityscape known simply as the City. A grim, ruthless tyrant dubbed the Baron rules this realm, his iron fist leaving the City’s residents suffering from his brutal reign and a shrouded pestilence wreaking havoc. Our cunning Thief finds the ensuing pandemonium too good an opportunity to pass up. However, it isn’t long before Garrett finds himself caught in the crosshairs of a more complex web of conspiracy and conflict, forced to play his cards carefully. THE THRILLING GAMEPLAY In its mechanics, our game hews closely to its legendary predecessors. It comprises a series of intricate missions that send Garrett slithering through the homes of the City’s wealthy, prying into their darkest secrets. Players can approach tasks in several ways, leveraging many tools, including but not limited to wire cutters, rope arrows, and keys to ventilation shafts. Embracing the true spirit of thievery, Garrett shuns confrontation instead of sneaking past or neutralizing guards using equipment like water darts, noise-making devices, or the trusty club. SMARTER OPPOSITION AND ENHANCED INTERACTION This revamped installment brings considerable improvements to NPC behavior. City guards and other NPCs are now capable of more thoroughly searching rooms for signs of the elusive infiltrator and possess a better understanding of the level layout. Furthermore, our dexterous protagonist Garrett has acquired a new ability called ‘focus,’ which illuminates interactive elements and slows down time for precise pickpocketing and lockpicking. This feature also gives him an upper hand during combat, allowing him to launch special attacks. ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY FOR A VIBRANT EXPERIENCE Our game harnesses the power of Unreal Engine 3, resulting in realistic lighting and shadow effects, intricately detailed locations, and meticulous character models. From crowded public houses to an isolated, eerie asylum, Garrett’s journey will take him through various mesmerizing settings. The music, often an overlooked element, plays a crucial role in our game, appearing only during intense chase sequences, enabling players to immerse themselves in the ambient sounds of the environment, from guard conversations that might unveil secrets to the rustle of potential threats. SPYING ON THE HORIZON: WHAT’S NEXT FOR THIEF In the end, Thief takes players on a stealthy adventure that truly pays homage to its renowned lineage while introducing fresh, exciting elements. As Garrett continues his journey through the City, who knows what treasures and secrets he’ll uncover next? Whether you’re a longtime fan or new to the series, the City’s rooftops and shadowy alleys await you, ready to reveal their secrets. So, why not seize the opportunity and step into Garrett’s shoes? It’s time to become the Thief of the Century, one rooftop at a time.

name: Musou Orochi Z - Elite Release
description: Warriors Orochi Z (無双オロチ Z, Musō Orochi Zetto), is a 2009 beat ’em up video game developed by Koei and Omega Force for the PlayStation 3 and Microsoft Windows. Z is the third installment of the Warriors Orochi series, a crossover video game of the Dynasty Warriors and Samurai Warriors series. Musou Orochi Z was intended to be a combination of the first two games with more characters and stages on an updated gaming platform. The game was released in Japan for the PS3 on March 12, 2009, and released for the Windows on November 27, 2009. Koei had planned to release the game as Warriors Orochi Z in North America and Europe, but those plans have since been cancelled.

name: Diablo III - Reaper of Souls – Ultimate Evil Edition - Collector's Cut
description: INTRODUCTION Summon the storm of fury right in the comfort of your abode. Diablo III: Reaper of Souls – Ultimate Evil Edition has rallied more than 15 million game warriors to smite the sinister legions of the underworld. You are invited to join this noble crusade, taking arms against the forces threatening the mortal realm. This package presents Diablo III and the Reaper of Souls expansion set in one comprehensive volume. Brace yourself as a chilling wind of malevolence is blowing your way. A SEIGE LIFTED BY DEMONIC DESTRUCTION The game is about taking down the fiendish hordes rampaging across all five acts of the epic storyline. But that’s not all; you could roam the open world in Adventure Mode. Here, you get to seek out and dispatch the primeval evils hidden in the corners of the mortal realms while earning bounties. The freedom to choose how you engage with the game is part of what has endeared it to its millions of players worldwide. RISING TO THE OCCASION AS A TRUE CHAMPION Choose from a diverse roster of humanity’s last defenders—the crusader, wizard, monk, demon hunter, witch doctor, or barbarian—and amplify your prowess with powerful abilities and legendary gear. It’s not just about selecting a character but about immersing yourself in a role that resonates with you and crafting a legacy on the battlefield. MASTERING A DYNAMIC BATTLEFIELD This game isn’t for the faint of heart. You are tasked with annihilating legions of vile creatures across varied, randomized 3D environments. Confront countless demonic villains, discover quests in fresh locations, and revel in the loot that rains down with every playthrough. The battlefield is forever changing, forcing you to adapt and ensuring that no two gaming experiences are identical. CALLING UPON THE POWER OF FRIENDSHIP The path before you need not be walked alone. Engage in solo play or team up with up to four heroes locally on a single screen or online with fellow players. Cooperation and camaraderie make for a richer experience, where strategy and synergy can mean victory and defeat. READY TO UNLEASH HELL IN YOUR LIVING ROOM? With Diablo III: Reaper of Souls – Ultimate Evil Edition, you’re not just playing a game but stepping into a world of epic fantasy. From crushing hordes of evil to standing as a champion, from conquering dynamic battlefields to calling upon allies, there is a lot to love about this game. It’s not just a journey; it’s your crusade. So, are you ready to embrace the call and face the wickedness on its way?

While El Blaze wrestles in lucha libre, Eileen practices monkey kung fu. Although J6 is sponsoring the tournament, competitors are not aware of their new Dural fighting program. Despite modifications, the gameplay consists of one-on-one arena combat with a changed ranking system and decreased throw speed. With a new offensive move, fighters can easily maneuver and launch strategic strikes. Throws can be used by the clash system to cancel attacks and give players the chance to win. description: The game has the action RPG elements set in the fantasy world. You will find the land attacked by Jeyne Kassynder. She aims to destroy the Montbarron family and their allies. To solve this situation and protect everyone, players choose one of four characters. The game has a new combat system accessible for newbies when they can control movement and attacks directly. Special attacks use focus energy. Enemies drop health and energy balls instead of potions. To fight against many strong opponents, players team up with an AI companion. They also focus on the level-up and skills of characters. Like other RPG games, passive talents and active abilities are the best combinations to reach the best powers. In addition, players will make decisions that influence quests and can change the main storyline.

description: Cole MacGrath faces The Beast in inFAMOUS 2. He escapes to New Marais with Zeke and Lucy while they plan to defeat the enemies with a special device. In particular, Cole remains the old power and continues unlocking the new ones to defeat the Beast. Based on your choices, the future will change in a good or bad way. In particular, Good or evil choices affect his karma and available powers. Side missions involve helping citizens or causing chaos. Being good gains allies but requires careful actions, while everyone can turn against Cole because he has become totally evil. Therefore, everyone decides their game style by completing various tasks, such as protecting people and restoring electricity. In particular, some missions are exclusive to good or evil paths.

name: FIFA 12
description: As the updated version, FIFA Soccer 12 lets players control soccer athletes directly. Because of many licenses, you can manage real teams in actual leagues to have more realistic experiences. The game still focuses on the career mode when you can choose from the main role. Especially you can be a manager, player, or coach. Absolutely, each of them has different tasks. The new thing about the game is a new physics engine where you can make a defense more realistic and easily. The athletes become smarter, and sometimes, they will hinder you in difficult matches. When you know all the skills of players, you will make choices based on your knowledge and strategy.

name: Terraria
description: “Minecraft” is considered one of the most famous sandbox game monuments in the world, becoming a huge brand for the gaming industry. That is why we can not ignore “Terraria”, a popular game that is compared by many players in the world as “Minecraft” in the simulation genre. “Terraria” is an independent adventure and survival game created by Re-Logic. The game was first released on PC on May 16, 2011 and is developed on many different platforms. In the game, players will be transformed into a hero whose mission is to beat you evil enemies on a journey around the world. In addition, players can also do many interesting things in the game world “Terraria” from digging, fighting to building houses and exploring the world. The plot and gameplay are similar to “Minecraft”, players are free to do everything they want with their imagination. The player’s character will be equipped with a number of items that can be exploited or made to help protect, attack, or support the character. In addition, players can collect wood, stone, lead and other resources to create whatever players need to turn the world into their own and protect it. Build houses, forts and castles and even allow others to move in. Players can even sell the goods they produce to help with the assigned tasks.

name: God of War Collection
description: Being an action-adventure game, God of War is played from the third-person perspective with the main character, Kratos. Players fight against enemies from Greek mythology, like minotaurs, harpies, and zombie soldiers. Therefore, the Hydra and the Guardian of Pandora are bosses and require them to pay attention to. Jumping and climbing are essential in platforming. While some riddles are easy, some are really difficult. Players can restore their health and magic by collecting orbs. Gain experience for improvements by consuming red orbs. You can enhance your meter length by using Gorgon Eyes and Phoenix Feathers. Remastered editions of the original two games are part of this collection. These updates include better visuals and a frame rate of 60 FPS. They also offer help for trophies. All of the visuals are in high definition now, so they’re much sharper.

name: Legend of Spyro - Dawn of the Dragon
description: “Legend of Spyro: Dawn of the Dragon” is an extremely attractive action-adventure game in “The Legend of Spyro” series developed by the Étranges Libellules in collaboration with Activision and Vivendi Games. This is the third and final part of the series “The Legend of Spyro”, as well as marking the tenth anniversary of the series. The game has been praised by the game critics for its quality. The graphics are noticeably improved from the previous two versions, building a vast open-world with images from green grass to lava caves that are bright and colourful. It is also the first “Legend of Spyro” game that allows players to fly whenever they want (free-fly mode). The main character in the game is the dragon Spyro, the game also has the appearance of Cynder, a dragon girl will follow the player during the adventure, especially the player can choose between the character Spyro and Cynder in Co-op mode. In this version, players can also customize Spyro in a variety of ways by upgrading their combat capabilities and obstacle-breaking techniques along with the dragon armour system. Players can unlock new armour items that not only change their appearance but also their attributes.

name: Cars 3 - Driven to Win - Champion Release
description: INTRODUCTION Imagine immersing yourself in an exquisitely developed game brimming with animated wonders. If this sounds inviting, let me introduce you to “Cars 3: Driven to Win,” a creative spinoff of Pixar’s animated trilogy, available on various platforms, including PS4 and PS3. This captivating installment is the brainchild of Avalanche Software, a gaming studio that rose like a phoenix from its ashes. Previously shuttered by Disney in May 2016, the studio found new life under Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment, helmed again by the indefatigable John Blackburn. THE FAITHFUL PLOT Despite the common notion that racing games rarely hinge on plot, Cars 3: Driven to Win bucks the trend. While focusing on the adrenaline rush of racing, it stays devoted to its cinematic counterpart and offers fresh insights. Join Lightning McQueen and Cruz Ramirez as they gear up to outspeed their fierce opponent, Jackson Storm. It’s a fast-paced narrative that will get your gears grinding! THE MECHANICS OF FUN Welcome to a world where Mario Kart-style arcade racing melds seamlessly with vibrant Pixar animation. Offering over twenty customizable car characters, each unique and full of personality, this game thrills and excites. Dash through twenty distinct tracks, from the renowned Radiator Springs to the bustling Florida International Speedway, set across thirteen diverse locations. The cars in “Cars 3: Driven to Win” aren’t just for looks – they’re teeming with upgrades, turbo boosts, and even the exhilarating ability to drive backward! UNLOCK THE EXTRAS Why stop racing when there’s so much more to explore? “Cars 3: Driven to Win” places you in the driver’s seat of your game progression. Training and test-driving open up a world of bonuses. Extra game modes, charismatic characters, exciting new tracks, and fantastic features await the persistent and adventurous gamer. REALISTIC GRAPHICAL WONDERS Visually, Cars 3: Driven to Win aims to mirror the captivating aesthetics of the animated film it draws inspiration from. This three-dimensional wonderment transports you into a realm where gaming graphics meet cinematic excellence. The familiar faces of your favorite characters and beloved locations are faithfully reproduced, eliciting a sense of delightful nostalgia. WRAPPING IT UP When the rubber meets the road, “Cars 3: Driven to Win” is a testament to creativity, a blending of cinematic charm, and gaming innovation. Combining a faithful plot, fun mechanics, unlockable extras, and breathtaking graphics makes this game a win-win for Pixar fans and gamers alike. Just remember, it’s not about the destination but the adrenaline-fueled journey! Buckle up and enjoy the ride.

name: Mortal Kombat - Komplete Edition - Neo Cut
description: Mortal Kombat Komplete Edition delivers the critically acclaimed game, all previously released downloadable content (DLC), plus digital downloads of the 2011 release of Mortal Kombat: Songs Inspired by the Warriors album with a bonus track, and the 1995 Mortal Kombat film on the PlayStation Store or Xbox Live Zune. The DLC includes fan-favorite warriors Skarlet, Kenshi and Rain, as well as the infamous dream stalker Freddy Krueger. The game also offers 15 Klassic Skins and three Klassic Fatalities (Scorpion, Sub-Zero and Reptile). Mortal Kombat: Songs Inspired by the Warriors is a collection of electronic music inspired by the game and is executive produced by JFK (of the DJ/ production duo MSTRKRFT and Death From Above 1979)

description: Lair follows the fantasy theme when you will explore the medieval setting of the game. The story will involve a war between two civilizations. The Asylians have abundant resources, but the Mokai struggle in barren lands. Therefore, the peace will return when a faction disappears. You control Rohn, an elite Sky Guard in the Asylians army. In addition, the aerial battles will happen and be attached to the motion sensor of PS3 for realistic challenges. You can attack with fire powers or use melee combos with other dragons. name: Resident Evil - Operation Raccoon City - Special Edition - Neo Cut
description: Resident Evil: Operation Raccoon City, known in Japan as Biohazard: Operation Raccoon City (バイオハザード オペレーション・ラクーンシティ Baiohazādo Operēshon Rakūn Shiti?) is a third-person shooter video game for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, co-developed by Slant Six Games and Capcom. It was released on March 20, 2012 in North America, March 22, 2012 in Australia, March 23, 2012 in Europe and April 26, 2012 in Japan. It is part of the Resident Evil series, being set around the same time as Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil 3: Nemesis, and featuring the characters from these two games, though it is a non-canon hypothetical scenario. The game follows a group of elite paramilitary mercenaries for the Umbrella Corporation during the zombie outbreak in Raccoon City. The game was met with a mixed and often negative critical reception. It was a commercial success, selling more than 2 million units.

The third game in the LittleBigPlanet franchise, the toolset within LittleBigPlanet 2 provides players with the ability to easily change the mapping of objects in-game, add abilities and non-player AI characters, create cutscenes, link levels and more. description: After 150 years, there will be fewer humans than before. A war with mechs has ruined the world, so plants cover buildings, and mechs roam cities to create a chaotic ambiance. Survivors are enslaved and transported in the ship. Therefore, some characters want to escape that, like Monkey, while Trip puts a headband on him. She wants him to take her home so the two people can survive and complete the goal. They start a journey to the village and finish their mission as a team to survive. Being an action-adventure, the game allows players to control Monkey and escort Trip. Monkey has a strong fighting ability, while Trip helps by distracting enemies. She has a camera to find mechs and mines. Players collect orbs to upgrade Monkey’s skills. At the same time, the game has three difficulty levels and a chapter-select mode.
