However, only Sealers can not accept this progress because they can put souls to rest. A new weapon surprisingly arrives in a remote kingdom. After that, the king and his son are killed, and the weapon is taken. A Sealer named Aisha takes the soul of a dying warrior to seek revenge. They start their journey through linear levels to find items and spells in chests. The Sealer and Soul can share stats and HP but still possess their powers. In combat, players first target monster parts, so magic can hit them more exactly. Fallen enemies can be poached for MP by Nine or permanently killed by Aisha.

name: Tekken Hybrid - Heroic Edition
description: “Tekken Hybrid” is a game collection of the Tekken series of game series released by Namco Bandai Games in 2011. It is a Japanese fighting game genre among the characters available in the game. The game has beautiful 3D graphics to help players feel the truth from the characters in the game. “Tekken Hybrid” has a total of 34 characters available that players can choose to participate in matches. The game has single-player mode and multiplayer online game mode. Entering the game, the player can move the character to attack the opponent. The health meter bar is displayed on the screen to help players can easily monitor the status of the character. In the game the player can choose up to 8 battles to play according to the Tekken card rules, the player can allow their fighter to rest to recover health while the player’s character fights with the opponent. If the character participating in the match in the game is defeated, the player can replace a new one to continue fighting. Conversely, if the player’s characters are completely defeated their fighter must continue the game alone.

description: The game happens before the famous 2011 movie. In this game, players will see all things from the third perspective and make vehicle combat more suitable. Players can transform freely, and this is the desire of all fans of this series film. The story opens seven chapters and an epilogue that happens in many locations in South America. In addition, the game allows for choosing the faction that affects the storyline. Players control Autobots and Decepticons, which have unique abilities. The new Stealth Force mode makes characters stronger when players can take advantage of its unlimited-ammo feature. In this version, players still play against others in competitive multiplayer with traditional gameplays like the deathmatch and conquest.

In this game, players can join online multiplayer for the first time. Players can face one of four gods before battles to receive new abilities. Through the quest, levels and new items will appear and become the goal for everyone. In addition, four multiplayer modes in the game include Team Favor of the Gods and Capture the Flag.

Overall, the game will bring thrilling missions for players and help them feel nostalgic for the original and new features.

name: Tom Clancy’s H.A.W.X
description: In 2014, countries hired private military companies, which created competition between them. David Crenshaw, the protagonist, joins a PMC and is freed from the US Army after aiding Ghost Recon. At the same time, he realizes the missions worldwide. From there, he finds out the deep things in a global military war. Through the game, his decisions will lead to many outcomes of the wars. Various real-life planes are available and make players try to unlock when completing many missions and progressing. Missions require you to defend or destroy targets to earn more experience points.

name: IL-2 Sturmovik - Birds of Prey
description: The game is inspired by WWII flight. In this simulation, you will pass five battle theatres and over 50 missions. Realistic damage models are included when they show engine damage and bullet holes to have a real experience. Besides the campaign, you can choose from the modes of multiplayer, like Dogfight, Team Battle, etc. Various planes can be applied to different skins, and players can freely personalize their weapons. The mixes of historical accuracy with engaging gameplay allow players to experience aerial combat in different scenarios. At the same time, multiplayer modes provide diverse challenges and encourage teamwork. You can play it with your friends and have a great time in the sky.

name: 50 Cent - Blood on the Sand - Definitive Archive
description: “50 Cent: Blood on the Sand” is an action video game series released next of the 50 Cent: Bulletproof series. This is a third-person shooter game developed by Swordfish Studios and was released in 2009 by THQ. The game has many genres played for gamers such as shooting directly, fighting cars or fighting between helicopters. The game revolves around the protagonist, 50 Cent, a rapper trying to join the G-Unit members to destroy the Kamal terrorist who stole the skull encrusted with diamonds and pearls from Anwar to mortgage them. In the game, players can use the money to buy new weapons or upgrade the weapons available in the “Store” of the game. Also if players want to earn super weapons they must earn G-Unit badges to unlock weapons. The gold ingots players collect in the game can be exchanged for support money for purchases in the “Shop” feature. By the time the game was released, “50 Cent: Blood on the Sand” had sold about 56,000 copies in the United States, hitting the biggest sales mark right after its release.
